A Hunter's Calling#009.src: An end, ousted by further action. An end, brought to six. An end, to the surety of the haughty. An end, of the world... in some fashion.

A Hunter's Calling#011.src: Make your way to the end of the cave.

A Hunter's Calling#012.src: Return back up the cave and fix a way out.

A Hunter's Calling#013.src: Return back up the cave and fix a way out.

A Hunter's Calling#014.src: Metal. Preventing an end. Life. Ends, prevented. Does metal taking life, bringing an end, truly prevent more?

A Hunter's Calling#015.src: Trick {~} people to follow you into the iron golem factory.

A Hunter's Calling#016.src: Make your way through the factory.

A Hunter's Calling#017.src: A home, invaded. A society, crumbling. The people, starving. The concerned, helpless. The flames, rising. An end you will not expect.

A Hunter's Calling#021.src: Metal. Life. A new place... One is not sacrificed for another. Always distrusting. Tension, as the clockworks chime.

A Hunter's Calling#026.src: The very center... the place deemed closest to your home. There, in the center of Wynn... You shall find the end.

A Marauder's Dues#001.src: ...ugh. Disgusting. Utterly disgusting. I've had just about enough of your kind here. Humans...
A Marauder's Dues#001.speaker: Norsten

A Marauder's Dues#002.src: Dreadfully drab, always getting in the way, wriggling through our province like worms! You're no heroes, you're pretenders!!
A Marauder's Dues#002.speaker: Norsten

A Marauder's Dues#003.src: Oh, you want through here? Well, I'm the gatekeeper. Let's call my toll...the abandonment of your ridiculous little heroics...and all your money besides. Sound fair?
A Marauder's Dues#003.speaker: Norsten

A Marauder's Dues#004.src: Aha, Norsten my boy! We've been worried sick, it's been a week. What is it you're doing so far out into the canyon?
A Marauder's Dues#004.speaker: Peli

A Marauder's Dues#005.src: Wha- Who are you, and who gave you permission to use my toll road?! And can't you see I'm busy?
A Marauder's Dues#005.speaker: Norsten

A Marauder's Dues#006.src: Norsten?? Don't you recognize your own grandfather? What's that strange look in your eyes, and what's this about a toll road?
A Marauder's Dues#006.speaker: Peli

A Marauder's Dues#007.src: You're nothing to me at your age. I only care about what the young can do for me...and about the fee you're neglecting, you shriveled old fruit!
A Marauder's Dues#007.speaker: Norsten

A Marauder's Dues#008.src: What's gotten into you? Such a polite man, acting this way to your elders... Human, have you any idea what's-
A Marauder's Dues#008.speaker: Peli

A Marauder's Dues#009.src: ...oh no. Oh, say it isn't so, is that what's happening? Is it HIS fault?
A Marauder's Dues#009.speaker: Peli

A Marauder's Dues#010.src: Up there, on the cliff- that tower! The scourge of the canyon...has he truly returned? Has he...taken my grandson?!
A Marauder's Dues#010.speaker: Peli

A Marauder's Dues#012.src: My reputation, even after all this time, still precedes me!! Indeed, old man, I have taken your grandson as my puppet!
A Marauder's Dues#012.speaker: Norsten

A Marauder's Dues#013.src: What should I care about the facade? For a hundred and fifty years I've stolen the vitality of others to maintain my beauty, and your grandson will be no different.
A Marauder's Dues#013.speaker: Norsten

A Marauder's Dues#014.src: Miserable dastard!! Cold-water eel!! Human, you must help, you MUST! I beg you, please, seek the sorcerer and save my poor Norsten!!
A Marauder's Dues#014.speaker: Peli

A Marauder's Dues#015.src: The southwest mountains have a shortcut past the bandits, time is of the essence!
A Marauder's Dues#015.speaker: Peli

A Marauder's Dues#016.src: A veritable army fell before my magic! The bandits pay their tribute to my grace and obey my orders! You're as mad as I am called if you think one human can get through.
A Marauder's Dues#016.speaker: Norsten

A Marauder's Dues#017.src: I'll leave you a corpse, a husk! A withered pile of dust- or perhaps I'll take YOU as a slave too, human! So what will it be? Run...or face me?
A Marauder's Dues#017.speaker: Norsten

A Marauder's Dues#018.src: Go up the path to the wizard's tower, at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

A Marauder's Dues#019.src: Hoho... The worm comes wriggling in, it seems. What a horrid thing you are. Mismatched armor, courage of a fool all over your face... Inelegant and UGLY!!

A Marauder's Dues#020.src: At least the last ones to face me had some coordination, and the sense to hide themselves. Come further and you'll share their fate!!

A Marauder's Dues#021.src: ..rrgh! The tunnels! Once again, humans try so hard to spoil my fun... But do you really think you've evaded me?

A Marauder's Dues#022.src: You can never understand. The beauty of one like myself cannot be transient, it must be everlasting! I will never succumb to my mortality!

A Marauder's Dues#023.src: As a matter of fact...you humans ARE good for one thing. Drab as you are, you're lively. So consider this an honor!

A Marauder's Dues#024.src: HAAAAAhahahaha!! Instead of destruction, I'll leave you trapped in this illusion, and chip away at your ugly mind until nothing remains. You'll join the rest who've prolonged my life!

A Marauder's Dues#026.src: I'll take pleasure in peeling away your most formative memories first- W-wait, what's this giant blank spot? It's interfering with my spell...!!

A Marauder's Dues#027.src: Ugh, barely any memories to remove, hardly any personality... How much of a dull gray slate are you...and how is that making this more difficult?!

A Marauder's Dues#028.src: Run away and confront the wizard.

A Marauder's Dues#029.src: You escaped?! ...hmph. I suppose that trick works better for blinding a platoon than a person. When you only need to focus on what YOU see...rrgh.

A Marauder's Dues#030.src: Fine...you've forced my hand. I must sweep you aside, you so-called hero! Never darken my door again! Cease to exist!!

A Marauder's Dues#032.src: Ugh, what was it that raisin of a man said- Miserable runt?! Cold-water eel?! More fitting names for you than me!!
A Marauder's Dues#032.speaker: Dramele

A Marauder's Dues#033.src: ...fine. The defenses of my tower were absolute enough that I never needed to defend myself inside. I should have taken you more seriously from the start.
A Marauder's Dues#033.speaker: Dramele

A Marauder's Dues#034.src: It's been so long since I've faced a threat, and now that you're here- RRGH! How could a HUMAN get the best of me?
A Marauder's Dues#034.speaker: Dramele

A Marauder's Dues#035.src: Me, who holds control over every bandit in the canyon...! How dare you embarrass me so!
A Marauder's Dues#035.speaker: Dramele

A Marauder's Dues#036.src: Well, fine. You've got me dead to rights. I'll give up the blasted binding gem. Who knows if most of the bandits will return to normal, after so long...
A Marauder's Dues#036.speaker: Dramele

A Marauder's Dues#037.src: ...but Norsten? He'll barely be affected. Bring it to him and he'll be freed, loath as I am to let him go.
A Marauder's Dues#037.speaker: Dramele

A Marauder's Dues#039.src: HA! I still get the last laugh! Even at my most vulnerable I have gracefully outwitted you! As if I would really surrender to a human.
A Marauder's Dues#039.speaker: Dramele

A Marauder's Dues#040.src: Those souls are mine to control, you hear me? Mine to bind!! Mine to drain dry of vitality!! Mine to OWN!! HehehaHAAAAA!!
A Marauder's Dues#040.speaker: Dramele

A Marauder's Dues#041.src: And if you jump in after it? You'll be truly trapped- a dimension of my own making, filled with volatile magical waste! You'll never be seen again!
A Marauder's Dues#041.speaker: Dramele

A Marauder's Dues#043.src: Find a way out of the strange dimension.

A Marauder's Dues#044.src: Find a way out of the strange dimension.

A Marauder's Dues#046.src: H-how did you survive? How did you get OUT?! That pocket dimension has a one-way entrance!! I- You- I'LL DRAIN AWAY NORSTEN BEFORE YOUR VERY EYES!!
A Marauder's Dues#046.speaker: Norsten

A Marauder's Dues#047.src: The scourge is angry!! Human, quickly, for him to be this upset you must have found something! Save my grandson, please!!
A Marauder's Dues#047.speaker: Peli

A Marauder's Dues#048.src: I'LL FLING YOU TO THE ENDS OF THE CANYON!! FILTHY HUMAN, LOWLY WORM NOT FIT TO BE DUST-
A Marauder's Dues#048.speaker: Norsten

A Marauder's Dues#049.src: Aguh...w-where am I? My...my throat hurts...was I screaming?
A Marauder's Dues#049.speaker: Norsten

A Marauder's Dues#050.src: Oh, my poor grandson...my little Norsten is back to us! Oh, joyous day!!
A Marauder's Dues#050.speaker: Peli

A Marauder's Dues#051.src: Back to...did something happen? I remember coming this way after a thief...and then...
A Marauder's Dues#051.speaker: Norsten

A Marauder's Dues#052.src: That terrible wizard captured you in his spell when you did. It was terrible, it was- Such a hard look you had in your eyes...
A Marauder's Dues#052.speaker: Peli

A Marauder's Dues#053.src: But this human, this hero... They have bested the scourge of the canyon! They managed to save you from such evil!
A Marauder's Dues#053.speaker: Peli

A Marauder's Dues#054.src: ...I barely remember anything. Just...feelings of anger, and...disgust, I suppose, but... You wouldn't lie to me Grand-Peli.
A Marauder's Dues#054.speaker: Norsten

A Marauder's Dues#055.src: Thank you, human- Hm? What's all this money doing in my pockets? I didn't bring my pouch out with me to chase the thief, but...! So much money!
A Marauder's Dues#055.speaker: Norsten

A Marauder's Dues#056.src: Ill-gotten gains from the scourge's sham of a toll-road scheme, no doubt. I think that human could put that money to fine use, what say you, my boy?
A Marauder's Dues#056.speaker: Peli

A Marauder's Dues#057.src: Of course! Here. And don't worry about the gate. It's supposed to be open for anyone, so use it as you like.
A Marauder's Dues#057.speaker: Norsten

A Sandy Scandal#000.src: Talk to the {p} Bank Guard at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

A Sandy Scandal#001.src: You look like a hardy one! {p} army is it? Would you be willing to help {p} a bit?
A Sandy Scandal#001.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#002.src: {p} bank tends to be a prime target for bandits, and there's been a string of incidents that have made us suspicious.
A Sandy Scandal#002.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#003.src: We're looking into some witness reports to try and gain information on the bandits' plan.
A Sandy Scandal#003.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#004.src: If I give you some of the reports, will you help check them out for clues?
A Sandy Scandal#004.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#005.src: Great! The store from the first witness report is straight down the stairs, just past this building right behind me.
A Sandy Scandal#005.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#006.src: It's called "Gibbs' Mining Supply Store", and the owner reported a robbery a few days ago.
A Sandy Scandal#006.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#007.src: Good luck! Report back to me if you find any information.
A Sandy Scandal#007.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#008.src: Go to the witness report location at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

A Sandy Scandal#009.src: Hello gentlemen! What can I interest you in today? Some industrial torches? Pickaxes?
A Sandy Scandal#009.speaker: Shopkeeper Gibbs

A Sandy Scandal#010.src: Shut yer’ trap, old man. We came for a different kind of business.
A Sandy Scandal#010.speaker: Bandit

A Sandy Scandal#011.src: Wha-? Look, fellows. Just step out of my store, and nobody gets hurt. I don't want any trouble.
A Sandy Scandal#011.speaker: Shopkeeper Gibbs

A Sandy Scandal#012.src: Listen up old man, tell us the code to the TNT vault in the basement, or I decorate my necklace with your fingers!
A Sandy Scandal#012.speaker: Bandit

A Sandy Scandal#013.src: Certainly not! That TNT is for licensed mining companies only, not your average amateur miner.
A Sandy Scandal#013.speaker: Shopkeeper Gibbs

A Sandy Scandal#014.src: Well then! I guess you'll still be able to grasp a pick with four fingers, eh?
A Sandy Scandal#014.speaker: Bandit

A Sandy Scandal#015.src: Gaaah! Alright, alright! No more violence, please!
A Sandy Scandal#015.speaker: Shopkeeper Gibbs

A Sandy Scandal#016.src: The code is {~}-{~}-{~}-{~}... please don't hurt me!
A Sandy Scandal#016.speaker: Shopkeeper Gibbs

A Sandy Scandal#017.src: {~}-{~}-{~}-{~}... thanks! We won't be needing you anymore... now go to sleep!
A Sandy Scandal#017.speaker: Bandit

A Sandy Scandal#018.src: Open the vault in the basement [Code: {~}].

A Sandy Scandal#021.src: Talk to the {p} Bank Guard at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

A Sandy Scandal#022.src: Ah, you're back! Did you find anything interesting in the report?
A Sandy Scandal#022.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#023.src: Missing TNT in the shop's vault? Looks like the shopkeeper was telling the truth.
A Sandy Scandal#023.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#024.src: We need to catch these criminals quickly if they have access to that amount of TNT - they could blow a hole right into the bank's vault!
A Sandy Scandal#024.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#025.src: You should check out another witness report, from after the attack on the shopkeeper.
A Sandy Scandal#025.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#026.src: It was taken from the rooftop garden of the Scroll Merchant's residence, you should take a look.
A Sandy Scandal#026.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#027.src: Be quick! We don't have much time if we want to stop these bandits.
A Sandy Scandal#027.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#028.src: Go to the witness report location at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

A Sandy Scandal#030.src: Ey', what do you two blighters think you're doing with those dangerous explosives in the city?
A Sandy Scandal#030.speaker: Scroll Merchant

A Sandy Scandal#031.src: Guards! Guards! Robber! Come quick! Urgently!
A Sandy Scandal#031.speaker: Scroll Merchant

A Sandy Scandal#033.src: Find the source of the detonation at [{~}, {~}, {~}].

A Sandy Scandal#035.src: Talk to the {p} Bank Guard at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

A Sandy Scandal#036.src: Were you able to uncover any new information regarding the status of the criminals?
A Sandy Scandal#036.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#037.src: Ah... that's troubling. The criminals plundered two very powerful weapons.
A Sandy Scandal#037.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#038.src: It won't be easy facing those criminals if they decide to raid the bank with those weapons.
A Sandy Scandal#038.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#039.src: I'm not certain how to proceed from here, we didn't receive any more witness reports, and-
A Sandy Scandal#039.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#040.src: Boss, I just received urgent reports of a robbery underway in the left residential area of {p}!
A Sandy Scandal#040.speaker: Almuj Sentry

A Sandy Scandal#041.src: Oh my… you! Soldier! Quick! The robbery is taking place across the bridge, next to the first house you visited today! It may be the bandits we're looking for.
A Sandy Scandal#041.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#042.src: There will be somebody waiting for you outside of the house once you get to the residential area!
A Sandy Scandal#042.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#043.src: If you still can't find it, I've written the coordinates in your content book. Now quickly, get to the house!
A Sandy Scandal#043.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#044.src: Quickly! Go to the house at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

A Sandy Scandal#045.src: Hello? Are you with the guards? Good! Hurry! Some bandits just ransacked my house, and left with lots of emeralds!
A Sandy Scandal#045.speaker: Almuj Citizen

A Sandy Scandal#046.src: Follow me to my house, hopefully you can find the bandits! They stole lots of my precious gems!
A Sandy Scandal#046.speaker: Almuj Citizen

A Sandy Scandal#047.src: Look for signs of the bandits' whereabouts.

A Sandy Scandal#049.src: Ready, boys? We've got the TNT, weapons, and the fastest horses those emeralds could buy. Now we just-
A Sandy Scandal#049.speaker: Bandit Leader

A Sandy Scandal#050.src: Ahah. I had a feeling we had a guard on our tail.
A Sandy Scandal#050.speaker: Bandit Leader

A Sandy Scandal#051.src: No point wasting these brand-new weapons on you... since we're blowing up this hideout anyway!
A Sandy Scandal#051.speaker: Bandit Leader

A Sandy Scandal#052.src: This whole thing'll go up in a few seconds, and any evidence will be buried in the sand. Good luck getting out of here!
A Sandy Scandal#052.speaker: Bandit Leader

A Sandy Scandal#054.src: Find where the bandits blasted a hole to get into the bank at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

A Sandy Scandal#055.src: It’s too late to stop us now! We’re already about to bust out of here with the grand prize - the contents of the emerald vault!
A Sandy Scandal#055.speaker: Bandit Leader

A Sandy Scandal#056.src: Follow the criminals into the other room.

A Sandy Scandal#057.src: Look here, the soldier decided they wanted to follow us. Dumb move.
A Sandy Scandal#057.speaker: Bandit Leader

A Sandy Scandal#058.src: I guess we can kill two birds with one stone: escaping the bank, and killing this pest.
A Sandy Scandal#058.speaker: Bandit Leader

A Sandy Scandal#061.src: Report back to the {p} Bank Guard at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

A Sandy Scandal#062.src: Soldier! Where did you disappear to? Did you hear those explosions, below the bank?
A Sandy Scandal#062.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#063.src: We think those bandits might have made their first move in the heist, we're mobilising a troop to-
A Sandy Scandal#063.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#064.src: You've already stopped them? And reclaimed the stolen weapons and explosives..?
A Sandy Scandal#064.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#065.src: Wow. Excellent work, soldier. {p} is in your debt. Please accept these from our vault, as a token of our thanks.
A Sandy Scandal#065.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

Arachnids' Ascent#000.src: Talk to Admiral Aegis in the {p} Barracks at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Arachnids' Ascent#001.src: Let's see... ah, ! There you are. I was just about to send someone to fetch you.
Arachnids' Ascent#001.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Arachnids' Ascent#002.src: Follow me- we have a conversation to have in my office. It's on the top floor of the barracks.
Arachnids' Ascent#002.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Arachnids' Ascent#003.src: ...ahem. Now that we're here, we can discuss the matter of {p}.
Arachnids' Ascent#003.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Arachnids' Ascent#004.src: Our preparations are complete, and it's time for the assault on Nivla's spider den! With you here, we'll just need to wait for-...
Arachnids' Ascent#004.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Arachnids' Ascent#005.src: Admiral- we're here! Sorry we're late, we were sparring in the training room and lost track of time...
Arachnids' Ascent#005.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#006.src: If is here, I take it that means today is the day we strike at the spiders?
Arachnids' Ascent#006.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#007.src: Indeed it is. Now, you three are to be the force which will fight through their den and clear out as many of those spiders as you can. For that, you'll need support.
Arachnids' Ascent#007.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Arachnids' Ascent#008.src: We've sent out several soldiers ahead of time to make preparations on site. You'll want to first speak to Private Cob on the {p}, who will have supplies for you.
Arachnids' Ascent#008.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Arachnids' Ascent#009.src: I expect this mission will hold some danger, but I trust the three of you will be able to deal with anything you come across. Good luck, soldiers!
Arachnids' Ascent#009.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Arachnids' Ascent#010.src: Yes, sir. We'll do our best.
Arachnids' Ascent#010.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#011.src: These spiders won't stand a chance! Let's get going.
Arachnids' Ascent#011.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#012.src: Speak to Private Cob in the Savannah at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] to receive supplies.

Arachnids' Ascent#013.src: 'ey there, chaps! You lot must be the spider killin' force, eh?
Arachnids' Ascent#013.speaker: Private Cob

Arachnids' Ascent#014.src: That's us! The Admiral told us you had supplies to give us?
Arachnids' Ascent#014.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#015.src: That I do! Now, 'fore I send ya off, there's been sum news from the Cap'n!
Arachnids' Ascent#015.speaker: Private Cob

Arachnids' Ascent#016.src: Buncha terrorised citizens been found right next to the bloomin' den! Trapped in a sticky old web, they were.
Arachnids' Ascent#016.speaker: Private Cob

Arachnids' Ascent#017.src: Priority number one is gettin' them out, before takin' on the den. But nothin' can get through the web!
Arachnids' Ascent#017.speaker: Private Cob

Arachnids' Ascent#018.src: No fire, no magic... nothin' has broken through. The cap'n decided- 'ey, why not try some lava? 's hotter than fire, anyway.
Arachnids' Ascent#018.speaker: Private Cob

Arachnids' Ascent#019.src: Point is. Along with all your supplies 'n whatnot, ya've gotta bring along some lava for the cap'n. Magically contained, o' course!
Arachnids' Ascent#019.speaker: Private Cob

Arachnids' Ascent#020.src: Sure, that sounds easy enough. A bit of extra work, but we were heading in that direction anyway.
Arachnids' Ascent#020.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#021.src: That's the spirit! If ya want the best route to the den, follow that road with the burn marks. It'll send ya straight to the cap'n!
Arachnids' Ascent#021.speaker: Private Cob

Arachnids' Ascent#022.src: Bring the supplies to Captain Enduyn at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Arachnids' Ascent#023.src: At ease, soldiers! You're the three Aegis told me to look out for, aren't you? Have you spoken to Cob yet?
Arachnids' Ascent#023.speaker: Captain Enduyn

Arachnids' Ascent#024.src: We have, and we've brought supplies. As well as... lava, I think?
Arachnids' Ascent#024.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#025.src: Ah, good! You can see the pickle we're in, hmm? We've tried everything to get those poor souls out, but the damned web is like glue!
Arachnids' Ascent#025.speaker: Captain Enduyn

Arachnids' Ascent#026.src: Now, let's see here... If I cast a spell on it like this, then...
Arachnids' Ascent#026.speaker: Captain Enduyn

Arachnids' Ascent#028.src: So, what do we do now? You mentioned another option- what was that about? What about it made it difficult?
Arachnids' Ascent#028.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#029.src: Right. You may have noticed on your way here, but the nest is at the base of {p}, a dormant volcano.
Arachnids' Ascent#029.speaker: Captain Enduyn

Arachnids' Ascent#030.src: Legends speak of incredible magic granted by the mountain- that of protection, incinerating any who dare go against it.
Arachnids' Ascent#030.speaker: Captain Enduyn

Arachnids' Ascent#031.src: These are only stories, of course. It's very unlikely the mountain actually could grant such magic. However... there may be some truth in the legend.
Arachnids' Ascent#031.speaker: Captain Enduyn

Arachnids' Ascent#032.src: So what's the catch? You would have tried it first if it were that simple.
Arachnids' Ascent#032.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#033.src: The mountain is infested with spiders, even more so than {p}. Our few attempts at scouting it out have shown they're incredibly hostile towards intruders.
Arachnids' Ascent#033.speaker: Captain Enduyn

Arachnids' Ascent#034.src: As though they're protecting something, I assume?
Arachnids' Ascent#034.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#035.src: Indeed. So, here's the plan... If you enter the mountain, the spiders will quickly try to move inside to stop you. I'll need one of you to stay here with me to fight them off.
Arachnids' Ascent#035.speaker: Captain Enduyn

Arachnids' Ascent#036.src: So two of us take on the volcano, and two stay behind. Got it! , you should be part of the Mount Wynn group. But then, Tasim, which of us should go with them?
Arachnids' Ascent#036.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#037.src: Why don't we let decide? Which of us do you want to join you in the volcano?
Arachnids' Ascent#037.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#038.src: Alright! We'll handle the volcano then. Captain, Tasim, don't die out here!
Arachnids' Ascent#038.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#039.src: Alright. We'll fight through the spiders in the mountain, then. Captain, Aledar, good luck!
Arachnids' Ascent#039.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#040.src: Then take more time. But don't take too long- we don't want the spiders to realize we're planning something.
Arachnids' Ascent#040.speaker: Captain Enduyn

Arachnids' Ascent#041.src: Decide who to bring with you into Mount Wynn at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Arachnids' Ascent#042.src: So, who do you want to join you to fight through Mount Wynn?
Arachnids' Ascent#042.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#043.src: Alright! We'll handle the volcano then. Captain, Tasim, don't die out here!
Arachnids' Ascent#043.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#044.src: Alright. We'll fight through the spiders in the mountain, then. Captain, Aledar, good luck!
Arachnids' Ascent#044.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#045.src: Then take more time. But don't take too long- we don't want the spiders to realize we're planning something.
Arachnids' Ascent#045.speaker: Captain Enduyn

Arachnids' Ascent#046.src: Enter Mount Wynn and reach the summit through the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Arachnids' Ascent#047.src: ...Wow, it's hot in here! That makes sense, I guess, given what we're here for. Let's reach the top as quickly as we can.
Arachnids' Ascent#047.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#048.src: W-woah! You felt that too, right? What's going-
Arachnids' Ascent#048.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#049.src: We've got to run for it! Come on, jump!
Arachnids' Ascent#049.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#050.src: That... that was a close one. Phew! Can't believe we made it out in one piece. I think we're near the top, too.
Arachnids' Ascent#050.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#051.src: Well, here we are! ...The heat's gotten more intense up here. Come on, let's find out what we're looking for, before I over-
Arachnids' Ascent#051.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#054.src: Ack! We should have known it wouldn't be that easy. Alright, let's take down this spider and get what we came for!
Arachnids' Ascent#054.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#055.src: Well, there it is. We have what we need to burn through those webs!... I hope.
Arachnids' Ascent#055.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#056.src: The spider mentioned a queen... I guess that's what we'll be facing in their nest, then.
Arachnids' Ascent#056.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#057.src: Alright, let's get back to Tasim and the captain!
Arachnids' Ascent#057.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#058.src: ...I can hear the spiders already. We'll need to fight through them if we want to reach the top. Let's get going, we don't want to take too long.
Arachnids' Ascent#058.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#059.src: H-huh? That shaking, it's almost like-
Arachnids' Ascent#059.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#060.src: What are those spiders doing!? , come on, we need to move!
Arachnids' Ascent#060.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#061.src: ...That was closer than it should have been. The spiders must be real desperate to protect whatever it is they have up here, huh? Let's keep going.
Arachnids' Ascent#061.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#062.src: It was a tough climb, but we made it... It's, uh, very hot up here. So- what was it we were looking for-
Arachnids' Ascent#062.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#065.src: Of course it wouldn't be that easy... Alright, , let's do what we came here for. Let's claim that magic, and burn through the webs!
Arachnids' Ascent#065.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#066.src: I guess that's that taken care of. We'll be able to burn through that web and save the villagers!
Arachnids' Ascent#066.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#067.src: You heard the spider mention a queen, right? We'll probably have to defeat it in it's nest to stop the spiders, once and for all.
Arachnids' Ascent#067.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#068.src: We should probably get going back down the mountain. We don't want to keep Aledar and the Captain waiting.
Arachnids' Ascent#068.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#069.src: Return to Captain Enduyn with the flame at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Arachnids' Ascent#070.src: You've returned! I trust you found something that can help us pass through these webs?
Arachnids' Ascent#070.speaker: Captain Enduyn

Arachnids' Ascent#071.src: We did! We fought off a spider at the summit, and claimed a magical flame.
Arachnids' Ascent#071.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#072.src: Excellent! Now, give it here. Let's see if we can't get these villagers free... watch out, folks! It might get a little warm for a moment...
Arachnids' Ascent#072.speaker: Captain Enduyn

Arachnids' Ascent#073.src: Great work, soldiers. With these villagers out we can turn our focus to the main den.
Arachnids' Ascent#073.speaker: Captain Enduyn

Arachnids' Ascent#074.src: If you're prepared, I don't see any reason to hold back. Good luck in there, soldiers! Let's stop this spider blight once and for all.
Arachnids' Ascent#074.speaker: Captain Enduyn

Arachnids' Ascent#075.src: We'll do our best, Captain. Aledar, , let's head down to the den entrance.
Arachnids' Ascent#075.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#076.src: You've returned! I trust you found something that can help us pass through these webs?
Arachnids' Ascent#076.speaker: Captain Enduyn

Arachnids' Ascent#077.src: We did, yes. There was a powerful spider at the peak, which was making use of this magical flame.
Arachnids' Ascent#077.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#078.src: Excellent! Now, give it here. Let's see if we can't get these villagers free... watch out, folks! It might get a little warm for a moment...
Arachnids' Ascent#078.speaker: Captain Enduyn

Arachnids' Ascent#079.src: Great work, soldiers. With these villagers out we can turn our focus to the main den.
Arachnids' Ascent#079.speaker: Captain Enduyn

Arachnids' Ascent#080.src: If you're prepared, I don't see any reason to hold back. Good luck in there, soldiers! Let's stop this spider blight once and for all.
Arachnids' Ascent#080.speaker: Captain Enduyn

Arachnids' Ascent#081.src: We'll do our best, Captain. Aledar, , let's head down to the den entrance.
Arachnids' Ascent#081.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#082.src: H-hah! F-freedom! No m-more c-creepy crawlies... Just me a-and my... mushrooms.
Arachnids' Ascent#082.speaker: Yahya

Arachnids' Ascent#083.src: We did it! We killed the spider queen! {p} is safe from that threat now!
Arachnids' Ascent#083.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#084.src: We- we did! That was... intense. But we succeeded in the end!
Arachnids' Ascent#084.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#085.src: ...So, what now? We completed the mission, so we should report back to the Admiral, but... what's after that?
Arachnids' Ascent#085.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#086.src: I guess we'll have to figure that out. I know I still want to help defend the province, but beyond that... I don't know.
Arachnids' Ascent#086.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#087.src: ...Yeah, alright. Well, hey, let's all meet back at {p} and celebrate! We deserve it after that whole ordeal.
Arachnids' Ascent#087.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#088.src: That sounds good, yeah. , we'll rest up here a little, but we'll meet you back at the barracks soon.
Arachnids' Ascent#088.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#089.src: Well, here we are! Back at the barracks, after a successful mission. It feels a little... unreal, you know?
Arachnids' Ascent#089.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#090.src: I know what you mean. But, well, we did good! We managed to make the woods safer for the people living there.
Arachnids' Ascent#090.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#091.src: We did! And now, we celebrate! Here, let's all some {p} Whiskey for the occasion.
Arachnids' Ascent#091.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#092.src: So, what are you two planning to do next? I think I'll speak to the Admiral about finding an assignment somewhere.
Arachnids' Ascent#092.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#093.src: Hm. I've been thinking a little about... looking into more advanced powder techniques. Something about their magic sticks out to me.
Arachnids' Ascent#093.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#094.src: Oh, really? I thought you would be more into basic fighting, what with our journey to {p}.
Arachnids' Ascent#094.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#095.src: Yeah... well, I guess I found something a little more interesting along the way. I'll let you know how it all goes.
Arachnids' Ascent#095.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#096.src: Keep us updated, Aledar. So, , what are you thinking of doing next?
Arachnids' Ascent#096.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#097.src: Not a bad idea! I might join you with that later, once I've decided on things more.
Arachnids' Ascent#097.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#098.src: Helping people is a good goal. There's bound to be lots of people around who need it.
Arachnids' Ascent#098.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#099.src: Exploring, huh? That's a good idea. There's plenty to see around here!
Arachnids' Ascent#099.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#100.src: ...And- well, we all came here for a reason. Might as well see the province while we're here, right?
Arachnids' Ascent#100.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#101.src: Well, if you're staying in the area, maybe we'll cross paths! I'll likely be defending {p} in the short-term.
Arachnids' Ascent#101.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#102.src: And, well, I'll probably be in the area as well! There's plenty of experts in the area.
Arachnids' Ascent#102.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#103.src: Well, hey, there's no shame in that. There's lots to do around here. I'm sure you'll figure it out!
Arachnids' Ascent#103.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#104.src: If you need a goal, the next place you might want to visit is {p} {p}, to the north. Maybe pay it a visit when you reach level {~}.
Arachnids' Ascent#104.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#105.src: ...Well, I'm glad we're all able to be here together. Here's to a long and fulfilling friendship!
Arachnids' Ascent#105.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#106.src: I'll drink to that! To all our future adventures.
Arachnids' Ascent#106.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#107.src: ...Oh, ! Good to see you. Anything interesting going on with you?
Arachnids' Ascent#107.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#108.src: Me? Well, I've been making little progress... but, nothing too big yet. I'm keeping at it, though!
Arachnids' Ascent#108.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#109.src: Oh, hello . I'm probably not going to be here for long- I've been assigned to help defend {p} to the south.
Arachnids' Ascent#109.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#110.src: You should come visit, if you have the chance!
Arachnids' Ascent#110.speaker: Tasim

Canyon Condor#001.src: I am one of the Keepers in the great {p}. There we hoard secrets about the world.
Canyon Condor#001.speaker: Svin

Canyon Condor#002.src: I am here to investigate an old tale of the canyon. Does that interest you? I'm sure it does!
Canyon Condor#002.speaker: Svin

Canyon Condor#003.src: Legend has it that a ferocious beast lives among these cliffs. A dangerous bird that has survived for many years.
Canyon Condor#003.speaker: Svin

Canyon Condor#004.src: I would love to seek the beast out, but it seems the natives here are too busy thieving each other to inform me of it.
Canyon Condor#004.speaker: Svin

Canyon Condor#005.src: I have heard of an old prospector nearby who has ventured throughout this mesa. He may have some information.
Canyon Condor#005.speaker: Svin

Canyon Condor#006.src: His name is Jankan and he lives east from {p}. Could you perhaps seek him out and ask him about this foul beast?
Canyon Condor#006.speaker: Svin

Canyon Condor#007.src: If you help me, I'll let you use the elevators spread in the canyon. Well...
Canyon Condor#007.speaker: Svin

Canyon Condor#008.src: A strange hermit decided to take control of them, but I'm sure we can reason with him.
Canyon Condor#008.speaker: Svin

Canyon Condor#009.src: I hope you are able to find the beast, and if you do, could you bring me back [[Beast Egg|[{~} Beast Egg]]] as evidence?
Canyon Condor#009.speaker: Svin

Canyon Condor#010.src: Talk to Jankan east from {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Canyon Condor#011.src: Hello there, youngster! Ye must be the stranger folks 'been talkin' 'bout.
Canyon Condor#011.speaker: Jankan

Canyon Condor#012.src: If yer lookin fer gold, I can promise ye that there ain' any for you in this here mineshaft!
Canyon Condor#012.speaker: Jankan

Canyon Condor#013.src: Oh.. Yer lookin fer a winged wilder beast? Are ye out of yer mind?
Canyon Condor#013.speaker: Jankan

Canyon Condor#014.src: The devil of a bird is complete chaos! It can move mountains with a single screech! Men twice yer size 'ave weeped from the sight of it!
Canyon Condor#014.speaker: Jankan

Canyon Condor#015.src: As it turns out, I did me back in trying to transport me earnin's from that there cave, left them right at the back did' I.
Canyon Condor#015.speaker: Jankan

Canyon Condor#016.src: Go fetch me [[Gold Chunk| and I'll tell ye where ye need to go next.
Canyon Condor#016.speaker: Jankan

Canyon Condor#017.src: Collect [[Gold Chunk|[{~} Gold Chunks]]] for Jankan in the mineshaft at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Canyon Condor#018.src: Finally! It took ye long enough, hand it over! Oh right.. yer want'n somethin'.
Canyon Condor#018.speaker: Jankan

Canyon Condor#019.src: I ain' got any intention of help'n ye with yer demise, but I can send ye along to a young fellow who might help.
Canyon Condor#019.speaker: Jankan

Canyon Condor#020.src: There's this Hermit feller ye wanna talk to, he is a right nutter, that one. Feeds the bird'n all.
Canyon Condor#020.speaker: Jankan

Canyon Condor#021.src: I think ye can find him up the mountain and across the canyon abyss, he ain' a friendly fella, I can tell yer that much.
Canyon Condor#021.speaker: Jankan

Canyon Condor#022.src: Take the canyon elevator up to the Hermit at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Canyon Condor#023.src: What do you think you're doing here, kid? Think you can waltz in my humble abode and get across my bridge?
Canyon Condor#023.speaker: Hermit

Canyon Condor#024.src: Oh, you want to know about the bird of the mountain? Hah, a little weed like you wouldn't stand a chance against it.
Canyon Condor#024.speaker: Hermit

Canyon Condor#025.src: It doesn't take kindly to strangers you know. I once saw it turn a group of poachers to ash!
Canyon Condor#025.speaker: Hermit

Canyon Condor#026.src: If you want to go through here, you'll need to pay. Oh, I don't want your money, why would I need money, I have everything!
Canyon Condor#026.speaker: Hermit

Canyon Condor#027.src: If you want access to these plateaus then you will have to find me a rare flower for my little cave here.
Canyon Condor#027.speaker: Hermit

Canyon Condor#028.src: It is found on top of one of the stacks in the mesa, it shouldn't be too hard to find.
Canyon Condor#028.speaker: Hermit

Canyon Condor#029.src: Bring me [[Rare Rose|[{~} Rare Rose]]] and I shall let you pass on to the creature of the mesa.
Canyon Condor#029.speaker: Hermit

Canyon Condor#030.src: Find and collect [[Rare Rose|[{~} Rare Rose]]] at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] for the Hermit

Canyon Condor#031.src: A ha! This will do perfectly. My chickling will love it! I suppose you can cross the bridge now.
Canyon Condor#031.speaker: Hermit

Canyon Condor#032.src: The beast dwells on top of one of these plateaus. With a little searching, you should be able to find it.
Canyon Condor#032.speaker: Hermit

Canyon Condor#033.src: I'll let you use my elevators too. After all, it's not like you will last long...
Canyon Condor#033.speaker: Hermit

Canyon Condor#034.src: Only one traveler I have heard of could stand against the beast. I believe he took an egg from it for a pet, hah!
Canyon Condor#034.speaker: Hermit

Canyon Condor#035.src: He is long gone now, just like you will be in a few moments. It was nice not knowing you, kid.
Canyon Condor#035.speaker: Hermit

Canyon Condor#036.src: Defeat the Cockatrice at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] and collect an egg for Svin

Canyon Condor#037.src: Traveler! You have returned! Tell me, what have you learned?
Canyon Condor#037.speaker: Svin

Canyon Condor#038.src: You found it?! This is wonderful news! You collected an egg from it's nest as well? You are very brave indeed!
Canyon Condor#038.speaker: Svin

Canyon Condor#039.src: So the legend of the Cockatrice is true! You've seen it and battled it with your own courage!
Canyon Condor#039.speaker: Svin

Canyon Condor#040.src: If only you could enter the {p}, brave soul! But it would seem our paths are to part now.
Canyon Condor#040.speaker: Svin

Canyon Condor#041.src: Do not worry, I shall keep the egg safe. One day your legend shall be as greatly told!
Canyon Condor#041.speaker: Svin

Celebrations in Smoke#001.src: Enter the Festival of the Wicker at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Celebrations in Smoke#005.src: Follow the Festival Organizer into the house at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Celebrations in Smoke#006.src: Find evidence against the three suspects.

Celebrations in Smoke#007.src: Find someone who might know something about Arris's clan.

Celebrations in Smoke#008.src: Search the tallest tree in {p} for Arris's burnt medallion.

Celebrations in Smoke#010.src: Find someone who might be familiar with a green tea merchant.

Celebrations in Smoke#011.src: Search for a camp east of {p} [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] that Burick might have been spotted at.

Celebrations in Smoke#013.src: Find someone who might have been observant enough to see Cerisa sneak in.

Celebrations in Smoke#014.src: Search under the bridge around [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] for something Cerisa may have left behind.

Celebrations in Smoke#016.src: Return to the festival organizer at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] or look into the suspects a bit more.

Clearing the Camps#000.src: Talk to Captain Kymer outside {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Clearing the Camps#001.src: Find and kill Orc Chieftains Elisu, Veltu, and Ceifko in the camps around {p}- look for green flags

Clearing the Camps#002.src: Report back to Captain Kymer once you have the three heads.

Cluck Cluck#001.src: Hey, you aren't a chicken! Wait, you're a human! You can help me! Maybe you are the guy who helped my brother Yahya, but who knows, you humans all look the same to me.
Cluck Cluck#001.speaker: Nohno

Cluck Cluck#002.src: I really love my chickens, but there is one that I just cannot control...
Cluck Cluck#002.speaker: Nohno

Cluck Cluck#003.src: His name is Cluckles, he was given to me by a man named Bob before he went to war, but when Bob never came back, Cluckles got angry...
Cluck Cluck#003.speaker: Nohno

Cluck Cluck#004.src: He's really dangerous to keep on my lovely island, so I keep him in my basement...
Cluck Cluck#004.speaker: Nohno

Cluck Cluck#005.src: I want to take care of him, but my wife says it's too dangerous. Where's my wife you say? Oh, I think she's around here eating some grain.
Cluck Cluck#005.speaker: Nohno

Cluck Cluck#006.src: Anyway, I need you to go down there and... Take care of him for me. I would really appreciate it.
Cluck Cluck#006.speaker: Nohno

Cluck Cluck#007.src: Bring back [[Cluckles' Favourite Feather|[{~} Cluckles' Favourite Feather]]] to Nohno.

Cluck Cluck#008.src: What is this?! His feather? What did you do to Cluckles?! I wanted you to take care of him, not kill him!
Cluck Cluck#008.speaker: Nohno

Cluck Cluck#009.src: You monster! Leave this place now, and keep that feather to remind you of your hideous crime!
Cluck Cluck#009.speaker: Nohno

Cook Assistant#000.src: Talk to the Cook in {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Cook Assistant#001.src: I can't believe what is happening to me.
Cook Assistant#001.speaker: The Cook

Cook Assistant#002.src: The King ordered me to bake cakes for all those new recruits!
Cook Assistant#002.speaker: The Cook

Cook Assistant#003.src: Unfortunately, a Grook took my last cake, and I ran out of ingredients!
Cook Assistant#003.speaker: The Cook

Cook Assistant#005.src: That's the Grook! Go chase it down and get my cake back!
Cook Assistant#005.speaker: The Cook

Cook Assistant#007.src: The Grook got away! Return to the Cook at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to figure out what to do.

Cook Assistant#008.src: What are you doing? Go after the Grook...
Cook Assistant#008.speaker: The Cook

Cook Assistant#010.src: Well, I guess you are going to have to help me find the ingredients and bake another...
Cook Assistant#010.speaker: The Cook

Cook Assistant#011.src: There he is again! After him!
Cook Assistant#011.speaker: The Cook

Cook Assistant#012.src: Find out where the Grook flew up to at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Cook Assistant#013.src: Return to the cook at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]. Use a Scroll to get there faster.

Cook Assistant#015.src: I can't thank you enough! Here, take these emeralds and armour for all your trouble.
Cook Assistant#015.speaker: The Cook

Cook Assistant#016.src: You should explore around to become stronger. I hear there might be work to do in {p}.
Cook Assistant#016.speaker: The Cook

Corrupted Betrayal#001.src: Hey, soldier! Yeah, you! Got some spare time to lend a hand?
Corrupted Betrayal#001.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#002.src: We've got a major issue with this old fortress. It keeps spewing out all these damned slimes, and their proximity to {p} is causing issues.
Corrupted Betrayal#002.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#003.src: Soldiers are spending half their guard duty slicing the critters into sludge. Ideally we'd raid the cave, cut out the source, but...
Corrupted Betrayal#003.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#004.src: This place has some history. Nasty stuff. I'd prefer not to head in blind, so I've been checking for any clues to what we might find inside.
Corrupted Betrayal#004.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#005.src: Haven't found much... except this verse, 'scribed into the wall over there. Go on, check it out and let me know what you think.
Corrupted Betrayal#005.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#006.src: Nonsense, if you ask me. Most likely kids from {p} messing about. But we haven't found anything else, so... if you've got any time, fancy checking it out for me?
Corrupted Betrayal#006.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#007.src: The first line is obviously talking about the Great Bridge, but I've no clue what the rest means. Head over there, take a look around, and tell me if you find anything interesting.
Corrupted Betrayal#007.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#008.src: Found anything interesting around the riddle yet? Do you need to hear it again?
Corrupted Betrayal#008.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#009.src: Near a corrupted bridge, a ruin past its prime..
Corrupted Betrayal#009.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#010.src: Lives a cursed sheep, with the color of lime...
Corrupted Betrayal#010.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#011.src: Lead it down the trail, headed to the slime...
Corrupted Betrayal#011.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#012.src: Sacrifice its soul, in the blood and the grime.
Corrupted Betrayal#012.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#013.src: The first line is obviously talking about the Great Bridge, but I've no clue what the rest means. Head over there, take a look around, and tell me if you find anything interesting.
Corrupted Betrayal#013.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#014.src: Alrighty. Let me know what when you've got something then.
Corrupted Betrayal#014.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#015.src: Use the Mage's riddle to figure out where it leads

Corrupted Betrayal#016.src: If you are heading towards the Great Bridge, be cautious in the plains around the jungle entrance.
Corrupted Betrayal#016.speaker: Troms Guard

Corrupted Betrayal#017.src: I have received reports of a strange cursed sheep taking refuge in one of the more fortified ruins around there.
Corrupted Betrayal#017.speaker: Troms Guard

Corrupted Betrayal#018.src: As far as I know, it is trapped in the ruins by some jungle growth, though if it was cut down it might escape...
Corrupted Betrayal#018.speaker: Troms Guard

Corrupted Betrayal#019.src: Explore the temple for a way to break the barrier.

Corrupted Betrayal#020.src: Go to Slykaar's residence at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to find out what is hidden there.

Corrupted Betrayal#021.src: By order of the city of {p}, I am here to keep other citizens from entering this house.
Corrupted Betrayal#021.speaker: Troms Guard

Corrupted Betrayal#022.src: From past experiences, everyone who has entered this house has vanished from existence...
Corrupted Betrayal#022.speaker: Troms Guard

Corrupted Betrayal#023.src: I would advise not going inside unless you know what you are doing.
Corrupted Betrayal#023.speaker: Troms Guard

Corrupted Betrayal#024.src: Well, I guess you must know who I am.

Corrupted Betrayal#025.src: Welcome to my domain. I am the hero of {p}, Slykaar.

Corrupted Betrayal#026.src: Well, I used to be. Banished by the very people who asked for my help. Pathetic.
Corrupted Betrayal#026.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#027.src: They couldn't give me a few peasants for their safety? Weak.
Corrupted Betrayal#027.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#029.src: I experimented my shamanism for many years underground to create the perfect mix of monster.
Corrupted Betrayal#029.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#030.src: Most ended in horrific slimes. Aggressive and powerful, but alas, just slimes.
Corrupted Betrayal#030.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#031.src: Then I found this place. A dark land. A dark god. A source of power.
Corrupted Betrayal#031.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#032.src: You mediocre wielders of magic have no idea what this world holds.
Corrupted Betrayal#032.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#033.src: You all strive to be that hero of heroes, “Bob”, but here's the truth. He's lost. You're lost.
Corrupted Betrayal#033.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#034.src: No one in the Wynn province is willing to make the sacrifices I am to gain power.
Corrupted Betrayal#034.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#035.src: If you want power, you have to give some. Sacrifice a few to save many.
Corrupted Betrayal#035.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#036.src: They were willing to give me a few peasants in {~}, when the hordes crossed the bridge.
Corrupted Betrayal#036.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#037.src: The king was happy to throw away lives to save his. But then the hero of Wynn waltzed in a few years later.
Corrupted Betrayal#037.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#038.src: They banished me like a rotten fruit. Their hero, their protector. So what if a few hundred nobodies died for it.
Corrupted Betrayal#038.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#039.src: Looks like we have a Bob aspirer. Pale imitation.
Corrupted Betrayal#039.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#040.src: So. Feel free to visit me down below, bring the entire might of the {p} army upon me. It will not be enough.
Corrupted Betrayal#040.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#041.src: I am ready. Soon, {p} will be in ruins. And I shall have my revenge.
Corrupted Betrayal#041.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#042.src: Go have fun in while you can. It's not like you have much of a life to live, anyways.
Corrupted Betrayal#042.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#043.src: Report back to Lanu about what you've learned.

Corrupted Betrayal#044.src: Ah, you're back. Find anything interesting? I've just been knocking back the occasional slime that pops up out of this cave.
Corrupted Betrayal#044.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#045.src: You... saw Slykaar? In another dimension?!
Corrupted Betrayal#045.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#046.src: This is bad. If he can materialise outside of this cave, even psychoactively... he's getting stronger. It explains the slimes, the attacks on {p}...
Corrupted Betrayal#046.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#047.src: He's an incredibly powerful shaman, . He has to be stopped, but it would take forever for {p} to mobile a force against him.
Corrupted Betrayal#047.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#048.src: If you can, you should head in there and... finish him off. Gear up first, though, and find some friends watch your back.
Corrupted Betrayal#048.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#049.src: , how's it going? Run into another shaman hallucination at all?
Corrupted Betrayal#049.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#050.src: Anyway, good luck in the cave. If you choose to go in, be careful.
Corrupted Betrayal#050.speaker: Lanu

Cowfusion#002.src: Find a way into the Laboratory

Cowfusion#003.src: Search the Laboratory for the missing cows

Cowfusion#004.src: Find a way to free the Cows.

Cowfusion#009.src: Find and enter the Secret Cow Hideout

Cowfusion#011.src: Find the one who's in charge of the hideout

Creeper Infiltration#001.src: Anyone! Can anyone- oh, hello. You look strong enough to help me.
Creeper Infiltration#001.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#002.src: I am Thomas, and I help manage the supplies for a village in the Pigman Ravine. Though, I have a bit of a problem...
Creeper Infiltration#002.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#003.src: We're running low on ravine grains, which is our main staple we use for our food.
Creeper Infiltration#003.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#004.src: We usually get it ourselves but recently an angry group of pigmen took over the tunnel to the top of the ravine, where the grain grows.
Creeper Infiltration#004.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#005.src: The last time we entered, I heard an explosion from the top. I fear the pigmen are blowing up our grain supply with TNT...
Creeper Infiltration#005.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#006.src: I came here to {p} to see if I could find help here, but I've had no luck. Until now, that is. Would you be willing to help?
Creeper Infiltration#006.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#007.src: You would? You're a life saver. I'll meet you at the village, just follow the path out of town and take the northern-most entrance to the ravines.
Creeper Infiltration#007.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#008.src: Once you get there, keep to the right wall of the ravine and climb up the stairs to reach the entrance. Also, be careful in the tunnel, as the pigmen throw rocks as a weapon.
Creeper Infiltration#008.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#009.src: Oh, finally, someone has come to this hidden village!
Creeper Infiltration#009.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#010.src: I am Thomas, and I help manage the supplies for this ravine village. Though, I have a bit of a problem...
Creeper Infiltration#010.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#011.src: We're running low on ravine grains, which is our main staple we use for our food.
Creeper Infiltration#011.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#012.src: We usually get it ourselves but recently an angry group of pigmen took over the tunnel to the top of the ravine, where the grain grows.
Creeper Infiltration#012.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#013.src: The last time we entered, I heard an explosion from the top. I fear the pigmen are blowing up our grain supply with TNT...
Creeper Infiltration#013.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#014.src: You appear to be much stronger than I am, so maybe you could get past the tunnel pigmen and eliminate the explosions at the top.
Creeper Infiltration#014.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#015.src: Just keep to the right wall of the ravine and climb up the stairs to reach the entrance. Also, be careful in the tunnel, as the pigmen throw rocks as a weapon.
Creeper Infiltration#015.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#016.src: Enter the tunnel at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and reach the top of the ravine

Creeper Infiltration#017.src: Bring back the [[Creeper Skin|[Creeper Skin]]] to Thomas at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Creeper Infiltration#018.src: I didn't expect you to fall out of the sky like that. Are you okay, or should I go get the potion merchant to heal you?
Creeper Infiltration#018.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#019.src: You're fine? Oh, good to hear. Did you manage to get rid of the pigmen and their explosives?
Creeper Infiltration#019.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#020.src: A green creature? A "creeper"? No such thing exists in this world, especially with the pigmen all around!
Creeper Infiltration#020.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#021.src: Oh, you brought a piece of skin back. How odd, I've seen this skin before...
Creeper Infiltration#021.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#022.src: There's a large cave over to the south. I tried to enter it, but I got ambushed by green creatures...
Creeper Infiltration#022.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#023.src: I thought I was just dreaming, but these "creepers" you talk about...they might live in that cave.
Creeper Infiltration#023.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#024.src: I have an idea. I need to know for sure that they live there. A merchant can make you a mask with the skin and another material.
Creeper Infiltration#024.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#025.src: There's a Pigman Overlord that sometimes hangs in a cave nearby. If you can kill it, you can get a pigman hide strong enough to make the mask.
Creeper Infiltration#025.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#026.src: If you continue on the western path past the tunnel entrance, you should find a camp where the Overlord is located.
Creeper Infiltration#026.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#027.src: Go get the pigman hide, and then come back to me so I can tell you what to do next.
Creeper Infiltration#027.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#028.src: Retrieve [[Pigman Hide|[{~} Pigman Hide]]] from the Pigman Overlord near [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and return to Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#029.src: I see you have the hide. This skin will work perfectly for my plan.
Creeper Infiltration#029.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#030.src: There is a Mask Merchant in this village. He can make you a mask with the two materials I have.
Creeper Infiltration#030.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#031.src: With the mask, you can put it on and go undetected into the cave with these "creepers". Only then will we know the truth.
Creeper Infiltration#031.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#032.src: To get to the creeper cave, follow the western path and turn left at the pigman camps.
Creeper Infiltration#032.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#033.src: Also, if you somehow lose the mask, the merchant can make you another one if you bring him another piece of skin and hide.
Creeper Infiltration#033.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#034.src: Here are the materials. Be careful out there. Who knows what those green monsters could do to you...
Creeper Infiltration#034.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#035.src: Buy the creeper mask from the merchant and enter the creeper hideout at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Creeper Infiltration#036.src: Bring Thomas [[Creeper Powder|[{~} Creeper Powder]]] to prove him creepers exist in Wynn at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Creeper Infiltration#037.src: So, what was in the cave? Were there really creepers in there?
Creeper Infiltration#037.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#038.src: What's this? It smells like gunpowder...but more earthy. And this came from the cave?
Creeper Infiltration#038.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#039.src: This powder is definitely not native to this area. It has to have come from those creepers.
Creeper Infiltration#039.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#040.src: I guess for now we'll leave them at peace. If they do exist, they don't need to be hunted down to extinction.
Creeper Infiltration#040.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#041.src: Besides, if they are composed of gunpowder, they could easily blow this ravine to pieces.
Creeper Infiltration#041.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#042.src: Thank you for your help. I guess you deserve some sort of reward, considering you helped solve the ravine's big mystery.
Creeper Infiltration#042.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#043.src: Feel free to come back to our village any time. By then our food supply should be stable.
Creeper Infiltration#043.speaker: Thomas

Crop Failure#002.src: Find Doubiss the salesman in {p} near the bank at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Deja Vu#001.src: Well well well, look who decided to come back with their tail between their legs.
Deja Vu#001.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#002.src: Two weeks now and you still haven't found it? Ugh, I can't believe I ever trusted you with such a simple task.
Deja Vu#002.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#003.src: Who am I? WHAT DO YOU MEAN WHO AM I? You offered to help find my shovel, and I've been waiting two weeks!
Deja Vu#003.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#004.src: Forget about your payment. Unless you either pay me back or get my shovel right now!
Deja Vu#004.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#005.src: My shovel? That's why I sent you out in the first place! It's somewhere in {p}. I lost it while following a trail of flowers.
Deja Vu#005.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#006.src: I think it was south west of the large ruined gate. Now go get it!
Deja Vu#006.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#009.src: Well hello there, stranger! Welcome to {p}! Always nice to see a new face around here.
Deja Vu#009.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#010.src: Mad at you? Why would I be mad at you? We've never met.
Deja Vu#010.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#011.src: I know this a bit forward, but I need to ask for your help with-
Deja Vu#011.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#012.src: Wait, is that-? It is! You've found my shovel! I recognize those markings anywhere.
Deja Vu#012.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#013.src: But why is it so rusty? Ah, no matter. Give that to me and I'll head inside to get you a nice reward.
Deja Vu#013.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#014.src: Thank you. Now, about that reward-
Deja Vu#014.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#016.src: Oh dear, there he goes again. Poor fool ignored my warnings and touched that shovel.
Deja Vu#016.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#017.src: He's gone and got himself stuck in a loop.
Deja Vu#017.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#018.src: Head inside, soldier, and I'll explain what's happening here.
Deja Vu#018.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#020.src: Without Asher, his house has vanished from time.
Deja Vu#020.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#022.src: Let me explain why Asher disappeared...
Deja Vu#022.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#023.src: {p} was built many years ago by a long-lost civilization.
Deja Vu#023.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#024.src: They had odd powers. They ended up distorting time itself.
Deja Vu#024.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#025.src: The tools they used to make these structures are imbued with their power.
Deja Vu#025.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#026.src: Asher found one of these tools: the shovel.
Deja Vu#026.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#027.src: The shovel is tethering its time of influence to today. It keeps sending Asher back.
Deja Vu#027.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#028.src: The issue is, Asher died in the past. This creates a paradox.
Deja Vu#028.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#029.src: We can save him if I send you back to prevent his death. Go through this rift to join him in the past.
Deja Vu#029.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#030.src: Find a way to save Asher from his death.

Deja Vu#032.src: Usually this place is filled with workers.
Deja Vu#032.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#033.src: But no one's here. And this place is clearly not done.
Deja Vu#033.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#034.src: Whatever the case, I should probably find my shovel.
Deja Vu#034.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#035.src: If I were a shovel, where would I be?
Deja Vu#035.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#037.src: This place... There's so much going on but no one here.
Deja Vu#037.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#038.src: What I don't understand, though, is why this place looks brand new.
Deja Vu#038.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#039.src: This place looks like it's just being built!
Deja Vu#039.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#040.src: This must be something to do with the valley's magic. Wouldn't be the first time.
Deja Vu#040.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#042.src: In fact, whenever I hold that shovel, this kind of stuff seems to happen.
Deja Vu#042.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#043.src: Maybe it's sent me way back. Back to the construction of this place.
Deja Vu#043.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#044.src: Then why is no one here?
Deja Vu#044.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#045.src: Woah, that tree looks like it might fall over!
Deja Vu#045.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#047.src: Uhf! How do they have a cannon? These guys must be super advanced.
Deja Vu#047.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#048.src: I think I'm close now. I can just feel that shovel close by.
Deja Vu#048.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#050.src: My my, a crushing defeat to be sure. You'll have to find a way to stop that.
Deja Vu#050.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#051.src: Go back through the rift and make sure Asher doesn't become a pancake this time.
Deja Vu#051.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#053.src: Well that was quite the explosive end to our friend there. There must be a way to prevent that.
Deja Vu#053.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#054.src: Head back in there. This time with less explosions.
Deja Vu#054.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#055.src: Oh, so close on that try. Who could've guessed that was how our friend met his end?
Deja Vu#055.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#056.src: I'm sure you'll nail it this time. Not sure how you will stop a cosmic event, though.
Deja Vu#056.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#057.src: Oh there it is! My shovel!
Deja Vu#057.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#058.src: I'm surprised it took me back this far this time.
Deja Vu#058.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#059.src: Well, time to head on back-
Deja Vu#059.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#062.src: Asher, you remember when I allowed you to live in the valley, I told you not to touch any odd objects.
Deja Vu#062.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#064.src: You got yourself stuck hundreds of years ago. If it wasn't for this guard, you'd be removed from existence.
Deja Vu#064.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#065.src: Oh... So that's where I am. I am so sorry Martyn. Please don't kick me out of the valley.
Deja Vu#065.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#066.src: I know time travel can be tempting. But it's far more dangerous than you can ever understand.
Deja Vu#066.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#067.src: The valley is banned for most citizens. I watch over this timeline because of poor souls like Asher.
Deja Vu#067.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#071.src: How did you get these powers? Are you even human?
Deja Vu#071.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#072.src: Oh you know. I've read a book or two in my time.
Deja Vu#072.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#073.src: , I'm sorry I got you dragged into this. I wish I could have done it myself.
Deja Vu#073.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#074.src: I probably could have gotten myself out...
Deja Vu#074.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#075.src: You died in the past. Multiple times.
Deja Vu#075.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#077.src: Yes. In some surprising ways too.
Deja Vu#077.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#078.src: , I'm sure we will meet again... in time.
Deja Vu#078.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#082.src: I don't understand Martyn. He seems to know everything about the past. Here, come closer, I want to whisper something.
Deja Vu#082.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#084.src: I think he might have known Bob. I saw some letters in his house.
Deja Vu#084.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#085.src: Weird, right? Bob was a hard guy to know.
Deja Vu#085.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#086.src: Anyway, take this. It's the least I can do to pay you for saving me.
Deja Vu#086.speaker: Asher

Dwelling Walls#002.speaker: Leucsaa

Dwelling Walls#003.src: Finally, the journal. It's out here somewhere, I assume. I'll look around.
Dwelling Walls#003.speaker: Leucsaa

Dwelling Walls#005.src: Hold on, what? The journal! I must have forgotten it inside the mansion!
Dwelling Walls#005.speaker: Leucsaa

Dwelling Walls#006.src: You there! Would you mind doing me a deed?
Dwelling Walls#006.speaker: Leucsaa

Dwelling Walls#007.src: I left a very precious journal inside this mansion, a hell within walls. It was my great grandfather's!
Dwelling Walls#007.speaker: Leucsaa

Dwelling Walls#008.src: The mansion was designed by a Corkian architect, and I was scammed into buying it.

Dwelling Walls#009.src: If you step inside the mansion just for a few moments, you'll understand why the sellers had to trick someone into investing in their god forsaken real estate!
Dwelling Walls#009.speaker: Leucsaa

Dwelling Walls#010.src: Navigating from room to room is nearly impossible, the rooms move around. I've only been in the mansion for a week and I'm already packing my bags and moving to {p}.
Dwelling Walls#010.speaker: Leucsaa

Dwelling Walls#012.src: Navigate the mansion to the room holding the journal

Dwelling Walls#014.src: The journal! You outsmarted the mansion!

Dwelling Walls#015.src: I must thank you, that journal was priceless to my family.
Dwelling Walls#015.speaker: Leucsaa

Dwelling Walls#016.src: Let this be a life lesson to you. Never buy a house from a Corkian architect.
Dwelling Walls#016.speaker: Leucsaa

Elemental Exercise#000.src: Talk to Captain Ragon in the {p} Barracks at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Elemental Exercise#001.src: Ah! You must be one of the new recruits the Admiral told me to look out for! What was it... , yes?
Elemental Exercise#001.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#002.src: You've done well to reach this city as quickly as you have, which must have required a great deal of fighting the undead.
Elemental Exercise#002.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#003.src: Now, I've heard from Sergeant Van of your aid in his assault on our overtaken fort- which, good work, very well done...
Elemental Exercise#003.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#004.src: But the fact still stands that you lack experience. You can certainly fight, yes, but can you fight well?
Elemental Exercise#004.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#005.src: Lucky for you, that's where I come in. You're just in time for today's training session! Come here, follow me.
Elemental Exercise#005.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#006.src: Follow Captain Ragon to the Training Room at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Elemental Exercise#007.src: ...Oh! , hello. Are you here for training as well?
Elemental Exercise#007.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#008.src: Ahem. Now, in front of you, you'll see five special training dummies. Each one finely imbued with elemental magic. You are aware of the elements, yes? There's five of them in total.
Elemental Exercise#008.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#009.src: I am! The elements are... , , , , and... ?
Elemental Exercise#009.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#010.src: That's right. And generally speaking, they're strong against each other in that order- beats , beats , and so on.
Elemental Exercise#010.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#011.src: Elemental weaknesses may vary based on the enemy, but that order holds true in most cases.
Elemental Exercise#011.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#012.src: Enemies will take more damage from elements they're weak to, and take less damage from elements they resist. This change to your damage is always a flat value, and it varies from enemy to enemy.
Elemental Exercise#012.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#013.src: Now. For training purposes, you'll be given an elemental weapon to try out on these training dummies. Take note of how each elemental defense and weakness affects your damage dealt. Speak to me once you feel you understand the concept.
Elemental Exercise#013.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#014.src: Test out the elemental training weapons on the dummies, then speak to Captain Ragon at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Elemental Exercise#015.src: Well? Have you noted the effect of elemental defenses and weaknesses on your damage?
Elemental Exercise#015.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#016.src: Excellent. I'll take those training weapons back from the two of you. Any questions?
Elemental Exercise#016.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#017.src: I do have one. If our enemies are susceptible to elements in this way, would that also apply to us?
Elemental Exercise#017.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#018.src: Ah, yes. A fine observation. Indeed, you are also bound by the rules of the elements. Elemental defenses and weaknesses from your equipment will affect you in the very same way.
Elemental Exercise#018.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#019.src: One final note before we move on from the elements- your weapon may not always be as effective against an enemy as you would like.
Elemental Exercise#019.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#020.src: However, you have another tool at your disposal in the form of your spells! Different spells will deal different elemental damage, even if your weapon does use that element by default.
Elemental Exercise#020.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#021.src: ...Oh! So my Bash spell will still deal damage even if my weapon only uses , right?
Elemental Exercise#021.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#022.src: Correct! Now, let's see... We have the two of you here. Why don't we have a friendly duel? A chance to test your battle skills in a save environment.
Elemental Exercise#022.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#023.src: That sounds good to me! , we've been traveling together for some time now... I can't say I haven't been curious to see how you fight. Let's see who comes out on top, shall we?
Elemental Exercise#023.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#025.src: Alright. I'll be waiting here when you're ready!
Elemental Exercise#025.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#026.src: Go on, then. Just speak to me when you're ready to move on.
Elemental Exercise#026.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#027.src: Return to Tasim at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] for a duel.

Elemental Exercise#028.src: There you are! Are you ready for our duel?
Elemental Exercise#028.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#029.src: Alright! Let's see which of us is the better fighter!
Elemental Exercise#029.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#031.src: Fight Tasim in a friendly duel.

Elemental Exercise#033.src: Phew! That was a good fight. You did well, . We'll have to do this again- and maybe we can get Aledar to join!
Elemental Exercise#033.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#034.src: Woo! You fought well, , but it looks like I'm still better! Wait until Aledar hears about this...
Elemental Exercise#034.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#035.src: Yes, yes, fine work, the two of you. Now-
Elemental Exercise#035.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#036.src: Captain! Captain Ragon! There's- there's corrupted forces! Advancing from {p}!
Elemental Exercise#036.speaker: Scout Evelyn

Elemental Exercise#037.src: Hm. And the Admiral is away... Very well. Mobilize the troops! We meet the forces at the north gate!
Elemental Exercise#037.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#039.src: Captain- we're capable fighters too. Let us come along and help fight off these undead!
Elemental Exercise#039.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#040.src: Hm... As I see it, this is a fine opportunity for you to gain some firsthand experience! Very well. Prepare yourselves, and come to {p}' north gate when you're ready.
Elemental Exercise#040.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#041.src: This is exciting! But... I'm a little bit nervous, still.
Elemental Exercise#041.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#042.src: ... We'll be alright. Come on, let's go follow the captain.
Elemental Exercise#042.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#043.src: Follow Captain Ragon to {p}' north gate at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] to face the undead forces.

Elemental Exercise#044.src: There you are! Ready for battle?
Elemental Exercise#044.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#045.src: I'm prepared as well. These corrupted won't stand a chance against us!
Elemental Exercise#045.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#046.src: Yes, yes, very good. Now, it shouldn't be long until-
Elemental Exercise#046.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#048.src: Hm... Take note of the leader. I expect if we can defeat it, the rest of the forces will disperse.
Elemental Exercise#048.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#049.src: Stronger foes such as this one will cast spells one after the other, in a specific order. These spell combos can be dangerous, so make sure to take note of them.
Elemental Exercise#049.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#050.src: We'll be fighting all around you, so shout if you're in need of aid. Alright, soldiers, let's defend our city!
Elemental Exercise#050.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#052.src: I understand. We have time until the corrupted forces arrive, so go prepare. Don't take too long, though.
Elemental Exercise#052.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#053.src: Defeat the Corrupted Captain and the force threatening {p}.

Elemental Exercise#054.src: Return to the {p} Barracks and talk to Captain Ragon at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Elemental Exercise#055.src: Ah, there you two are. Come here.
Elemental Exercise#055.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#057.src: Yes, my absence was never meant to take long. I was paying a visit to the desert city of {p}, for a meeting with an Admiral Amerigo...
Elemental Exercise#057.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Elemental Exercise#058.src: But I digress. I've been told the two of you were essential in the defense of our city! Excellent work.
Elemental Exercise#058.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Elemental Exercise#059.src: Our preparations for the assault on {p}' spider den are nearing completion. I'd like the two of you to join that mission.
Elemental Exercise#059.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Elemental Exercise#060.src: Sir- are you certain? I mean, we'd be happy to join, but surely there are many others more worthy of such a task.
Elemental Exercise#060.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#061.src: Nonsense! Captain Ragon has assessed your skills, and has deemed them sufficient. And I trust the Captain's judgement.
Elemental Exercise#061.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Elemental Exercise#062.src: Now, I must be off. I'll see the two of you when it's time for the mission.
Elemental Exercise#062.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Elemental Exercise#063.src: A big mission to take out the spiders, huh... You know, even though I'm a little worried, I think I'm excited.
Elemental Exercise#063.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#064.src: Ahem. Before the two of you return on your business, I have something for the two of you. Payment for your work today, and a special piece of equipment. Make good use of it.
Elemental Exercise#064.speaker: Captain Ragon
