Enzan's Brother#001.src: I see you want to venture into the wilderness!
Enzan's Brother#001.speaker: Enzan

Enzan's Brother#002.src: My name is Enzan, and I am now a retired knight. I've spent most of my life fighting for {p}'s army, just like you.
Enzan's Brother#002.speaker: Enzan

Enzan's Brother#003.src: I know how hard it must be to be a recruit at this time, so I've got something that could help you! Well, I don't have it, but my brother does!
Enzan's Brother#003.speaker: Enzan

Enzan's Brother#004.src: Follow this road, he's just past the item identifier, you can't miss him. Just head to the big set of stairs, past the item identifier.
Enzan's Brother#004.speaker: Enzan

Enzan's Brother#005.src: Tell him I sent you! He can be such a jerk to strangers sometimes, especially when he's focused on his stairs...
Enzan's Brother#005.speaker: Enzan

Enzan's Brother#006.src: Find Enzan's brother near the Item Identifier on the {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Enzan's Brother#007.src: Excuse me? Can't you see I'm busy?
Enzan's Brother#007.speaker: Therck

Enzan's Brother#008.src: Oh, my brother? Sorry, I didn't know.
Enzan's Brother#008.speaker: Therck

Enzan's Brother#009.src: Why yes, I actually have something that could help you...
Enzan's Brother#009.speaker: Therck

Enzan's Brother#010.src: But before I give it to you, why don't you help me with something first?
Enzan's Brother#010.speaker: Therck

Enzan's Brother#011.src: You see, there's a special kind of mushroom that grows in this cave. I hear it has certain... energizing properties.
Enzan's Brother#011.speaker: Therck

Enzan's Brother#012.src: If you can bring me [[Energy Mushroom|[{~} Energy Mushroom]]], I'll help you out. Enter the cave down the stairs, and bring me that mushroom!
Enzan's Brother#012.speaker: Therck

Enzan's Brother#013.src: Descend into the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and bring [[Energy Mushroom|[{~} Energy Mushroom]]] to Therck

Enzan's Brother#014.src: Ah, you're back! Do you have the mushroom?
Enzan's Brother#014.speaker: Therck

Enzan's Brother#015.src: Excellent... Now I might be able to finally climb these stairs!
Enzan's Brother#015.speaker: Therck

Enzan's Brother#016.src: Who knows, maybe there's a treasure up there?
Enzan's Brother#016.speaker: Therck

Enzan's Brother#017.src: Take this ring. It's an accessory item! You can identify it at the nearby Item Identifier.
Enzan's Brother#017.speaker: Therck

Enzan's Brother#018.src: It's a very good ring for someone starting out like you. There's just one small issue...

Enzan's Brother#019.src: To wear it, you must help my friend back in {p}. He's been pestering me for days about needing help.
Enzan's Brother#019.speaker: Therck

Fate of the Fallen#000.src: Talk to Telvu the mage at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Fate of the Fallen#001.src: Ah, a member of the {p} army. We're trying to gain entry to this frozen barrow. We could use your aid.
Fate of the Fallen#001.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#002.src: Are you familiar with the story of Theorick and {p}?
Fate of the Fallen#002.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#003.src: Probably not. Well, you see, {p} was not always frozen.
Fate of the Fallen#003.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#004.src: During Theorick's time, this place was like the Wynn plains, warm and arable.
Fate of the Fallen#004.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#005.src: For some reason, Theorick Twain used his immense power to freeze the land before exiling himself here.
Fate of the Fallen#005.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#006.src: We need to find out why so we can reverse this spell. Presumably, the source of that spell's magic would lie within the barrow... but we don't want to go in empty-handed.
Fate of the Fallen#006.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#007.src: As such...have you heard of a place called {p}? We could use it to go back in time, to try to learn more about Theorick's actions.
Fate of the Fallen#007.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#008.src: Well...in a way, at least. There are laws to this sort of magic. For one, you need an item from the specific time we want to see. Second, you can witness the past, not change it.
Fate of the Fallen#008.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#009.src: One of Theorick's staves is on display in the {p} bank. Presumably, it should work for what we need. Could you retrieve it somehow?
Fate of the Fallen#009.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#011.src: Aha, quick job. I see you've got the wand. Must've needed a sharp tongue to get the bankers to give it up.
Fate of the Fallen#011.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#012.src: Now, it is a long walk to {p}. Needn't take that walk, though, as I can teleport you there. Hopefully.
Fate of the Fallen#012.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#013.src: Once you're there, enter the Temple of Time. You should know what to do once you are there. Careful dealing with time travel, friend... No idea what you might find.
Fate of the Fallen#013.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#015.src: Should anything go wrong, I'll stay here to teleport you back to the temple.
Fate of the Fallen#015.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#016.src: Enter the portal the mage made.

Fate of the Fallen#017.src: Enter the Gate of Time at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and travel back in time.

Fate of the Fallen#020.src: Woah, your weaponry and armour is so advanced!
Fate of the Fallen#020.speaker: Psern

Fate of the Fallen#021.src: Are you another Twain? Only the Twains know magic like that.
Fate of the Fallen#021.speaker: Psern

Fate of the Fallen#023.src: He's busy fighting in the war, shouldn't you be doing the same?
Fate of the Fallen#023.speaker: Psern

Fate of the Fallen#024.src: He went west. There was some kind of emergency.
Fate of the Fallen#024.speaker: Psern

Fate of the Fallen#025.src: We've been fighting the corruption for years, it seems like it might finally engulf {p}.
Fate of the Fallen#025.speaker: Psern

Fate of the Fallen#026.src: Find Theorick in the forest west of {p} [{~}, {~}, {~}].

Fate of the Fallen#027.src: I could've sworn she had gone this way... Oh, what now, more imbeciles? This forest isn't safe to travel!
Fate of the Fallen#027.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#028.src: If you need help, lodge a complaint with the guards. I'm busy and I can't exactly break away from saving this god-blessed province to chill your milk!!
Fate of the Fallen#028.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#029.src: Are your ears full of wax?! I said-
Fate of the Fallen#029.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#030.src: Urgh, the things followed you! See what happens?! STAND ASIDE.
Fate of the Fallen#030.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#031.src: As though I needed TWO people to save! Now get out of here, I have to find that woman who went missing!
Fate of the Fallen#031.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#032.src: HEEEELP! I can't outrun them!!! Guards! Someone!!

Fate of the Fallen#034.src: Ugh, is she dragging them over from the west?! You there, If you don't want to end up frozen, GET BEHIND ME, NOW!!
Fate of the Fallen#034.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#035.src: Phew... You're out of danger now. If you hadn't left town, though, you wouldn't have been IN any danger at all!
Fate of the Fallen#035.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#036.src: Don't bother apologizing to me, just get back to town. Now.
Fate of the Fallen#036.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#037.src: Next time you feel like picking flowers in the forest or whatever you were doing, remember you have a life to live, hm?!
Fate of the Fallen#037.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#038.src: Every day, more corrupteds, more deaths... There is only one thing for it. I have to tackle it myself. Cut the roots...and kill this hellish weed.
Fate of the Fallen#038.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#039.src: Still here? Well, listen up. Myself and a few others are planning something risky. Damned be it if our minds are lost, I need to go through that portal.
Fate of the Fallen#039.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#040.src: You look heavily geared, so I'm conscripting you. Meet us at our base, immediately. Follow the river south and you'll see a house on the right side.
Fate of the Fallen#040.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#041.src: Head to the base of the operation south of {p} [{~}, {~}, {~}].

Fate of the Fallen#042.src: Well, I'll give you this. You're prompt to listen to orders, at least. We're headed to the {p}.
Fate of the Fallen#042.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#043.src: The last man that entered the portal and returned became Bak’al... But if there is even a fraction of a chance this could work, we must take it at this point.
Fate of the Fallen#043.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#044.src: Let's get moving. We'll be taking no breaks on the trip, so I hope you were prepared.
Fate of the Fallen#044.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#045.src: Now. The sheer cold I command can stave off corruption itself. Somehow I doubt any of you can say the same. I'll go in alone.
Fate of the Fallen#045.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#046.src: When I enter... If I had to make an assumption, corrupteds will swarm the portal after me. Your job? Slay them. I can't have distractions in there.
Fate of the Fallen#046.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#047.src: You will not be leaving your post here until I exit that portal. Understood?
Fate of the Fallen#047.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#050.src: ...no, no, no no no NO!! DAMN IT ALL!!
Fate of the Fallen#050.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#051.src: You know what happened?! I lost!! I will destroy the province if I turn completely! GET AWAY, NOW! DO YOU HEAR ME?! RUN!!
Fate of the Fallen#051.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#052.src: I... C-calm yourself, Theorick...don't...don't lose yourself to it...there's...yet a solution...one way...
Fate of the Fallen#052.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#053.src: Oh...you again...the others...dead? Run off? Cowards...urgh...
Fate of the Fallen#053.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#054.src: You live...so...eyes up. Listen to me. If I turn...w-when...when I turn...n-no, can't...gaaah, I'll destr- Nggh...
Fate of the Fallen#054.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#055.src: I won't last, you can tell... Right now...killing me is an impossibility, you idiotic weakl- Agh, GET OUT OF MY MIND!!
Fate of the Fallen#055.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#056.src: Gaaah... Tell...everyone. I will freeze this place. I...t-too fargone. It needs time to heal...and my powers m-must be dampened...frozen...
Fate of the Fallen#056.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#057.src: All worthless... Urgh, no...they yet deserve life...and this spell...it will surely claim some. Please, let them know why...
Fate of the Fallen#057.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#058.src: If I have learned anything from that insufferable f- ...from Mael...deaths without reason lets spirits to linger. I would...prefer against giving him a harder time.
Fate of the Fallen#058.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#059.src: K-keep advancing. Your things, if everyone was as strong as you...we may stand a chance. This could end me, in time, once I am weaker.
Fate of the Fallen#059.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#060.src: Let it be known...Theorick Twain is not dead. He cannot be killed...all will burn...until future days. Here, in this accursed place. Find me...and end it all.
Fate of the Fallen#060.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#061.src: Tell Telvu the mage what happened.

Fate of the Fallen#062.src: You must have succeeded, or you would be yet in the memory of the past. I can feel some potent magic on you.
Fate of the Fallen#062.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#063.src: So, you met Theorick? He was always said to have fallen from heroism after the great freezing.
Fate of the Fallen#063.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#064.src: Were you able to figure out why it was he froze this place, at least?
Fate of the Fallen#064.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#065.src: What... so many revelations... ice magic staves off corruption...? It is true this palce has seen less corrupted threats than other places in the province...
Fate of the Fallen#065.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#066.src: Dear gods... We've had it all wrong this whole time... This was to protect everyone...but surely he would have told someone his intentions if he was of that sound a mind!
Fate of the Fallen#066.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#067.src: All this time, spent buried alive, wrestling with the corruption. The thought horrifies you, as well, judging by your face. Killing him would be a mercy.
Fate of the Fallen#067.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#068.src: Here. Use this. It may help protect you within the Ice Barrows... Please, soldier. Be Theorick's guardian angel. Free him from this torment.
Fate of the Fallen#068.speaker: Telvu

Grand Youth#001.src: Oh, what am I to do...? How am I to be our next elder if I cannot even help him... Oh? Ehm, hello, stranger.
Grand Youth#001.speaker: Monte

Grand Youth#002.src: You most likely heard me. Our elder has fallen ill of some vile disease... I am to be our next elder, but I am not yet ready.
Grand Youth#002.speaker: Monte

Grand Youth#003.src: We have tried everything we can think of, but our healers and shamans have failed to cure him. We had some hope, however...
Grand Youth#003.speaker: Monte

Grand Youth#004.src: A man in your city, {p}, insists that he sells healing water that could cure him, but he is selling it for an exorbitant price that we cannot afford!
Grand Youth#004.speaker: Monte

Grand Youth#005.src: I do not know where else to turn. I must ask you for help. If you can purchase it, I am sure that we could find a way to repay you.
Grand Youth#005.speaker: Monte

Grand Youth#006.src: I have written directions for you in your content book...please help our village.
Grand Youth#006.speaker: Monte

Grand Youth#007.src: Visit the Salesman in {p} near the fountain.

Grand Youth#008.src: Oh, why hello there! Come for my patented healing water, have you? Any problem instantly cured! Sniffles beware!
Grand Youth#008.speaker: Salesman

Grand Youth#009.src: You're quite lucky, I only have a couple of bottles left, so it won't go cheap, but this is the good stuff! Only [{~} Liquified Emeralds]!
Grand Youth#009.speaker: Salesman

Grand Youth#010.src: What? Don't give me that look! This is the real stuff, very valuable and rare! What do ya take me for, some guy who'd sell lake water for a fortune?!
Grand Youth#010.speaker: Salesman

Grand Youth#011.src: Agh, agh! Put away the weapon! Put it away! Jeez, buddy! Alright, I admit it, I'm a fraudster! But, I do know where you get the real stuff, I ain't lying about that much.
Grand Youth#011.speaker: Salesman

Grand Youth#012.src: There's this group of mages out in Dernel who know how to get the stuff. They're a bunch of tightwads and wouldn't get give me any real healing water to sell.
Grand Youth#012.speaker: Salesman

Grand Youth#013.src: I doubt you'll have any better luck with it, but go on, try your luck.
Grand Youth#013.speaker: Salesman

Grand Youth#014.src: Those tightwad mages are out in Dernel, on the lake with the big island. I doubt you'll convince them to give you any healing water, though.
Grand Youth#014.speaker: Salesman

Grand Youth#015.src: Talk to Isfurus in Dernel at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Grand Youth#016.src: Hm, hm...if it really does that, then...oh, is someone there? Erisk?
Grand Youth#016.speaker: Isfurus

Grand Youth#017.src: Oh, a tourist. Heard about the healing water, I presume? Well, if you are here to make a quick buck, you can turn right back around from where you came.
Grand Youth#017.speaker: Isfurus

Grand Youth#018.src: Hm...ah. Iboju's sister settlement...I see. I will trust this is an honest venture, then. The tribesmen are honourable.
Grand Youth#018.speaker: Isfurus

Grand Youth#019.src: I will provide you a specially-prepared bottle to hold the water in. My colleague, Erisk, is within the fountain here. He can fill up the bottle for you.
Grand Youth#019.speaker: Isfurus

Grand Youth#020.src: There are a few animals in the fountain, however. They're wild and will most likely attack, but you look well-armoured. I doubt you'll have trouble.
Grand Youth#020.speaker: Isfurus

Grand Youth#021.src: The entrance to the heart of the fountain is right below us. Take a deep breath and dive right in.
Grand Youth#021.speaker: Isfurus

Grand Youth#022.src: Your directions are in your content book, friend. Always consult it if you are in a bind.
Grand Youth#022.speaker: Isfurus

Grand Youth#023.src: Get the bottles filled by Erisk in the heart of the fountain to give Isfurus.

Grand Youth#024.src: And who might you be? We certainly don't get many visitors down here.
Grand Youth#024.speaker: Erisk

Grand Youth#025.src: Aha, Isfurus referred you. Yes, let me bottle this up for you, then. Once I do, make sure you don't drop them! Both the bottles and the water are valuable and difficult to replace.
Grand Youth#025.speaker: Erisk

Grand Youth#026.src: But what a marvel this place is...water to cure all ailments, even aging! I even hear there is a similar fountain someplace in Gavel, can you believe?
Grand Youth#026.speaker: Erisk

Grand Youth#027.src: Oh, I nearly forgot. Just make sure to check back in with Isfurus before you leave! There is just one more step to the process he has to take care of.
Grand Youth#027.speaker: Erisk

Grand Youth#028.src: Just make sure to check back in with Isfurus before you leave!
Grand Youth#028.speaker: Erisk

Grand Youth#030.src: Aha. You had no trouble, I assume? Hand the bottle here, I'll finish the seal and remove the impurities...
Grand Youth#030.speaker: Isfurus

Grand Youth#031.src: ...done. There is much potential here...ancient tribal markings repeat the word "youth" over and again. It could be used, or abused...
Grand Youth#031.speaker: Isfurus

Grand Youth#032.src: Anyways, you have your water. Not to be rude, but I must ask that you leave me to my research now. You have your delivery to make anyway, correct?
Grand Youth#032.speaker: Isfurus

Grand Youth#033.src: Your directions are in your content book, friend. Always consult it if you are in a bind.
Grand Youth#033.speaker: Isfurus

Grand Youth#034.src: Bring back the bottle of healing water to Monte.

Grand Youth#035.src: You have returned, I see. Have you the healing water?
Grand Youth#035.speaker: Monte

Grand Youth#036.src: Aha, perfect! If this not work, then...no, I must have faith.
Grand Youth#036.speaker: Monte

Grand Youth#037.src: From the bottom of my heart, thank you. I know we surely will not be able to compensate you for the price of the water...
Grand Youth#037.speaker: Monte

Grand Youth#038.src: ...but here. This is the summation of our village's riches. For aiding us, consider it yours.
Grand Youth#038.speaker: Monte

Green Gloop#001.src: Oh, hey! You, adventurer over there! Would you mind helping me?
Green Gloop#001.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#002.src: You see, this cave behind me has been troubling me for the past while now.
Green Gloop#002.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#003.src: There are special slimes that live in there, and they drop a certain goo that is quite a delicacy when brewed into a drink!
Green Gloop#003.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#004.src: They are called Gooey Slimes, and should be at the very back. A friend of mine drinks the stuff like water, and he refuses to work without it.
Green Gloop#004.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#005.src: However, the slimes have gotten stronger about a month ago. I'm unable to retrieve it any more, I've come close to getting killed a few times!
Green Gloop#005.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#006.src: You, however, seem much better equipped than I. Hopefully you can do it.
Green Gloop#006.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#007.src: If you decide to help me, you'll need to obtain a special device for retrieving it, as the slime will dry up quickly in the air.
Green Gloop#007.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#008.src: A...less fickle glassblower, Yodbon, can make it for you. He should be living in a house in front of the {p} bank.
Green Gloop#008.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#009.src: I'll need [{~} Slimey Goo] since we'll need a big batch of drinks. If you help, I'll be sure to tell my friend, and he'll probably let you into his shop.
Green Gloop#009.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#010.src: Find Yodbon near the {p} Bank at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Green Gloop#011.src: Welcome to Yodbon's Glass Blowery, what can I do f-
Green Gloop#011.speaker: Yodbon

Green Gloop#013.src: So many've been coming up to me recently, askin' for a bloody Slime Scooper...
Green Gloop#013.speaker: Yodbon

Green Gloop#014.src: Izzat brother o' mine stopped workin' again? I swear, he's addicted to that slop...
Green Gloop#014.speaker: Yodbon

Green Gloop#015.src: Anyways, for me to make you a scooper you'll need to get [{~} Soft Sand].
Green Gloop#015.speaker: Yodbon

Green Gloop#016.src: Come back to me once you've gotten ahold of it. You can dig it up from those sand piles 'round the desert.
Green Gloop#016.speaker: Yodbon

Green Gloop#017.src: Bring [[Soft Sand|[{~} Soft Sand]]] from enemies in the desert to Yodbon at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Green Gloop#019.src: A'ight, fork 'em over and I'll make you the scooper.
Green Gloop#019.speaker: Yodbon

Green Gloop#020.src: ..There you go. No idea why he wants that stuff though. Maybe it's an acquired taste...
Green Gloop#020.speaker: Yodbon

Green Gloop#022.src: Fetch [[Slimey Goo|[{~} Slimey Goo]]] for Eluzterp from the cave at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Green Gloop#023.src: Oh, you're back! Good to see you were able to get through there. Have you got a full Slime Scooper?
Green Gloop#023.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#024.src: Hmm, yes, everything seems to be in order. Perfect!
Green Gloop#024.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#025.src: Thank you very much. Finally, I'll be able to get him in gear again... Why are all Villagers so fickle like that?
Green Gloop#025.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#026.src: Well, I suppose that's beside the point. I'll be sure to let him know you got him his most recent fix.
Green Gloop#026.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#027.src: He hangs around in a little black stall in the bazaar, there's a basement to it. He should let you inside now.
Green Gloop#027.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#028.src: And, for your troubles, a little something from me as well.
Green Gloop#028.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#029.src: Ah, hello again. This latest batch of drinks apparently really revitalized him. He said he's looking to make some great craft.
Green Gloop#029.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#030.src: Those Villagers are a little bit crazy though... I have no idea what kind of material it is that he insists he needs for it.
Green Gloop#030.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#031.src: Oh, it's you again. Yes, my brother there just loves makin' his little trinkets. He oughta make somethin' useful out of his glass instead...
Green Gloop#031.speaker: Yodbon

Infested Plants#000.src: Meet up with Tasim at the entrance to {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Infested Plants#001.src: Oh, ! There you are. It's good to see you. Are you ready to continue on towards {p}?
Infested Plants#001.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#002.src: It seems we'll need to pass through the {p} first. I've heard the forest is crawling with spiders... But between you and me, we should be-
Infested Plants#002.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#003.src: H-hey! You two! You're soldiers, right? I can tell from your weird fashion sense. You folk are supposed to help people! So. Help!

Infested Plants#004.src: Huh? Oh- yes, of course! What's your name? What do you need help with?
Infested Plants#004.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#005.src: I'm Ope! I was recently... uh... bit by a spider! And now I need your help to get a rare medicinal herb to heal me!
Infested Plants#005.speaker: Ope

Infested Plants#006.src: It only grows in an infested cave filled with creepy crawlies. And I'm clearly in no condition to go get it myself!
Infested Plants#006.speaker: Ope

Infested Plants#007.src: Well, alright! We're here to help, after all, so... We'll get you that herb!
Infested Plants#007.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#008.src: Perfect. I'll bring you to the cave, and you can do the rest from there. Follow me, soldiers!
Infested Plants#008.speaker: Ope

Infested Plants#009.src: Follow Ope to the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Infested Plants#010.src: Well, here we are! The cave's right over there - just climb up the rocks and jump into it.
Infested Plants#010.speaker: Ope

Infested Plants#011.src: Hm... There's two of you. Good! One of your can climb up into that cave, and the other can protect me from the crawly spiders down here!
Infested Plants#011.speaker: Ope

Infested Plants#012.src: Alright! , you can go into the cave, and I can defend Ope here while you do that.
Infested Plants#012.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#013.src: Good, good. Well, good luck up there! Try not to get bitten too much by the spiders!
Infested Plants#013.speaker: Ope

Infested Plants#014.src: Locate the medicine in the spider cave behind Ope at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Infested Plants#015.src: Exit the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] with the medicinal herb.

Infested Plants#016.src: There you are! It feels like we've been waiting for hours.
Infested Plants#016.speaker: Ope

Infested Plants#017.src: It... really hasn't been that long. Maybe ten minutes at most.
Infested Plants#017.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#018.src: Well-... Anyway! Do you have the herb? It's very- uh, important! To cure me. Yep.
Infested Plants#018.speaker: Ope

Infested Plants#019.src: There it is! Eheh. Thank you kindly for your work, soldiers! Now, about your payment...Let's see, what do I have...
Infested Plants#019.speaker: Ope

Infested Plants#020.src: Oh. I seem to be out of emeralds. Well- I can, uh, offer some advice! There's lots to find in this forest. Plenty of caves with valuables to explore! Might be worth your time.
Infested Plants#020.speaker: Ope

Infested Plants#021.src: Wait, are you seriously not going to-
Infested Plants#021.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#022.src: It has been a time, soldiers, but I truly must be going! We're near {p}, you should stop on by! Just keep going east down the main road! Go and speak to the mayor! He can cover my expenses!
Infested Plants#022.speaker: Ope

Infested Plants#025.src: That's... frustrating. He seemed shady from the start, I should have-... Well. What's done is done. Let's go speak to that mayor.
Infested Plants#025.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#026.src: Speak to Mayor Alvin in {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Infested Plants#027.src: Ah, travelers... welcome to our humble forest town. Have you come to stay, or are you simply passing through?
Infested Plants#027.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Infested Plants#028.src: Probably the latter. Though, we ran into a man named Ope, who directed us to speak with you.
Infested Plants#028.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#029.src: Oh, Ope... I take it your meeting with him went poorly? I must apologize for him, he is... a tough man to deal with.
Infested Plants#029.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Infested Plants#030.src: Here, I may offer you a small sum of emeralds as an apology. I hope he has not soured your opinion of our small town, here...
Infested Plants#030.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Infested Plants#031.src: Oh... Thank you. That's very kind of you. We'll probably stay for a while, before we continue towards {p}.
Infested Plants#031.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#032.src: Then feel free to make yourselves at home! We welcome all travelers here, no matter how long their stay is.
Infested Plants#032.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Kingdom of Sand#001.src: A {p} soldier! I imagine you're here to investigate the tomb up the hill?
Kingdom of Sand#001.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#002.src: It's believed to house the remains of Prince Hashr, the son of the old Desert Emperor, but it's far too dangerous for me to explore personally.
Kingdom of Sand#002.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#003.src: Instead I've been looking into a related legend - the Emperor's Sceptre.
Kingdom of Sand#003.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#004.src: It was the source of his power, and potentially one of the most important artifacts in history.
Kingdom of Sand#004.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#005.src: When the Emperor was slain by his son, Hashr, it is said that the sceptre was lost amongst the raging sandstorm that followed.
Kingdom of Sand#005.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#006.src: ... Until now. I believe I have been able to trace its possession to a nearby group of bandits. They probably have no idea what they're sitting on.
Kingdom of Sand#006.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#007.src: I'm not prepared to confront them myself, but... this artifact belongs in a museum, in the hands of careful and respectful researchers.
Kingdom of Sand#007.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#008.src: I would be in your debt if you could try to retrieve it, for the sake of history.
Kingdom of Sand#008.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#009.src: Attempt to enter the bandit hideout at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Kingdom of Sand#011.src: Even if yer a crooked soldier, we can't jus let yer in.
Kingdom of Sand#011.speaker: Vault Guard

Kingdom of Sand#012.src: That is, unless yer got the password?
Kingdom of Sand#012.speaker: Vault Guard

Kingdom of Sand#013.src: Didn’t think so. Now get lost, wasted enough of my t-
Kingdom of Sand#013.speaker: Vault Guard

Kingdom of Sand#014.src: Now would you look at that... Even soldiers think they can waltz in ere.
Kingdom of Sand#014.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#015.src: Having fun thinking of a password? Sorry to spoil your lunch, but there isn’t one!
Kingdom of Sand#015.speaker: Geo

Kingdom of Sand#016.src: We could use a few more officials on the roster.
Kingdom of Sand#016.speaker: Geo

Kingdom of Sand#017.src: If yer are on the liberal side of the law, talk to us outside.
Kingdom of Sand#017.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#019.src: Looks like yer in. Look, there ain't a password cause we're meant to be the best thieves in the land, right?
Kingdom of Sand#019.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#020.src: So what good are words? Yer gotta give the guard somethin' stolen, aintcha!
Kingdom of Sand#020.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#021.src: And we just so happen to have the opportunity of a lifetime for you. {p} has gone soft see, a new Mayor is cleaning things up.
Kingdom of Sand#021.speaker: Geo

Kingdom of Sand#022.src: Well, we can't have government not under our control. {p} will always be bandit capital.
Kingdom of Sand#022.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#023.src: So how about we give him a taste of his own medicine, and get hold of that journal he keeps? I'm sure that’ll dig up some dirt on him.
Kingdom of Sand#023.speaker: Geo

Kingdom of Sand#024.src: And by "we", we mean you. You'll have to sneak through the mansion and avoid guards.
Kingdom of Sand#024.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#025.src: He keeps his journal in the highest room. Might need to distract some guards too. It's the biggest mansion in {p}, can't miss it.
Kingdom of Sand#025.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#026.src: Sneak into the highest room of the {p} Mansion at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Kingdom of Sand#027.src: Arh, there's the thief I saw a-sneakin' round the Mansion! Get them!
Kingdom of Sand#027.speaker: Mansion Guard

Kingdom of Sand#028.src: Yer know you could get kicked out of the army fer this.
Kingdom of Sand#028.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#029.src: Heh, guess yer the real thing. Hop in, lets get out of ‘ere.
Kingdom of Sand#029.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#030.src: That journal is more valuable than any gem, you'll be able to get in fer sure.
Kingdom of Sand#030.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#031.src: Bring the journal from the {p} Mansion to the Vault Guard to enter the hideout.

Kingdom of Sand#034.src: Oh, this is quite the password, "soldier". I think this will do nicely, on you go.
Kingdom of Sand#034.speaker: Vault Guard

Kingdom of Sand#035.src: Look for the sceptre within the bandit hideout at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Kingdom of Sand#036.src: Right, then, you lot. Give me your reports.
Kingdom of Sand#036.speaker: Bandit Leader

Kingdom of Sand#037.src: Gold relieved from Mesa travellers last week counted just over {~} bars.
Kingdom of Sand#037.speaker: Bandit

Kingdom of Sand#039.src: We're working on exposing that blasted {p} Mayor with a stolen journal. {p} should be back under Creden Tibus control within the week.
Kingdom of Sand#039.speaker: Bandit

Kingdom of Sand#041.src: Well... someone's been hanging around the old tomb. An archaeologist, looks like. I reckon she's lookin' for the sceptre.
Kingdom of Sand#041.speaker: Bandit

Kingdom of Sand#042.src: Ah... that sceptre's too valuable for us to lose. Maybe we pay 'er a visit, persuade her to... stop lookin'.
Kingdom of Sand#042.speaker: Bandit Leader

Kingdom of Sand#043.src: Right you are, boss. Good thing no one will think to look for it in that broken cart by the river, ey?!
Kingdom of Sand#043.speaker: Bandit

Kingdom of Sand#044.src: Shut it, you fool! What did I just say? Anyway, I'll decide what to do with this archaeologist. Dismissed!
Kingdom of Sand#044.speaker: Bandit Leader

Kingdom of Sand#047.src: We might be bandits, but we’re not stupid. That sceptre is left better off alone.
Kingdom of Sand#047.speaker: Bandit Leader

Kingdom of Sand#050.src: Return to the tomb and give Junes the sceptre at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Kingdom of Sand#051.src: Ah, . I couldn't help myself - I simply had to see the tomb up close.
Kingdom of Sand#051.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#052.src: You have no idea how tempted I am to go inside, but I doubt I'd make it out alive.
Kingdom of Sand#052.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#053.src: You... you found the sceptre? Oh! This is incredible! I can't believe it!
Kingdom of Sand#053.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#054.src: This artifact, it witnessed the rise and fall of the Empire, thousands of years ago. And you've just been... holding it, without gloves...
Kingdom of Sand#054.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#055.src: Under the circumstances, I think I can let that slide. But the things I could learn from studying it...
Kingdom of Sand#055.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#056.src: I should get to {p} right away. Thank you, . You have my eternal gratitude.
Kingdom of Sand#056.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#057.src: Are you thinking of exploring the tomb? I'm sure you can learn so much about the Empire... but you best be careful.
Kingdom of Sand#057.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#058.src: There are nasty legends of what it holds. Silverfish, skeletons... even Prince Hashr himself. Make sure to gear up!
Kingdom of Sand#058.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#059.src: I have little to offer you for your help, but please accept these emeralds, and a fossil bone I found around here.
Kingdom of Sand#059.speaker: Junes

Lava Springs#002.src: Go back to Colonel Gailard at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Lava Springs#003.src: Talk to Gregor outside the {p} well at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Lava Springs#004.src: Enter the {p} well and talk to the healer at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Lava Springs#005.src: Report back to Colonel Gailard at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Lava Springs#006.src: Drink the Potion of Obsidian Skin, then enter the lava spring through the borehole at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] and look for a corrupted heart

Lava Springs#007.src: Tell Colonel Gailard at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] that you destroyed the heart

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#001.src: Ah, one of you adventurin' types, huh? We see a lot of you around here... Going in and out as you please. Must be a nice life.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#001.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#002.src: Though, if you could spare some time, the town could use you-
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#002.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#003.src: Wait, already?! It's only been a day since last! How insatiable are they...?
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#003.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#004.src: THE UNDEAD HAVE OVERWHELMED THE GOLEMS! EVERY CITIZEN FOR THEMSELVES!!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#004.speaker: Gelibord Guard

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#005.src: This is what I was talking about! We need your help with this! You Wynn folk are good at killing zombies, right?!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#005.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#006.src: We need help with this! Defend the town with us!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#006.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#007.src: The horde's retreating, but we have one citizen dead! Regroup at the square and prepare the pyres!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#007.speaker: Gelibord Guard

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#008.src: Hey! Over here, you alright? Come talk to me, I can explain what just happened.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#008.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#009.src: Check in with Burtur about the attack at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#010.src: Phew. That was a smaller horde, thankfully... Still, good thing you were there. That could have been worse.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#010.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#011.src: Still, c'mon now... We have to burn the bodies. Can't leave the job half-done.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#011.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#012.src: It's a bit sacrilegious, but necessary to do right now- otherwise they just keep coming back, like they do across the ridge in Kander.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#012.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#013.src: The ones around here all come up from the river, though, and since it runs right through the town, well... You can see the problem.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#013.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#014.src: Since we don't live in a reeking, pockmarked plain, we have to burn the bodies so any dead don't turn right around against us.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#014.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#015.src: Say your goodbyes, all. Irahe will be missed. Step away from the pyre!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#015.speaker: Gelibord Guard

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#016.src: Some conspiracy theorists think that the Lazarus Pit is the issue. It's an urban legend, a well of water that can revive the dead.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#016.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#017.src: Supposing that it's real, it would make some sense, at least- If it started feeding into the river or water tables, then we'd get the current goings-on.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#017.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#018.src: Of course, no one knows where it is, since it's just rumors, but there's supposedly an "Order" of pit-keepers. Conveniently long dead, and buried in that small graveyard just north of here.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#018.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#019.src: It's... probably just Referick having made the rounds to any drunk who would listen a while back, but it's also our only shot. If you could give it a search, and a yay or nay?
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#019.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#020.src: I'll stay back at the town square, in case the undead attack again. Give me a shout if you find something you aren't sure about.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#020.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#021.src: Have you checked out that small graveyard north of here yet? Remember, you're looking for any clues about that Lazarus Pit "Order."
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#021.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#022.src: Find the body of the Order's mage in {p}'s graveyard at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#023.src: Locate the chapel mentioned by the talisman, or return to Burtur for assistance.

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#024.src: Oh, you found something? Well color me shocked that there was any stock to Referick's ranting...
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#024.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#025.src: Chapel of an ancient order? There's a chapel just northwest of here. I'd say investigate that! I have to stick around here in case of another attack, but...
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#025.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#026.src: Any luck searching out that chapel yet? The coordinates ought to be in your content book, right?
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#026.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#027.src: Investigate the Order's chapel northwest of {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#028.src: Solve the crypt's riddle to 'bring the water of life anew' to the graves.

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#029.src: Revive the people in the tombs with the Lazarus Water and complete their tasks.

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#030.src: Ugh. And who put YOU in charge of waking me up? Where's Gwendolyn, my maid? Incompetents- she was supposed to be buried with me too!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#030.speaker: Lord Plaatic the Kind

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#031.src: What, you want to enter the crypt? Well, prove you're better than the funeral directors and do something right! The Ghastly Ghouls around here won't stop SCREAMING!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#031.speaker: Lord Plaatic the Kind

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#032.src: I want them gone! Get rid of, say, {~} Ghastly Ghouls. Then perhaps I'll give you the time of day, you strange, small-nosed lookyloo!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#032.speaker: Lord Plaatic the Kind

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#033.src: Agh! Stop sneaking up on me! Have you killed those {~} Ghastly Ghouls I asked you to, yet?
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#033.speaker: Lord Plaatic the Kind

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#035.src: Ah, my favorite little weird-small-nosed-person! The graveyard is so lovely when it's quiet- you really did do a good job!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#035.speaker: Lord Plaatic the Kind

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#036.src: As important as I am, you must still check with the other graves, though you certainly have my blessing to enter.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#036.speaker: Lord Plaatic the Kind

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#037.src: My goodness! Ah, it feels good to stretch these old bones. It's not easy being cooped up in a coffin, you know.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#037.speaker: Sir Pigglesworth the Thirty-Fifth

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#038.src: You want to get into the crypt? I suppose I could give you a hand... figuratively, I mean. Still, need to see if you can be trusted and all...
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#038.speaker: Sir Pigglesworth the Thirty-Fifth

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#039.src: Oh, right! My dear husband gave me the most beautiful wedding band, but it became lost when I carked it. Some rude shadowy thing- See if anyone ever marries THEM!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#039.speaker: Sir Pigglesworth the Thirty-Fifth

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#040.src: Bring it back, could you? I died around that old lich's tower to the east. Do that, and I'll be happy to give you my blessing!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#040.speaker: Sir Pigglesworth the Thirty-Fifth

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#041.src: Bring my wedding band back, could you? I died around that old lich's tower to the east. Do that, and I'll be happy to give you my blessing!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#041.speaker: Sir Pigglesworth the Thirty-Fifth

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#043.src: Oh, you found it! Wonderful! Just pop it on that fingerbone right there... Ah, it fits even better on the other hand!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#043.speaker: Sir Pigglesworth the Thirty-Fifth

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#044.src: The crypt, you say? I can offer my blessing to enter, but you'll need to check with the other tombs as well. Farewell!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#044.speaker: Sir Pigglesworth the Thirty-Fifth

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#045.src: I oughta deck you for waking me up!! Don't you realize it's RUDE to re-animate the long-dead corpse of a murderer when he's trying to get his beauty death?!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#045.speaker: Uggword Pollywaggon the Murderous

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#047.src: Greetings! Thank goodness, that dreary old tomb was simply awful. No furniture, no natural light, not even a lick of paint! So drab, the whole thing.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#047.speaker: Poclo Wabblebuff of Gelibord

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#048.src: What's that? You want to get into the crypt? Well, of course I can help, if you just do one teensy little thing for me?
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#048.speaker: Poclo Wabblebuff of Gelibord

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#049.src: Could you feed my cat for me? I know Mrs. Fluffles must be so lonely after all these years. My old house is just south of here, over at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], just pop some food down for her? Thank you!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#049.speaker: Poclo Wabblebuff of Gelibord

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#050.src: Please, kind adventurer! Feed Mrs. Fluffles for me. I'm sure she's just so lonely, in that big old house at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#050.speaker: Poclo Wabblebuff of Gelibord

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#053.src: So, is Mrs. Fluffles doing alright without me? Oh, I bet she was so affectionate, always such a softie!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#053.speaker: Poclo Wabblebuff of Gelibord

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#054.src: Oh, thank you so much! I was so worried that after my death she wouldn't be okay... What a relief!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#054.speaker: Poclo Wabblebuff of Gelibord

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#055.src: You have my blessing to enter the crypt! Make sure to check with the other graves as well though.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#055.speaker: Poclo Wabblebuff of Gelibord

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#056.src: W-wait, Mrs. Fluffles... She was...d-dead? No... It can't be! I left her a lifetime supply of food!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#056.speaker: Poclo Wabblebuff of Gelibord

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#057.src: You! You killed Mrs. Fluffles, it's the only explanation!! HOW COULD YOU DO SUCH A THING?!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#057.speaker: Poclo Wabblebuff of Gelibord

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#059.src: Investigate the crypt's inner chamber at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#060.src: ... the Lazarus Pi... said to bring back the dead.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#060.speaker: Old Book

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#061.src: Be warned, traveller, th... not truly alive agai... were before.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#061.speaker: Old Book

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#062.src: ... In times of great need, one can find... at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#062.speaker: Old Book

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#063.src: But know this... use for greed or self-ga... result in... worse than death.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#063.speaker: Old Book

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#064.src: Find the entrance to the Lazarus Pit at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#065.src: Follow the path to the Lazarus pit at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and enter the Pit.

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#066.src: Follow the cave to find the Lazarus Pit.

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#067.src: Find a way to block off the water pillar in the Lazarus Pit.

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#068.src: Tell Burtur that you have blocked off the Lazarus Pit at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#069.src: Ah, you're back! We were getting a tad worried about you. Were you able to figure anything out in the chapel there?
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#069.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#070.src: Wait, you found the Lazarus Pit? AND blocked the flow into the river? Grook feathers you humans work quick! It's only been a few hours!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#070.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#071.src: Heck, I gotta pitch in and compensate you for that hard work! I know we're not the richest, but I hope you'll accept this...other way of paying, too!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#071.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#072.src: ...loss, but those pure of heart found... untouched by the curse, and formed this Order.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#072.speaker: Old Book

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#073.src: For worry of the misuse... waters, malicious or not, our... shall be taken to the grave.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#073.speaker: Old Book

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#074.src: Only one apart from our... of it, and they have... secrecy, even... immmortality.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#074.speaker: Old Book

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#075.src: The lich, Espera... keeper of the Order. We ...an outside influence will not...
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#075.speaker: Old Book

Lexdale Witch Trials#000.src: See what's going on in the center of {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Lexdale Witch Trials#001.src: Explore the basement of the decayed and barren house.

Lexdale Witch Trials#002.src: Follow the creature down the tunnels.

Lexdale Witch Trials#003.src: Continue to follow the creature from the tunnel at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Lexdale Witch Trials#004.src: Continue to follow the creature from the tunnel at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Lexdale Witch Trials#006.src: Dig yourself out of the dirt. Then go after the creature.

Lexdale Witch Trials#007.src: Return to {p} and try to show the mayor the creature at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Lost in the Jungle#001.src: Excuse me, traveller... I am dreadfully sorry to ask this of you, but I need your help.
Lost in the Jungle#001.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#002.src: You see, my son, Aryn. Very recently, he underwent a traditional coming-of-age ceremony from our tribe.
Lost in the Jungle#002.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#003.src: He was tasked to enter the dangerous {p}, just south of here, and brave the wilderness for three days. He returned a true man, successful.
Lost in the Jungle#003.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#004.src: However, he also brought with him an odd purple gemstone. Our shaman saw it as a bad omen, but I was so caught up in the celebrations, I brushed it off.
Lost in the Jungle#004.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#005.src: Strange happenings began around the village. Aryn walked about at night, talking to someone, but no one else was there with him.
Lost in the Jungle#005.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#006.src: Just last sunrise, he vanished entirely. We sent out a search for him, but even our hardiest warriors could not venture deep into the jungle.
Lost in the Jungle#006.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#007.src: We returned empty-handed, having lost our newest tribesman. The village is in terrible spirits, and I feel as though I am responsible.
Lost in the Jungle#007.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#008.src: You Wynn warriors, however... great stories are told of your exploits. Surely, you will be able to brave the jungle, yes?
Lost in the Jungle#008.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#009.src: I beg of you, please, find my son. I do not know quite where he is, but undoubtedly he has been taken quite a ways in...
Lost in the Jungle#009.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#010.src: Hm... I just now am seeing a strange trail on the ground... it matches the color of the gemstone! It may take you to him, please, follow it!
Lost in the Jungle#010.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#012.src: P-please, I beg of you spirit, let me go free! The tribesmen must be so worried-
Lost in the Jungle#012.speaker: Aryn

Lost in the Jungle#013.src: DO NOT RESIST, BOY! YOUR BODY IS MINE. I WAS TRAPPED IN THAT STONE FOR MILLENIA, AND NOW I AM FREE.
Lost in the Jungle#013.speaker: Aryn?

Lost in the Jungle#014.src: Aha, I hear someone coming! Surely a tribesman here to rescue me!
Lost in the Jungle#014.speaker: Aryn

Lost in the Jungle#015.src: Oh! If so, the body of this warrior will be far better suited to my needs! Grant me your power, boy! I need to thrash them first to possess them!
Lost in the Jungle#015.speaker: Aryn?

Lost in the Jungle#017.src: Make sure Aryn is safe at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Lost in the Jungle#018.src: Hahah, take that, evil wraith! You'll never match the power of our tribe-
Lost in the Jungle#018.speaker: Aryn

Lost in the Jungle#019.src: W-wait, you aren't part of our tribe! Who are you, why did you come here?
Lost in the Jungle#019.speaker: Aryn

Lost in the Jungle#020.src: Oh... my father sent you? Well, I am very impressed, Wynn warrior. You fight with ferocity of our own!
Lost in the Jungle#020.speaker: Aryn

Lost in the Jungle#021.src: I...can't say the same for myself. That spirit completely overtook me, I still can't move right now...
Lost in the Jungle#021.speaker: Aryn

Lost in the Jungle#022.src: For now, please. Take away this gemstone. It caused all this, I don't want to be near such a bad luck charm.
Lost in the Jungle#022.speaker: Aryn

Lost in the Jungle#023.src: Tell the tribe that I will return on my own. I made it back once, I can do it again once I am prepared.
Lost in the Jungle#023.speaker: Aryn

Lost in the Jungle#024.src: Bring the Mysterious Gemstone to Gracen at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Lost in the Jungle#025.src: Oh my... Aryn was possessed by a spirit residing within the gemstone?
Lost in the Jungle#025.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#026.src: How shameful... Our shaman has never been wrong before, why did I disregard his warning...
Lost in the Jungle#026.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#027.src: But that is beside the point. You say you have destroyed the spirit and it does not feel tainted any longer, so I will trust you.
Lost in the Jungle#027.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#028.src: Looking at it now, this is actually quite a valuable stone. If crushed to dust, it can be used in special charms we make.
Lost in the Jungle#028.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#029.src: Here, allow me to grind this down for you. You can keep the shards for whatever purposes you may find for them in the future.
Lost in the Jungle#029.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#030.src: Our tribe, and especially myself... We thank you for your service. We shall consider you one of our own, from this day forward.
Lost in the Jungle#030.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#031.src: In fact, if you'd like, you may even enter my house here whenever you'd like.
Lost in the Jungle#031.speaker: Gracen

Lost Royalty#001.src: Talk to the Mercenary Leader in their hideout outside {p}

Lost Royalty#002.src: Go to the jungle temple and retrieve the talisman at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Lost Royalty#003.src: Bring the talisman back to the Mercenary Leader.

Lost Royalty#004.src: Talk to the Prince of {p} in the jail cell

Lost Royalty#005.src: Report back to Yavlis with the news

Lost Soles#001.src: Bring back Abysso Galoshes, received during the quest Beneath the Depths.

Lost Soles#002.src: Visit the mansion dining room and ask Grandon about the book

Lost Soles#003.src: "The face above the hall owns the nose that needs to be heavier to open the way"

Lost Soles#004.src: Talk to Grandon and tell him about your findings

Lost Soles#005.src: "The carpet of different colour will show you the stone to reveal the tables secret"

Lost Soles#006.src: Talk to Grandon and tell him about your findings

Lost Soles#007.src: "Throw something behind the map on the wall to uncover a piece of the code"

Lost Soles#008.src: Open the secret passage above the flags by reaching into the unwanted hole

Lost Soles#009.src: Bring back [[Boot Container|[{~} Boot Container]]] and [[Abysso Galoshes|[Abysso Galoshes]]] to Ferndor

Lost Tower#001.src: Hey adventurer! Would you mind helping me for a second? I have a bit of a problem on my hands.
Lost Tower#001.speaker: Laen

Lost Tower#002.src: A while ago, before {p} was destroyed, my family used to own quite an interesting book, that held knowledge of places and beings of great power.
Lost Tower#002.speaker: Laen

Lost Tower#003.src: Unfortunately, a creature stole it from them during the attack that led to the destruction of {p}, and no one has seen it since.
Lost Tower#003.speaker: Laen

Lost Tower#004.src: If you are willing to help, bring me [{~} Book of the Bones], I believe this book is now between the hands of skeletons, in an old tower in {p}.
Lost Tower#004.speaker: Laen

Lost Tower#005.src: See if you can find this tower, one of the skeletons probably has the book somewhere in there.
Lost Tower#005.speaker: Laen

Lost Tower#006.src: Find the lost tower in {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Lost Tower#007.src: Find the book in the tower, and bring it back to Laen.

Lost Tower#008.src: Bring back the book to Laen.

Lost Tower#009.src: Great! This will be very interesting to read, thank you!
Lost Tower#009.speaker: Laen

Maltic's Well#000.src: Talk to Rynend located in {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Maltic's Well#001.src: Please help us! We called for a {p} guard days ago, but Humans tend to forget this little village.
Maltic's Well#001.speaker: Rynend

Maltic's Well#002.src: Last week, an evil witch found refuge in our old well. Normally this wouldn't be a problem...
Maltic's Well#002.speaker: Rynend

Maltic's Well#003.src: But she's lured my child into the well! My only child! He was born in Wynn, that makes him a Wynn citizen!
Maltic's Well#003.speaker: Rynend

Maltic's Well#004.src: Please do something! I know {p} isn't of importance to you humans, being a Villager settlement, but...my son!
Maltic's Well#004.speaker: Rynend

Maltic's Well#005.src: Investigate the old {p} well at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and bring [[Witch's Empty Bottle|[{~} Witch's Empty Bottle]]] to Rynend

Maltic's Well#006.src: Help me! Someone! The witch is being mean!!
Maltic's Well#006.speaker: Child

Maltic's Well#007.src: I wondered when they'd send the famous {p} guards. You'll never get me!
Maltic's Well#007.speaker: Witch

Maltic's Well#008.src: I don't know why they call me a witch. Magic is everywhere, you know. This one's father made fun of my looks, so I'll turn his son into a Grook!
Maltic's Well#008.speaker: Witch

Maltic's Well#009.src: Treat me like a witch, I'll act like one, darn it! You'll have to pass through my dastardly magical defenses to find me!
Maltic's Well#009.speaker: Witch

Maltic's Well#010.src: Oh...drat. I never could get that spell right. Well, now you'll have to guess the way, um, you fool! Turn back now, for, uh...
Maltic's Well#010.speaker: Witch

Maltic's Well#011.src: ...for if you choose the wrong door, you'll be sent to a beast, a beast most foul! The, um...the Beast-What-Eats-{p}-Guards-For-Brunch!! Totally!
Maltic's Well#011.speaker: Witch

Maltic's Well#012.src: Oh...didn't think that'd fool you. You know, I'm really not all that good at magic. I just like wearing pointy hats, and have warts.
Maltic's Well#012.speaker: Witch

Maltic's Well#013.src: Maybe if the people of this village weren't so mean to me, I wouldn't have been forced to live here.
Maltic's Well#013.speaker: Witch

Maltic's Well#014.src: I know it's a crime, but his father and the rest of the villagers here hunt me like I'm a rabid dog!
Maltic's Well#014.speaker: Witch

Maltic's Well#015.src: I wasn't really going to turn this boy into a Grook. I doubt I could even make him grow one feather. I mean, watch...
Maltic's Well#015.speaker: Witch

Maltic's Well#017.src: ...oh my gosh it worked???? It worked, I did a spell for once in my miserable life!!
Maltic's Well#017.speaker: Witch

Maltic's Well#018.src: W-Wait, that's not good at all, you're gonna... No! You won't take me out of here alive!
Maltic's Well#018.speaker: Witch

Maltic's Well#019.src: Thank you for saving me from the witch... She was nice at first and made me cookies, but I want to go home now.
Maltic's Well#019.speaker: Child

Maltic's Well#020.src: Oh my son! What happened down there? Erh, not a witch, you say?
Maltic's Well#020.speaker: Rynend

Maltic's Well#021.src: Preposterous! She wore a hat and had warts! I guess it's too late now... Thank you so much for your help.
Maltic's Well#021.speaker: Rynend

Maltic's Well#022.src: I have very little to offer you as reward... I hope my appreciation will be more than enough!
Maltic's Well#022.speaker: Rynend

Mushroom Man#001.src: , hello! This place is really nice, isn't it? I'd like to stay a while longer before moving on towards {p}, but I'll be ready soon.
Mushroom Man#001.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#002.src: In the meantime, I've been thinking about what we could do to help this place... I've maybe got something.
Mushroom Man#002.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#003.src: Take a look at that villager over there. He's acting a little off, like he's got something going on. I wonder...
Mushroom Man#003.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#004.src: Alright, I've decided. I'm feeling a little restless, so let's go over there and see if there's anything we can help with!
Mushroom Man#004.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#005.src: Maybe we can leave this place better off than it was when we got here!
Mushroom Man#005.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#006.src: Speak to the strange man at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Mushroom Man#007.src: G-... Hi! H-how can I help you on this... this p-perfectly fine and n-n-normal day!
Mushroom Man#007.speaker: Yahya

Mushroom Man#008.src: Sorry to interrupt- we're soldiers traveling through this town, and you looked like the sort of person who might need the kind of help soldiers can provide. Anything we can help with?
Mushroom Man#008.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#009.src: O-oh! No, t-there's nothing going on. Not a th-thing. My m-m-mushroms are... they're fine. Why are you a-asking? Ev-... everything is g-great. W-Why wouldn't it b-be?
Mushroom Man#009.speaker: Yahya

Mushroom Man#010.src: ...O-okay, fine, y-you caught me! My mushrooms... my m-mushrooms aren't fine! T-they're bad, even! A-are you hap-... happy now?
Mushroom Man#010.speaker: Yahya

Mushroom Man#011.src: Ehm- no, but that's why we're here! Is there anything we can do to help your... uh. Your mushrooms?
Mushroom Man#011.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#012.src: Hm. One soldier, two s-soldier... Y-you look weak. I've s-seen str-... stronger. B-But- eheh, the- the s-stronger soldiers are... not here. Y-you'll be good enough. Maybe.
Mushroom Man#012.speaker: Yahya

Mushroom Man#013.src: I- my favorite mushroom spot. I c-can't use it any-... anymore. Spiders. L-lots of spiders. They've t-t-taken over it... I can't get... mushrooms. Can y-you kill the s-s-spiders? Mushrooms.
Mushroom Man#013.speaker: Yahya

Mushroom Man#014.src: We can kill spiders! Right, ? Come on, this is what we're here to do! We became soldiers to help the people of Wynn, didn't we? We'll help you get your mushrooms back sir.
Mushroom Man#014.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#015.src: H-hm. Good. I can't m-make soup without... mushrooms. F-follow me, I'll take you to the-... the spiders. B-bad spiders.
Mushroom Man#015.speaker: Yahya

Mushroom Man#016.src: Follow Yahya to his infested mushroom patch at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Mushroom Man#017.src: H-here we are. I- I can f-feel the m-m-mushrooms... from here. And the s-spiders! No-... no good.
Mushroom Man#017.speaker: Yahya

Mushroom Man#018.src: S-so! Mushrooms. Those-... those bad c-creepy c-crawly s-s-spiders... Kill them. P-please?
Mushroom Man#018.speaker: Yahya

Mushroom Man#019.src: We wouldn't have come here if we weren't planning to. Alright, , let's clear out some spiders!
Mushroom Man#019.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#020.src: Clear out the spiders from Yahya's favorite mushroom patch at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], then return and talk to Yahya.

Mushroom Man#021.src: I-is it done? S-s-spiders... No m-more spiders? Is my m-m-mushroom patch cl-... cleared?
Mushroom Man#021.speaker: Yahya

Mushroom Man#022.src: Looks cleared to me. These are... uh... some fine mushrooms!
Mushroom Man#022.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#023.src: Th-thank you soldiers! Th-that was-... I mean. I-it was f-fine, I g-... guess.
Mushroom Man#023.speaker: Yahya

Mushroom Man#024.src: ...O-oh. Do I n-need to pay you... now? Heh. Is- is [[Emeralds|[{~} Emeralds]]] fine with y-you..?
Mushroom Man#024.speaker: Yahya

Mushroom Man#026.src: Oho okay, ok-... okay! It was a joke, don't get all ex-... ex-... excited. Here, just take-
Mushroom Man#026.speaker: Yahya

Mushroom Man#030.src: I-... This is bad. This is really bad. We need to tell the Mayor, now.
Mushroom Man#030.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#031.src: Return to Mayor Alvin at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] with news about the spiders.

Mushroom Man#032.src: Ah, hello travelers. You seem to be in a rush- has something happened?
Mushroom Man#032.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Mushroom Man#033.src: Yes! Yes, something- something has happened. We went with Yahya to help him with a problem he was having with spiders-
Mushroom Man#033.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#034.src: Yes, yes, I know of Yahya's antics... He doesn't seem to be with you. Has he ran off on you, just as Ope did?
Mushroom Man#034.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Mushroom Man#035.src: No- no. When we finished clearing out the spiders, we were swarmed- and they took him!
Mushroom Man#035.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#036.src: ...Oh. Oh, dear. That isn't good at all. If they're making moves such as this, unprovoked...
Mushroom Man#036.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Mushroom Man#037.src: You two are soldiers, yes? I would ask you to continue your travels to {p}. Find an Admiral Aegis- tell him our little village needs aid.
Mushroom Man#037.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Mushroom Man#038.src: I-... of course. We'll set out immediately. Come on, .
Mushroom Man#038.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#039.src: Travel to {p} to request the help of their military at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Mushroom Man#042.src: Another one of these? We've fought one of them before, we can do it again!
Mushroom Man#042.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#043.src: Phew. I think that went about as well as it could have!
Mushroom Man#043.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#044.src: We're both in one piece, the corrupted is dead... Good. That's good!
Mushroom Man#044.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#045.src: Let's keep moving towards {p}. I don't think it's too much further, if we keep heading east from here.
Mushroom Man#045.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#047.src: Why'd you just leave me there? If we couldn't fight that thing off together, what made you think I could do it alone?
Mushroom Man#047.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#048.src: I managed to get away, but... still. What if I couldn't? Would you have just left me for dead?
Mushroom Man#048.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#049.src: ...Whatever. I'm alive, you're alive... that's probably good enough. Let's go find Admiral Aegis
Mushroom Man#049.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#050.src: ...Oh, , you're awake! I was really worried there for a bit...
Mushroom Man#050.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#051.src: After you went down, I managed to hold my own long enough for some nearby soldiers to arrive and help. I can't thank Lieutenant Van enough.
Mushroom Man#051.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#052.src: We, uh... brought you back here to rest up. Aledar's around here somewhere, I think.
Mushroom Man#052.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#053.src: Oh, I spoke to Admiral Aegis about the spider problem already. He said he wants to speak to you about it, too. He should be downstairs
Mushroom Man#053.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#054.src: ...and that's how we managed to defeat that undead swarm, sir!
Mushroom Man#054.speaker: Aledar

Mushroom Man#055.src: That's good to hear. Thank you for your work, Aledar. I'll speak to Lieutenant Van and see if he'd be willing to take you into his squad.
Mushroom Man#055.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Mushroom Man#056.src: Thank you for the opportunity, sir. I won't let you down-... Wait, is that- Tasim and ?
Mushroom Man#056.speaker: Aledar

Mushroom Man#057.src: Aledar! We've finally made it to {p}. We've had... something of an adventure, getting here.
Mushroom Man#057.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#058.src: Ah, you two must be the recruits Aledar has been telling us all about. It's good to finally meet you, though I can't help but notice you seem to have arrived in a rush.
Mushroom Man#058.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Mushroom Man#059.src: Right! Right. We've arrived from Nivla Town, with bad news and a request for aid. The spiders of the forest have grown hostile, and threaten the town.
Mushroom Man#059.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#060.src: One of their townsfolk was captured and taken away in front of our eyes. Mayor Alvin sent us here to request the aid of {p}' army.
Mushroom Man#060.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#061.src: Bad news, indeed. Very well, we will make preparations. For the time being, the two of you should rest and hone your skills. Captain Ragon here in the barracks would gladly offer some training.
Mushroom Man#061.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Mushroom Man#062.src: Thank you, sir. But is there anything we could do to actually help?
Mushroom Man#062.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#063.src: Enthusiastic, aren't you! Let me think... I believe Captain Fenor out by the west gate was looking for aid. If you're willing, I'd suggest you speak with him.
Mushroom Man#063.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Mushroom Man#064.src: And Lieutenant Van is planning a raid on a corrupt stronghold! I'm sure he'd be glad to have more forces with them.
Mushroom Man#064.speaker: Aledar

Mushroom Man#065.src: Yes, yes. Well, I must be off. If the threat of Nivla's spiders is growing... we must prepare accordingly. I hope to hear of your future endeavors, all three of you.
Mushroom Man#065.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Mushroom Man#066.src: ...so, Captain, what do you think? We'll need to start training soldiers more quickly, but I hope that won't be a problem.
Mushroom Man#066.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Mushroom Man#067.src: Of course, Admiral, I'll see what I can do.
Mushroom Man#067.speaker: Captain Ragon

Mushroom Man#068.src: Excellent. Now- ah, . Good to see you're up and about again. You gave us quite a shock!
Mushroom Man#068.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Mushroom Man#069.src: Van tells me that goliath the two of you faced was a dangerous foe. He was impressed you managed to damage it as much as you did, even if you ended up needing rescue.
Mushroom Man#069.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Mushroom Man#070.src: Now, to business. We've already begun planning for our assault on the spiders, but we'll need more well-trained soldiers. Captain Ragon here should be able to help you hone your skills.
Mushroom Man#070.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Mushroom Man#071.src: And if we wanted to help out, sir? I'm getting a little stir-crazy in here.
Mushroom Man#071.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#072.src: Enthusiastic, aren't you! Let me think... I believe Captain Fenor out by the west gate was looking for aid. If you're willing, I suggest you speak with him.
Mushroom Man#072.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Mushroom Man#073.src: In addition, Lieutenant Van was highly impressed by your fight with the goliath! He told me to pass on that he'd appreciate your help in a raid he's planning on a nearby corrupted stronghold. I believe your friend Aledar was involved.
Mushroom Man#073.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Mushroom Man#074.src: With that, I must be off. We have many preparations to make, and the enemy never rests. I hope to hear of your future endeavors, both of you.
Mushroom Man#074.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Pit of the Dead (Quest)#001.src: Would you like to hear the tale of the pit of the dead?
Pit of the Dead (Quest)#001.speaker: Merloni

Pit of the Dead (Quest)#002.src: It is the pit where the corpses of the poor miners who discovered the Portal by the {p} are buried.
Pit of the Dead (Quest)#002.speaker: Merloni

Pit of the Dead (Quest)#003.src: Those that had not already died had to be executed due to the insanity brought on from the corruption.
Pit of the Dead (Quest)#003.speaker: Merloni

Pit of the Dead (Quest)#004.src: Their spirits still haunt the grave and infect the minds of people who disturb them. It isn't pretty.
Pit of the Dead (Quest)#004.speaker: Merloni

Pit of the Dead (Quest)#005.src: However, I heard rumours of those who were able to bathe in their waters and be accepted by them, to show no fear of the dead is to be admired.
Pit of the Dead (Quest)#005.speaker: Merloni

Pit of the Dead (Quest)#006.src: Maybe this shrine that I keep hearing about has something to do with it? It's apparently hidden deep inside the pit.
Pit of the Dead (Quest)#006.speaker: Merloni

Pit of the Dead (Quest)#007.src: Soldier, the pit is located south east of {p}, across the bridge behind us. I will write down the coordinates inside your quest book.
Pit of the Dead (Quest)#007.speaker: Merloni

Pit of the Dead (Quest)#008.src: Enter the pit. Learn it's mysteries, then come back to me.
Pit of the Dead (Quest)#008.speaker: Merloni

Pit of the Dead (Quest)#009.src: Explore the pit at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] and find the shrine

Pit of the Dead (Quest)#010.src: Go back to {p} and tell Merloni that you succeeded

Pit of the Dead (Quest)#011.src: Very impressive! Here's your reward. I found it a while ago while walking around {p}. It probably fell off a skeleton!
Pit of the Dead (Quest)#011.speaker: Merloni
