Purple and Blue#001.src: W-Woah there, short nose! What are you doing, barging into my home?!
Purple and Blue#001.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#002.src: Did {p} send you? Well, welcome to {p}! I could actually make use of some assistance.
Purple and Blue#002.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#003.src: The magic here in this place is so potent; you can actually see the mystical properties!
Purple and Blue#003.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#004.src: I've been a scientist for many years, but I have never seen anything like this lake.
Purple and Blue#004.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#005.src: That's why I set up a small laboratory and started living here to study the place. It's pretty rudimentary but it does the job done.
Purple and Blue#005.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#006.src: The deeper into the lake you dive, the stronger the magical power becomes. I think something strange is happening at the heart of the lake. I believe a lot of answers lie inside.
Purple and Blue#006.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#007.src: Alright, that's enough context! You see, there's another... "scientist" across the lake. We're kind of rivals? The guy's awful, I hate him, AND... Well...
Purple and Blue#007.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#009.src: And while I somewhat hope he's gotten himself in trouble, he might've figured out something about the lake.
Purple and Blue#009.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#010.src: I suspect he's gone in to the heart of the lake... Come with me a moment, please.
Purple and Blue#010.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#011.src: Alright, this leads underwater where the heart is. How about you try and enter?
Purple and Blue#011.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#012.src: ...just as I thought, you can't get in just like me. We'll need to gather more information.
Purple and Blue#012.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#013.src: Human, investigate Nikoler's house for me. It's north down the coast.
Purple and Blue#013.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#014.src: Where could he be... There's no way he found access to- Hey!
Purple and Blue#014.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#015.src: Don't just listen to me mumbling! Have you found Nikoler?!
Purple and Blue#015.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#016.src: Investigate Nikoler's house for clues at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Purple and Blue#017.src: Follow the hints in the cellar to the mysterious cave.

Purple and Blue#018.src: Enter and explore the mysterious cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Purple and Blue#019.src: Return to Korun in his home at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Purple and Blue#020.src: Y-you've actually found a lead?! There was clues in his basement? And you found a... talisman? This must be it, then!
Purple and Blue#020.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#021.src: This might very well be the key to enter the heart, especially if it was as well-guarded with cosmic creatures as you say.
Purple and Blue#021.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#022.src: Alright then! This might be too dangerous for me, so I'm entrusting this task to you once more. Enter the tunnel in my basement, and explore as much as you can!
Purple and Blue#022.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#023.src: If you can bring me samples of any kind, I'll try to reward you handsomely. However, if you find Nikoler alive... Please bring him back.
Purple and Blue#023.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#024.src: As for the talisman, make sure to hold it whilst in the tunnel. Be careful, you're in uncharted territory from now on.
Purple and Blue#024.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#025.src: Good luck, human. Please bring me back Nikoler, or any sample you might find.
Purple and Blue#025.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#026.src: Enter the heart of Gylia from under the lake.

Purple and Blue#028.src: The drill should be ready by now... In just a little bit, I'll have single-handedly conquered the heart of the mountain...!

Purple and Blue#029.src: A human!? W...What? Did you read the notes I left for Korun? I'll have you know that's theft!! I - you...!
Purple and Blue#029.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#030.src: Don't get any closer!! I'll destroy the path if I have to!!
Purple and Blue#030.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#031.src: This is MY story! Don't you dare interfere!!
Purple and Blue#031.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#032.src: You're... persistent. Are you trying to steal from these meteors I'VE found?! Do you have any idea how much research I did to get this far??
Purple and Blue#032.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#033.src: It's too late! I've already drilled a piece. Once I show Korun, I'll be known as the better researcher...
Purple and Blue#033.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#036.src: No no no no no no! This CAN'T be happening!
Purple and Blue#036.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#037.src: Tampering with the meteors must be making the cave instable! I... I thought this'd happen and yet-
Purple and Blue#037.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#038.src: This is all YOUR fault! Why'd you have to come and make me panic? We're both DOOMED!
Purple and Blue#038.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#039.src: No... I can't die here, I can't die now, what will he think...
Purple and Blue#039.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#040.src: I... We might have a shot at escaping... And then, human, I'll report you to the authorities!!
Purple and Blue#040.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#041.src: I'm STUCK! Urgh... No... Not like this, please, not like this...
Purple and Blue#041.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#042.src: You... Why? You came to get me? Not the... meteors?
Purple and Blue#042.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#043.src: I... Fine then. Let's make a run for it, human!
Purple and Blue#043.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#045.src: Rats! That dynamite went and backfired on us! Quick, try to run in to the rubble with me, we need to hurry!
Purple and Blue#045.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#047.src: Welcome back! I see you're completely drenched! How did things go? I assume you explored the place thoroughly.
Purple and Blue#047.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#049.src: ...were you worrying about me? What a fool. This mountain could never do so much as scratch me!
Purple and Blue#049.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#050.src: This human right here actually saved me, right after endangering me. You don't mean to tell me you sent him for me?
Purple and Blue#050.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#051.src: Well, it's very simple. Where's the fun in our rivalry if you just go off and die somewhere?
Purple and Blue#051.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#052.src: That aside, what did you find in there? What happened?
Purple and Blue#052.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#053.src: I found them, Korun. I found the meteors! The still seemed potent somehow, but the cave collapsed and...
Purple and Blue#053.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#054.src: That's... fine. We can always go back and try clearing the rubble. There's always opportunities to take a hold of. Next time, please don't just go off on your own!
Purple and Blue#054.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#055.src: Human, you made the right choice... Without Nikoler, our efforts would have been in vain. I'll try to work with him a bit more, as it seems the logical course of action now. Thank you.
Purple and Blue#055.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#057.src: I see you're completely drenched! There's this odd aura around you... What happened?
Purple and Blue#057.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#058.src: You... You actually found a meteor shard! That's amazing! That's... that's... um...
Purple and Blue#058.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#059.src: Uh, what did you say j-just now? The cave collapsed and Nikoler d-died...?
Purple and Blue#059.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#060.src: That's, um, haha... That doesn't sound right, he can't die, he can't leave like that, he can't-
Purple and Blue#060.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#061.src: S-Sorry. I'm just a little shocked is all. I do have to thank you for the shard...
Purple and Blue#061.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#062.src: A-at the very least, you saw this through... I have to commend you for that... I think.
Purple and Blue#062.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#063.src: Just take these, and go. I have much to think about.
Purple and Blue#063.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#064.src: You explored thoroughly, and couldn't find a shard? Well, we still have much to discover I suppose.
Purple and Blue#064.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#065.src: Uh, what did you say j-just now? The cave collapsed and Nikoler d-died..?
Purple and Blue#065.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#066.src: That's, um, haha... That doesn't sound right, he can't die, he can't leave like that, he can't-
Purple and Blue#066.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#067.src: S-Sorry. I'm just a little shocked is all. And you came back empty-handed... This was just a loss with everyone involved.
Purple and Blue#067.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#068.src: A-at the very least, you saw this through... I have to commend you for that... I think.
Purple and Blue#068.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#069.src: Just take these, and go. I have much to think about.
Purple and Blue#069.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#070.src: I see you're completely drenched, so I suppose you thoroughly explored the place. How did it go?
Purple and Blue#070.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#071.src: You found... Nothing? Really? And the meteors were too unstable to temper with?
Purple and Blue#071.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#072.src: Actually, how would you know about tempering with the- wait...
Purple and Blue#072.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#073.src: Did you find him? Please... please tell me you found him, there's no way he'd die just like that. I...
Purple and Blue#073.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#074.src: W-what? The whole cave COLLAPSED on him? And you couldn't even save him?! N-no, it can't be your fault, I... I'm sorry.
Purple and Blue#074.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#075.src: This is all way too much to take in for me, but I suppose you've explored and served the purpose I gave you.
Purple and Blue#075.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#076.src: Here's your reward, then. Now please, just leave me be. There's a lot I have to think about.
Purple and Blue#076.speaker: Korun

Purple and Blue#077.src: It's you! Glad to have crossed paths again!
Purple and Blue#077.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#078.src: Since the incident, I've decided to start fishing as a hobby.
Purple and Blue#078.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#079.src: Take this- for all I care, you can own this!
Purple and Blue#079.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#081.src: Check up on Korun from time to time for me, will you?
Purple and Blue#081.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#082.src: I'm still taking a break from all the science stuff... But he definitely hasn't seen the last of me!
Purple and Blue#082.speaker: Nikoler

Purple and Blue#083.src: After all, I'm the one who got to the heart of the mountain! I'm even able to sleep soundly knowing that I've won...
Purple and Blue#083.speaker: Nikoler

Queen's Recruit#000.src: Tasim is looking to catch up in {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Queen's Recruit#002.src: Travel to the Gate of Fruma at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] or meet up with Tasim in {p}.

Queen's Recruit#003.src: Meet up with the group at the gate at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Queen's Recruit#004.src: Listen to the introduction. Go to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to return to the palace.

Queen's Recruit#005.src: Head to the royal dining hall at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].

Queen's Recruit#006.src: Get your assigned room from the representative at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].

Queen's Recruit#007.src: Head to your room, W-{~}, and check it out.

Queen's Recruit#008.src: Meet up with the others in room W-{~} at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].

Queen's Recruit#009.src: Make your way back to W-{~} and sleep.

Queen's Recruit#010.src: Find the location of the tournament in the northern side of the palace at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].

Queen's Recruit#011.src: Begin your fight against Mel in the southern waiting room.

Queen's Recruit#012.src: Leave the arena waiting room and find Picard at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].

Recipe For Disaster#000.src: Meet up with Chef Hamsey in {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Recipe For Disaster#001.src: Ah, bonjour! Welcome to my restaurant, allow me to lead you to your seat-
Recipe For Disaster#001.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#002.src: Oh do my eyes deceive me? Serais-ce possible?!
Recipe For Disaster#002.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#003.src: It is you... the novice soldier turned hero of legends! Who would have thought?!
Recipe For Disaster#003.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#004.src: I have heard tales of your exploits across the lands, mon ami! Je suis honore! Someone like you sitting in my restaurant!
Recipe For Disaster#004.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#005.src: Je suis, bien sur... Le Chef Hamsey! Famed across the lands for my flavors, as you are for your weapon!
Recipe For Disaster#005.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#006.src: I boast, I boast. Je peu t'offrir un plat... but perhaps I have a different proposition for us both.
Recipe For Disaster#006.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#007.src: You may have mastered the art of battle, my friend, but what of... L'Art de la Cuisine?!
Recipe For Disaster#007.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#008.src: Follow me into the kitchen behind me, and I will tell you more.
Recipe For Disaster#008.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#009.src: Find Chef Hamsey in his kitchen.

Recipe For Disaster#010.src: Welcome to my kitchen! C'est beau, non?
Recipe For Disaster#010.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#011.src: It may be on fire, but... que serais la Cuisine sans une touche de danger, eh?!
Recipe For Disaster#011.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#012.src: So, back to the challenge. What do you say to a bit of friendly competition, hehe?
Recipe For Disaster#012.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#013.src: You can work with one of my three best chefs on a dish and present it to me once you're done!
Recipe For Disaster#013.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#014.src: I, of course, will judge your dish based on the twenty-nine Principes de Cuisine - texture, presentation, originality...
Recipe For Disaster#014.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#015.src: ... aroma, magical ability... oh, and flavour!
Recipe For Disaster#015.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#016.src: S'il te plait! Go introduce yourself to each of my chefs and return once you have decided who to work with!
Recipe For Disaster#016.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#017.src: Speak to all three chefs in Hamsey's kitchen.

Recipe For Disaster#018.src: Heya! You must be the adventurer that Hamsey told me about. You know, he was almost ecstatic, but don't tell him I said that!
Recipe For Disaster#018.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#019.src: Oh, a cook-off? How exciting! I'll gladly help you out. Maybe this way I can prove myself a bit more to the others...?
Recipe For Disaster#019.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#020.src: If we work together, we can make a Seasoned Voidroot Stew, how does that sound?
Recipe For Disaster#020.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#021.src: You need to talk to the other chefs before deciding what to make, though!
Recipe For Disaster#021.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#022.src: Good friend of Hamsey's, are you? I'll believe it when - no, if - you somehow win this competition.
Recipe For Disaster#022.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#023.src: I don't need any amateurs like yourself getting in my way when I'm cooking up a storm!
Recipe For Disaster#023.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#024.src: Are you still here? Just... go chitchat to someone else, please.
Recipe For Disaster#024.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#025.src: Yo, dawg. Name's Frank. Hamsey said you guys go waaay back. Any friend of Hamsey's is good with me, man.
Recipe For Disaster#025.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#026.src: Nothin' too sure on what we're gonna cook yet, figure I'll dream somethin' up before the time comes.
Recipe For Disaster#026.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#027.src: Thinkin' a pie, maybe? Not too much effort there, can't go far wrong, right?
Recipe For Disaster#027.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#028.src: Talk to Hamsey and choose a chef to work with.

Recipe For Disaster#029.src: Ah, you have introduced yourself to tous mes cuisiners? Who do you want to work with?!
Recipe For Disaster#029.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#030.src: Ah, Brie! An excellent chef... and an even better cheese! I jest, I jest. You will work well together, I am certain.
Recipe For Disaster#030.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#031.src: Ah, Kale. One of my most talented chefs, though he can be stubborn at times!
Recipe For Disaster#031.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#032.src: Frank! Whilst he may seem rather... relaxed, at times, I assure you he is a most capable chef!
Recipe For Disaster#032.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#033.src: Maitenant, mon ami, head over to your chef and start cooking!
Recipe For Disaster#033.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#034.src: Talk to your chosen chef about the dish.

Recipe For Disaster#035.src: Heya again! So you decided to make the Seasoned Voidroot Stew with me? Hurray!
Recipe For Disaster#035.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#036.src: It's not quite as easy as it might seem, but I think together we'll be able to handle it.
Recipe For Disaster#036.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#037.src: Like I said before, about proving myself... I'm the newest chef here at the kitchen and some of the other chefs disapprove of my ideas. This could be my chance!
Recipe For Disaster#037.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#038.src: I've been perfecting the recipe for Voidroot Stew for months now and I finally have a chance to show everyone what I'm worth!
Recipe For Disaster#038.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#039.src: The first one is some [Snail Slime] available on Snail Island! We only need one for this dish.
Recipe For Disaster#039.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#040.src: Next up, we need some [Voidroot], a super rare root found deep in the Void. I've heard someone in the {p} can take you down there.
Recipe For Disaster#040.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#041.src: Lastly, we need some [Moonsalt], which is famously hard to obtain. Luckily, self-proclaimed 'Space Wizard' Astralaus should have some, so you can just pop over to his tower and ask for some!
Recipe For Disaster#041.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#042.src: And that should do it! I'll give you a Recipe Book, just right-click to open it up and track your ingredients. Good luck!
Recipe For Disaster#042.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#043.src: Ugh. Stay out of my way, and we'll get along just fine.
Recipe For Disaster#043.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#044.src: Make yourself useful and get me everything we need. I'm not in the mood for chit-chat.
Recipe For Disaster#044.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#045.src: I don't want my reputation tarnished by the likes of you...
Recipe For Disaster#045.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#046.src: Listen up, I'm *not* going to say this again. Take notes.
Recipe For Disaster#046.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#047.src: The key ingredient in my amazing omelette is obviously the [Blue-Ring Grook Egg], which of course you didn't know.
Recipe For Disaster#047.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#048.src: Secondly what we need is some [Snail Slime], which is at Snail Island, obviously. Any seasoned chef could tell you that.
Recipe For Disaster#048.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#049.src: Lastly you need a [Talking Mushroom] which is found on the swamp Sky Island, provided you have a functioning sense of sight.
Recipe For Disaster#049.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#050.src: YOU FORGOT ALREADY?? I TOLD YOU TO TAKE NOTES!
Recipe For Disaster#050.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#051.src: Lucky for you, at least one of us here is competent. I wrote everything down in this recipe book. Right-click to open it. Now get me my ingredients and scram!
Recipe For Disaster#051.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#052.src: Thrilled to be workin' with you, dude! We'll blow Hamsey's mind.
Recipe For Disaster#052.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#053.src: Hmmm, now what kinda pie should we be bakin', here?
Recipe For Disaster#053.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#054.src: Well, I might be a lil' lazy, but when it comes to cookin', I've got the eye. And to me, dude? You look like a real Skyhigh Pie kind of guy! Heheh.
Recipe For Disaster#054.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#055.src: Welp, guess you know how to cook up a simple Skyhigh Pie, right? Off you go, I'll be waiting here when you have the ingredients.
Recipe For Disaster#055.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#056.src: Hehe, just messin' with you, man! Shoulda seen your face.
Recipe For Disaster#056.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#057.src: First, we're gonna need some kinda flour. A lil' [Sunrise Flour] aughtta do.
Recipe For Disaster#057.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#058.src: A good-sized [Blue-Ring Grook Egg] should give us a lil' kick. Not as much as those grooks'll give you a kick if they see you pilfering their eggs, though!
Recipe For Disaster#058.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#059.src: Finally, the secret ingredient - A [Skyhigh Raspberry]. Real good stuff, but it's a fair way out. Guess a lil' walking never hurt anyone, huh? Not that I've ever bothered.
Recipe For Disaster#059.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#060.src: Huh, you've got a bad memory? Yeah, me too, man. Here's a Recipe Book, just right-click to open it up and check where to grab the ingredients!
Recipe For Disaster#060.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#061.src: Return here once you've got them all. Peace out, dude!
Recipe For Disaster#061.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#062.src: Collect [{~} {Ingredient}] at [X, Y, Z] or check your recipe book.

Recipe For Disaster#063.src: Welcome to Astralus' Astral House! Can you get to the top by flipping gravity?
Recipe For Disaster#063.speaker: Astralus

Recipe For Disaster#064.src: Astronomical progress! But this is just the beginning!
Recipe For Disaster#064.speaker: Astralus

Recipe For Disaster#065.src: ...And why did you come to my tower?
Recipe For Disaster#065.speaker: Astralus

Recipe For Disaster#066.src: My Moonsalt? How absurd! I collected mine myself, you collect yours! It's only fair.
Recipe For Disaster#066.speaker: Astralus

Recipe For Disaster#067.src: Darn humans, you never listen! I said... Get. It. Yourself.
Recipe For Disaster#067.speaker: Astralus

Recipe For Disaster#068.src: What takes you here, strangeling? What namings do you have? Hu-man? We claim Humyn! Bad choose, pick elsewhere strangeling!
Recipe For Disaster#068.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#069.src: Investigating for helping? How many conveniences! Humyns requires assistancing! You observers, humyns failflies into large crater-rock!
Recipe For Disaster#069.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#070.src: Burnmilk run out and one direction to retrieve it is moonsalt! We strike lucknugget and discover moonsalt on crater-rock!
Recipe For Disaster#070.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#071.src: Refined moonsalt gives burnmilk for spacezoom! Inconveniencing, spacezoom destroyed. Humyns create miniscule Spacezoom!
Recipe For Disaster#071.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#072.src: Only singular humyn can fit in current spacezoom. If strangeling helps humyns will let strangeling in spacezoom. Humyns can create new spacezoom in given time!
Recipe For Disaster#072.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#073.src: Humyns currently residing on crater-rock, meaning waiting is not result of death!
Recipe For Disaster#073.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#074.src: Moonsalt discovered in saltcave in north, strangeling follow path!
Recipe For Disaster#074.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#075.src: Just [{~} Unrefined Moonsalt] need for burnmilk, strangeling can grab any left over!
Recipe For Disaster#075.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#076.src: When strangeling has moonsalt, refine at device beside humyn and go zoom in spacezoom!
Recipe For Disaster#076.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#077.src: Hello aaand welcome to the Racetrack of the Century!
Recipe For Disaster#077.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#078.src: One winner, one loser. And Usnail Bolt eats losers for breakfast.
Recipe For Disaster#078.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#079.src: Breakfast? Wait, did I have breakfast? A little breckkie could be good fo-
Recipe For Disaster#079.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#080.src: Well, no matter. What do you say, adventurer? Enter the race against Usnail Bolt. The grand prize is some Snail Slime!
Recipe For Disaster#080.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#082.src: Shame, could've been a great race. See you around, adventurer!
Recipe For Disaster#082.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#083.src: Well well well... looks like Usnail Bolt has won this one. Again.
Recipe For Disaster#083.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#084.src: Not your lucky day, human. Oh well, you know the price for losing. Guards!
Recipe For Disaster#084.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#085.src: Wowee! In what turned out to be an amazing race, the human has managed to steal the lead right out from Usnail Bolt's nose!
Recipe For Disaster#085.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#086.src: Here, human. Take this slime as your prize.
Recipe For Disaster#086.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#087.src: ISN'T THIS JUST ABSOLUTELY FANTASTIC. A HUMAN?! WHO WOULD HAVE GUESSED.
Recipe For Disaster#087.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#088.src: YOU'RE THE SEVENTH ONE PASSING ME TODAY AND YOU'RE NO DIFFERENT FROM THE OTHERS.
Recipe For Disaster#088.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#089.src: EVERY SINGLE ONE WITH THAT DOPEY SHEEPISH LOOK ON THEIR FACE, AS IF A TALKING MUSHROOM IS OUT OF THE BLUE.
Recipe For Disaster#089.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#090.src: GIVE ME A BREAK, I'VE HAD ENOUGH OF JERKS PICKING ME UP AND DISRESPECTING ME LIKE THAT. PRIVATE SPACE, EVER HEARD OF IT?
Recipe For Disaster#090.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#091.src: WHY DO I EVEN TRY. JUST LOOK AT YOU! THE EPITOME OF CLUELESS. WHAT NOW, GONNA TAKE ME ON SOME LOONEY ADVENTURE ACROSS THE SKY ISLANDS?
Recipe For Disaster#091.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#092.src: I HOPE NOT, IF YOU WERE THINKING THAT. I'VE ALREADY LOST A STEM TODAY BECAUSE SOME DIMWIT TRIED TAKING A BITE OUT OF ME... LIVE!
Recipe For Disaster#092.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#093.src: DON'T TELL ME, ARE YOU TAKING ME ON SOME LOONEY ADVENTURE ACROSS THE SKY ISLANDS? HOW LOVELY.
Recipe For Disaster#093.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#094.src: A KITCHEN YOU SAY, WELL, IF IT'LL PUT ME OUT OF MY MISERY AS SOON AS POSSIBLE, THEN WHY NOT.
Recipe For Disaster#094.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#095.src: WAIT, WHY ARE YOU STUFFING ME INTO YOUR BAG? HOW DO YOU EXPECT ME TO BREATHE IN HERE?!
Recipe For Disaster#095.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#096.src: Hello there! I can see you knead you some sunrise flour, don't you?
Recipe For Disaster#096.speaker: Baker

Recipe For Disaster#097.src: It's needed rye away? Well no worries, friend!
Recipe For Disaster#097.speaker: Baker

Recipe For Disaster#098.src: Well butter me up and call me toast, it seems I ran out of the stuff, there's none left.
Recipe For Disaster#098.speaker: Baker

Recipe For Disaster#099.src: I'm sorry if I see to just be loafing around, but at yeast I know how to make some more.
Recipe For Disaster#099.speaker: Baker

Recipe For Disaster#100.src: Can you see that wheat field over there, next to the bakery? You can farm up some wheat and pop it on the mill.
Recipe For Disaster#100.speaker: Baker

Recipe For Disaster#101.src: Grab a scythe from the tool merchant next dough and get to work!
Recipe For Disaster#101.speaker: Baker

Recipe For Disaster#102.src: Make as much as you want, I've made all the bread I need for today already.
Recipe For Disaster#102.speaker: Baker

Recipe For Disaster#103.src: Howdy, pal! Looking for some Skyhigh Raspberries? They work great in a pie!
Recipe For Disaster#103.speaker: Raspberry Vendor

Recipe For Disaster#104.src: If you're interested, it's just a small fee of {~} Emeralds to get access to the island.
Recipe For Disaster#104.speaker: Raspberry Vendor

Recipe For Disaster#105.src: A man's gotta make a living somehow, so I've set up a system of cannons to take you right up to the island they grow on!
Recipe For Disaster#105.speaker: Raspberry Vendor

Recipe For Disaster#106.src: So, whaddya say? Small price for a little adventure, and as many raspberries as you can eat!
Recipe For Disaster#106.speaker: Raspberry Vendor

Recipe For Disaster#107.src: Alrighty! Just head on over to that island beside me and jump in the cannon - it's perfectly safe, I promise!
Recipe For Disaster#107.speaker: Raspberry Vendor

Recipe For Disaster#108.src: Find your way up the island and grab as many raspberries as you want! When you're done just jump in the big cannon and come back to shore!
Recipe For Disaster#108.speaker: Raspberry Vendor

Recipe For Disaster#109.src: Alrighty, no worries. Feel free to come back if you're ever in the mood for some!
Recipe For Disaster#109.speaker: Raspberry Vendor

Recipe For Disaster#110.src: Present the ingredients to your chosen chef.

Recipe For Disaster#111.src: Have you got all the ingredients? Amazing!
Recipe For Disaster#111.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#112.src: Okay you set back and let me work on the cooking, just pass over the ingredients!
Recipe For Disaster#112.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#113.src: Aha! That should do it! Hopefully I've done everything correctly... but wow, would you look at the color of that soup!
Recipe For Disaster#113.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#114.src: You should bring it over to Hamsey to see what he thinks!
Recipe For Disaster#114.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#115.src: You got everything? Took you long enough.
Recipe For Disaster#115.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#116.src: Let's get started. Everyone else already finished. Stay back while I work my magic.
Recipe For Disaster#116.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#117.src: Mwah! My masterdish is finished. Present this to the chef, I'm sure he'll love it!
Recipe For Disaster#117.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#118.src: And be CAREFUL taking it over. That food could be worth HUNDREDS once I'm famous!
Recipe For Disaster#118.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#119.src: You got everything? Awesome stuff, dude.
Recipe For Disaster#119.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#120.src: I'll just take a smallll bit of this raspberry - chef's commission, eh? And let's get started!
Recipe For Disaster#120.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#121.src: And we're all done. Hamsey's gonna love this.
Recipe For Disaster#121.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#122.src: Here you go, dawg. Pleasure working with you - show this to Hamsey and we'll see what he thinks. Make sure you don't "lose" any of it on the way over - you know what they say about your own supply!
Recipe For Disaster#122.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#123.src: Talk to Hamsey with your finished dish.

Recipe For Disaster#124.src: Ah, you have finished your dish? Well, then, il est temps de goûter!
Recipe For Disaster#124.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#125.src: Let us retreat to my private dining room... this way!
Recipe For Disaster#125.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#126.src: Meet Hamsey in the dining room at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Recipe For Disaster#127.src: Welcome back, mon ami! I see you've return with a dish in hand!
Recipe For Disaster#127.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#128.src: A stew? Seems simple, but even the simplest things in life can be le meilleur!
Recipe For Disaster#128.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#129.src: Adventurer, are you sure you made this dish? It is so good I might as well close the restaurant!
Recipe For Disaster#129.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#130.src: You never fail to surprise me, friend. Here, take this apron, an essential of any true chef.
Recipe For Disaster#130.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#131.src: I cannot help but notice that your dish is ready!
Recipe For Disaster#131.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#132.src: Let me taste your dish and I will present you mine! Mon dieu, une omelette?
Recipe For Disaster#132.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#133.src: Je suis déçu, ami. I would prefer biting into a mule derrière! This thing... a Gert wouldn't touch it!
Recipe For Disaster#133.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#134.src: I see you haven't improved in the art of cuisine. Leave me be, and come back when you have learned what good food is!
Recipe For Disaster#134.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#135.src: I see you've returned, and not empty handed. Please, show me what you've created!
Recipe For Disaster#135.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#136.src: A pie? Why, you must have been helped by Frank. He always has a thing for making pie!
Recipe For Disaster#136.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#137.src: I can see that your compétences culinaires are very well developed!
Recipe For Disaster#137.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#138.src: Though I will not truly call you a chef quite yet, you are très bien! Have this reward as congratulations!
Recipe For Disaster#138.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Supply and Delivery#066.src: You may feel free to use it whenever you like! As thanks for all you have done for us.
Supply and Delivery#066.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#067.src: He's... difficult. He's the son of my sister, who was unfortunately killed by spiders some time ago.
Supply and Delivery#067.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#068.src: With his father out of the picture, I had to take him in. He's a grown man now, yes, but... I fear the loss has taken a toll on us both.
Supply and Delivery#068.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#069.src: I truly hope he will cease with these ridiculous ploys sometime soon... but I can't bring myself to do more than give him a stern talking to.
Supply and Delivery#069.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#070.src: He's a good man, truly. I believe that with my whole heart. It's alright if you don't feel the same way, though. I will not force you to interact with him if you do not wish to.
Supply and Delivery#070.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#071.src: Oh, dear... I suppose it must have been fifteen years ago that I took the position, when the old mayor stepped down.
Supply and Delivery#071.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#072.src: He was a kind man, always looking out for the townsfolk. Though, by the time he retired, it was clear he was growing restless in our little town.
Supply and Delivery#072.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#073.src: Well, as soon as he passed down the position to me, he immediately traveled to {p} and enlisted in their army! I hear he's in the business of training soldiers these days.
Supply and Delivery#073.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#074.src: Ah, but I've tried lived up to his legacy. I like to think I've done well in my time as mayor!
Supply and Delivery#074.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#075.src: A fine day for passing through! I hope you enjoy your stay.
Supply and Delivery#075.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Taking the Tower#000.src: Speak to Aledar in the {p} Barracks at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Taking the Tower#001.src: Oh, ! Hey! It's good to see you and Tasim again. Hope you didn't have too many adventures without me!
Taking the Tower#001.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#002.src: Tasim's gone off to the training room, if you were looking for him. He's really jumping straight into it, which... is good! We all need to get stronger so we can defend the province.
Taking the Tower#002.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#003.src: Tasim told me all about the corrupted force you took out. I wish I could have been there to help!
Taking the Tower#003.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#004.src: ...Oh! Since you're here- I was about to head out to join Lieutenant Van's squad to take back a tower overtaken by corrupteds. You should come with us, too!
Taking the Tower#004.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#005.src: Well? What do you think? Want to get some real combat experience? It shouldn't take long.
Taking the Tower#005.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#006.src: Perfect. Well, no time better than the present! Let's get going.
Taking the Tower#006.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#007.src: Oh, wait. There's a stop we've got to make first. Follow me to the Powder Master!
Taking the Tower#007.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#009.src: Well, I'll still be here for a while. If you change your mind, let me know!
Taking the Tower#009.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#010.src: Hey, you're back! Have you changed you mind? Want to join a raid on a corrupted tower?
Taking the Tower#010.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#011.src: Follow Aledar to the Powder Master at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Taking the Tower#012.src: Alright, so. There's something I've been told about the tower we're going to be attacking which we can prepare for!
Taking the Tower#012.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#013.src: Apparently, the big bad at the top of the tower is weak to damage! And so, here we are at the Powder Master.
Taking the Tower#013.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#014.src: You can apply various elemental powders to your weapons here, which lets them deal types of damage they might not have been able to before.
Taking the Tower#014.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#015.src: In this case, you can apply a powder, so that your weapon will be more effective against the corrupted enemies at the tower!
Taking the Tower#015.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#016.src: I, uh... don't remember the whole elemental speech off the top of my head. If you want to know more about those, you'll have to talk to Captain Ragon in the barracks. He has a whole course about it!
Taking the Tower#016.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#017.src: ...The point is- here. Take this elemental powder and talk to the Powder Master to apply it. Let me know when you're done!
Taking the Tower#017.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#018.src: Apply a Water Powder to your weapon, then let Aledar know at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Taking the Tower#019.src: Got the powder on your weapon? Good, that means we're ready.
Taking the Tower#019.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#020.src: Lieutenant Van and the others are by that bunch of houses in the {p} Suburbs- you probably saw it on your way in.
Taking the Tower#020.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#021.src: Lead the way! I'll be right behind you.
Taking the Tower#021.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#022.src: Meet up with Lieutenant Van's squad near the Raging Tower at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Taking the Tower#023.src: Ah, Aledar! Good to see you here. Who's this with you?
Taking the Tower#023.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taking the Tower#024.src: This is , sir. They're here to join our assault, if you'll allow it.
Taking the Tower#024.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#025.src: Hm... Well, I don't see why not. The more the merrier, that's what I say.
Taking the Tower#025.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taking the Tower#026.src: If everyone's here, we can begin. Here's the plan! We'll need to fight off some of the forces near the base of the tower, so that someone can climb to the top.
Taking the Tower#026.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taking the Tower#027.src: It doesn't matter who does the job, so long as it gets done. If you see an opportunity- go for it!
Taking the Tower#027.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taking the Tower#028.src: If you need to retreat, or the corrupteds are slain, regroup here!| Understood?
Taking the Tower#028.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taking the Tower#030.src: Yes, sir!}} ** ' ** ** ** *{{Dialogue|green|Lieutenant Van|Good. Alright soldiers, let's take back that tower!
Taking the Tower#030.speaker: Detlas Soldier

Taking the Tower#031.src: Go on, head for the tower! If we're lucky, we'll be able to clear out the corrupteds who have taken over it.
Taking the Tower#031.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taking the Tower#032.src: Assault the Raging Tower at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] and defeat the monster at the top.

Taking the Tower#033.src: Alright. It's time to take on the tower! We've got this, .
Taking the Tower#033.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#034.src: Report back to Lieutenant Van about your success at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Taking the Tower#035.src: We did it, we killed the corrupted! Come on, let's get back to Lieutenant Van with the news!
Taking the Tower#035.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#036.src: It seems everyone has returned. Well? Have the corrupted forces been vanquished?
Taking the Tower#036.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taking the Tower#037.src: They have, lieutenant. and I reached the top and defeated the corrupted.
Taking the Tower#037.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#038.src: Fine work, soldiers! Another great victory for the {p} army. With the leader killed, it shouldn't be too difficult to clear out the rest of them.
Taking the Tower#038.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taking the Tower#039.src: I'll let the Admiral know of your victory today, soldiers. And- here, some payment for your work.
Taking the Tower#039.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taking the Tower#040.src: The two of you have a promising future. I look forward to serving with you in the future!
Taking the Tower#040.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taking the Tower#042.src: We'll take care of the remaining stragglers, don't you worry. Thank you for your work today, soldier.
Taking the Tower#042.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taproot#001.src: Follow Lari to the black spot next to her camp.

Taproot#002.src: Follow the trail of magic leading from the black spot.

Taproot#003.src: Talk to Lari outside the weird gate at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Taproot#011.src: Talk to Lari outside the Taproot gate.

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#000.src: Talk to Kelight at the entrance of the Temple of the Legends, close to {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#001.src: I see you want to enter this mighty temple! Do not deny it, I see it in your eyes.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#001.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#002.src: It is only natural, after all, to want to join the esteemed ranks of the Legends, such as myself!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#002.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#003.src: You will need to prove yourself by fighting a powerful beast, hidden deep in this cave beside me.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#003.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#004.src: However, as a Legend, I am very busy, autographs and the sort, and that's not to mention my guard duty! Let me see if you are even worth my time.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#004.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#005.src: Hm... At a glance, you don't look anything special! Why, you may as well be a common soldier, for all I can imagine!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#005.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#006.src: Tell me, why should I bother giving you this chance? Because thus far, I'm not impressed.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#006.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#007.src: You're stubborn? Hah! Don't make me laugh. Do you think you are the first to attempt entry without anything great to show for it?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#007.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#008.src: Of course you aren't. Run along, now. Return when you have something truly impressive to show for yourself.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#008.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#009.src: ...And? Surely you do not hope to bribe me, do you? What use would I have for whatever meager wealth you have?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#009.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#010.src: I'm a Legend! I have everything I could possibly need for the rest of my life! Now, run along. Return when you have something concrete to show me.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#010.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#011.src: Ha! You? A Legend?! What a joke. You aren't the first to have tried that, by the way. I know each and every member of our ranks, and you are not one of them.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#011.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#012.src: Ah, truly, being a gatekeeper of the Temple is an entertaining position. Run along, now. Return when you have something real to show me.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#012.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#013.src: Hmph. Ridiculous. I don't need you to convince me of anything! Clearly, you are nothing but a pretender.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#013.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#014.src: Run along, now. If you don't have anything to show for yourself, don't waste my time!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#014.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#017.src: ...But- ah. Since you are still here. Perhaps- no, no, don't be ridiculous, Kelight.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#017.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#019.src: Come on, Kelight, don't do this, you can't just let them get you with the silent treatment...
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#019.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#021.src: Oh, fine. You've got me interested. What is special about you? You look like a common soldier, and yet...
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#021.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#022.src: Very well. I will allow you to attempt the trial. Perhaps, then, you will be able to prove yourself.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#022.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#023.src: Hidden deep within a nearby cave is a beast beyond compare. Corrupted, yes, but nothing like the foes you may have faced before.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#023.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#024.src: Rumor has it this creature was one of the miners which first ventured into the Nether Portal... Of course, as a Legend, I would usually disregard such things.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#024.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#025.src: In any case, its power cannot be underestimated. Simply entering its cave will greatly weaken you, even with the best equipment!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#025.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#026.src: Getting close to it would quickly corrupt you, which is why you will need protection. Only a light which is from the same realm from which the beast arrived will do the trick.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#026.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#027.src: As such, your very first step on your journey to become a Legend will be... to visit a friend of mine who studies the Nether.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#027.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#028.src: His name is Jorkin, and he knows more about that realm than anyone else I know. Find him near the {p}, in {p}, and request his aid. Tell him I sent you.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#028.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#029.src: Find a way to get Kelight to allow you entry into the Temple of the Legends at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#030.src: So you return! Very interesting. That certainly puts you a level beyond any others who have tried... But it is not enough.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#030.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#031.src: So? Tell me, why should I bother giving you this chance? Because thus far, I'm not impressed.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#031.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#032.src: You're stubborn? Hah! Don't make me laugh. Do you think you are the first to attempt entry without anything great to show for it?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#032.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#033.src: Of course you aren't. Run along, now. Return when you have something truly impressive to show for yourself.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#033.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#034.src: So you are! And so am I. You will not get past me that easily, I'm afraid.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#034.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#035.src: Off you go, then. Don't come back unless you have something to show!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#035.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#036.src: Yes, I'm starting to get that impression. You are such a headache, you know that?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#036.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#038.src: Fine! Fine. I'll give you a chance. I'm certain you won't succeed, but anything to get you to stop bothering me.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#038.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#039.src: Ahem. Hidden deep within a nearby cave is a beast beyond compare. Corrupted, yes, but nothing like the foes you may have faced before.

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#065.src: Talk to Jorkin in {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] about Light Dust.

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#066.src: Ah, hello soldier. What brings you to my humble abode today?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#066.speaker: Jorkin

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#067.src: Oh my. You...you want to attack HIM? Th-that horrid beast! Are you mad?!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#067.speaker: Jorkin

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#068.src: Urgh, Kelight keeps sending adventurers like you to their deaths with his asinine tasks!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#068.speaker: Jorkin

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#069.src: Fine. If you're really so determined to walk to your death, I can tell you where to go.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#069.speaker: Jorkin

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#070.src: Down in the Roots, there is a cave full of the Light Dust you'll need.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#070.speaker: Jorkin

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#071.src: Powerful corrupteds live in that cave, so be very careful retrieving it, and bring it back to me once you find it.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#071.speaker: Jorkin

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#072.src: Find the lightdust cavern located near the Portal at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#073.src: Retrieve [[Light Dust|[{~} Light Dust]]] from the cave at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] and bring it back to Jorkin at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#074.src: You have the Light Dust, then? Hand it here, I want to see something.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#074.speaker: Jorkin

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#075.src: Ah, just as I thought. Even this light has been tainted by Corruption. Sorry, looks like you can't fight him, go home.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#075.speaker: Jorkin

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#077.src: ...urgh, there's no fooling you, is there? You really are committed to trying to fight him.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#077.speaker: Jorkin

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#078.src: Well, I wasn't lying when I said the Light Dust was corrupted, but there is a way to purify it.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#078.speaker: Jorkin

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#079.src: An old acquaintance of mine, Rayshyroth, has a method. He lives on {p}.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#079.speaker: Jorkin

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#080.src: He knows even more about that...thing, than I do in my years of studying the Nether. Maybe he'll be able to talk you out of this.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#080.speaker: Jorkin

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#081.src: Visit Rayshyroth on {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] to purify the dust

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#082.src: Oh? Well, greetings. What brings you to our quiet lonely island, let alone all the way up here?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#082.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#083.src: ...I see. Yes, the corruption of the blasted Nether Portal is rather potent. I'm not surprised this would need purification.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#083.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#084.src: Well, I can certainly do it, but I'll need the materials to do so. Shouldn't be anything you can't handle by now, right?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#084.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#085.src: You see, below my house here, there is a wellspring from which a powerful magic flux generates.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#085.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#086.src: It creates a unique magic vapor if disrupted, which I can use to purify the dust for you.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#086.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#087.src: I would say, given how badly corrupted this is, I will need at least [[Sky Vapor|[{~} Sky Vapor]]] for the task.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#087.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#088.src: Find the cave on {p} where the Sky Flux gathers at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#089.src: Give [[Sky Vapor|[{~} Sky Vapor]]] to Rayshyroth at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#090.src: Aha, you're back with the Sky Vapor! Sorry about the climb, even I find it rather inconvenient at times.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#090.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#091.src: While I perform the ritual to purify this, I'd like to ask you something. Do you know, exactly, what it is you'll be fighting?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#091.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#092.src: Don't look so surprised, I know exactly what you need Light Dust for. The corruption warding helmet...to allow you to fight the Corrupter of Worlds.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#092.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#093.src: Yes, yes. I imagine that Kelight didn't bother telling you that was his title. I also surmise that you were given few details of how he came to be...
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#093.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#094.src: The beast now known as the Corrupter of Worlds used to be a simple mining captain, during the expeditions that uncovered the Nether Portal. He was the first to enter that wicked realm.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#094.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#095.src: The poor man was never heard from again...well, that is until the corrupted hordes began to pour from the Nether, with him leading the pack. A bit ironic, isn't it? Led the miners in life, the corrupteds in death.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#095.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#096.src: His mining crew there lasted hardly minutes. He personally slaughtered every single one of his original crew, and thousands more. The energies of the Nether have made him monstrously powerful.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#096.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#097.src: ...although, the stories differ. Some say that Bak'al was the first to enter the portal, and the Corrupter of Worlds was simply a beast from the Nether. But the unclear truth doesn't change his strength.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#097.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#098.src: Just remember that no one, aside from that snooty Kelight, will think less of you should you choose not to fight him.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#098.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#099.src: Show the [[Purified Light Dust|[Purified Light Dust]]] to Kelight at the entrance of the Temple of the Legends at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#100.src: Hah. Took you long enough. This is the light dust, I presume?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#100.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#101.src: I'll hold onto this for now. While it is a vital ingredient for your protection, it is not enough on its own.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#101.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#102.src: You'll need an item to focus the magic around yourself, preferably something you'd wear. Hm... How about a helmet? Certainly, it'd do wonders for your poor sense of style.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#102.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#103.src: Ahem. As for creating it... I know only one man capable of crafting a piece of armor good enough to ensure your safety.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#103.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#104.src: Unfortunately, he will be hard to reach. His name was Garull, and he was the finest craftsman I'd ever met! A bit on the eccentric side, though.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#104.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#105.src: He was always ranting and raving about Creepers... he really thought they were real, can you imagine? What complete and utter nonsense.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#105.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#106.src: When I suggested the notion to be absurd, he seemed upset by my comments, and stopped visiting. Truly, I did not know what I did wrong. What a ridiculous man.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#106.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#107.src: As it stands, I have no idea where you could find him. He spoke of wanting to research the Pigman Ravines several times, though none of our rank had ever seen him there.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#107.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#108.src: In any case, it is somewhere to begin your search! Should you manage to find him, and convince him to craft you the helmet, return here and we can proceed.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#108.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#109.src: Find Garull, the Creeper obsessed craftsman, somewhere in the {p} located around [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#110.src: GWUH! Oh god, don't scare me like that! Who... Who even are you?!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#110.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#111.src: Ah, you were sent from Kelight for a protection helmet? I can do that, sure, but there's a few complications.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#111.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#112.src: See, I usually use something called Touroto Hide to make my armor. It's extremely resilient, magic resistant and tough to break.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#112.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#113.src: But, this also makes the Touroto themselves almost impossible to kill. Getting Touroto Hide is extremely difficult. I do know of a black market for it in {p}, but...
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#113.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#114.src: They only sell useless Old Touroto Hide, gotten from ones that died of old age. It's almost no better than just plain leather.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#114.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#115.src: So, for me to craft you this helmet, I'll need you to bring me not just the [[Old Touroto Hide|[Old Touroto Hide]]], but also the means to restore it to its previous power. Do listen up, there's a lot to tell you!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#115.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#116.src: There's the [[Aseado Leaf|[Aseado Leaf]]], grown someplace in the {p}... it has powerful medicinal qualities, supposedly able to reverse aging.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#116.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#117.src: Then, a [[Maro's Eye Jewel|[Maro's Eye Jewel]]], which is an amazing magical focus from...well, where else, the {p}. Using its dust, I'll be able to return its magical resilience manually.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#117.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#118.src: Finally, I'll need a [[Coral of Nelfors|[Coral of Nelfors]]], which can be found in the {p}. This is what I need to use to enchant the hide to be magically resistant.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#118.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#119.src: I wrote all that down in your content book. If you can get it all, come back to see me, but don't be so sneaky about coming up to me please!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#119.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#120.src: Bring the [[Old Touroto Hide|[Old Touroto Hide]]], [[Aseado Leaf|[Aseado Leaf]]], [[Maro's Eye Jewel|[Maro's Eye Jewel]]], and [[Coral of Nelfors|[Coral of Nelfors]]] to Garull in the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#121.src: Thank you for listening to me about not being so quiet coming over here. I'm guessing you've got everything?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#121.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#122.src: Alright, this should go quickly. For however pompous Kelight is, he's right in sending you to me to craft this.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#122.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#123.src: Now, I want to warn you about something. I've heard stories about the enemy you need this helmet to face, none of them good.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#123.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#124.src: While I have seen people return from killing the "beast" he talks about, it isn't often. Be very careful, should you choose to fight it.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#124.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#125.src: Bring the [[Helmet of the Legends|[Helmet of the Legends]]] to Kelight at the entrance of the Temple of the Legends at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#126.src: ...Hm? Oh, it's you again. Did you actually manage to find the blighter? Good to know he isn't dead, at least.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#126.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#127.src: You have the helmet, I presume? Hand it over, here. I'll quickly apply the light dust. Then, you'll be able to enter the cave.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#127.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#128.src: Hopefully you'll do better than that last group that tried to fight him. Six fighters strong... never came back.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#128.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#129.src: ...Well, good luck! I'm certain you'll either succeed, or you'll fail spectacularly. Either or, really.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#129.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#130.src: Bring me concrete proof of your triumph over the beast, and I will grant you passage into the Temple of the Legends! Do be quick, would you?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#130.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#131.src: Kill the Corrupter of Worlds in the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and bring proof of its death to Kelight at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#133.src: Even one so brave and powerful as myself could not possibly survive against-
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#133.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#134.src: Er... I mean, of course you were able to defeat the beast! I believed in you from the very start!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#134.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#135.src: ...Ehm. I suppose you are welcome in the Temple of the Legends, now! You have... certainly proven yourself. My apologies for misjudging you. Feel proud of your accomplishment!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#135.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#136.src: Hm? What are these oddities you have with you? Curious, yet useless. Allow me to dispose of them for you.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#136.speaker: Kelight

Tempo Town Trouble#001.src: Hey, excuse me! I'm in need of- ...yeah, just walk right by me. Maybe I shoulda gone to {p} for help, these people here have enough problems...
Tempo Town Trouble#001.speaker: Tyko

Tempo Town Trouble#002.src: Don't suppose you'd be willing to help, huh? Bet you're busy- Wait, you've got spare time? Criminy, only took a week of asking! Good to meet ya.
Tempo Town Trouble#002.speaker: Tyko

Tempo Town Trouble#003.src: Alright, My name is Tyko, and I got asked to find a capable soldier for- well, lemme explain. So, I'm from a place called {p}, by {p}. It's a recent establishment.
Tempo Town Trouble#003.speaker: Tyko

Tempo Town Trouble#004.src: I'm buddies with the mayor- he set up {p} as kind of a homeless shelter for people whose homes got ruined by corrupted attacks, since {p} doesn't seem corrupted.
Tempo Town Trouble#004.speaker: Tyko

Tempo Town Trouble#005.src: Some old guy with jaundice or something swings by, some kind of keeper- Says to set up on a ridge overlooking a lake. So, we did! Everything was going well for a bit.
Tempo Town Trouble#005.speaker: Tyko

Tempo Town Trouble#006.src: And then some freaky time monster starts showing up in the middle of the night and tries to bust down our doors! We were told that ridge was safe, but that was clearly a lie.
Tempo Town Trouble#006.speaker: Tyko

Tempo Town Trouble#007.src: So, that's why I'm here. No one at {p} is tough enough to kill that thing, so I ran over here to ask for some backup. Glad I ran into ya!
Tempo Town Trouble#007.speaker: Tyko

Tempo Town Trouble#008.src: Lemme write down the coordinates for ya in your book. I'm gonna stick around and see if anyone else feels like helping.
Tempo Town Trouble#008.speaker: Tyko

Tempo Town Trouble#009.src: The coordinates to where you need to go should be in your book. Help us out, yeah?
Tempo Town Trouble#009.speaker: Tyko

Tempo Town Trouble#011.src: Hello- Welcome to {p}, friend! Established only two months ago, I'm proud to provide aid to those displaced by corrupted raids.
Tempo Town Trouble#011.speaker: Homeless Mayor

Tempo Town Trouble#012.src: Come to think of it, you look like a {p} representative... Can I bother you to deliver some paperwork to the castle about getting officially established here?
Tempo Town Trouble#012.speaker: Homeless Mayor

Tempo Town Trouble#013.src: ...Repeat that? ...OH! Oh, no wonder you- Agh, my mind's all over the place from stress, I'm so relieved he found help finally!
Tempo Town Trouble#013.speaker: Homeless Mayor

Tempo Town Trouble#014.src: Alright, Tyko told you about the monster, right? We were told by that old man Martyn to settle on this ridge because there weren't any dangerous creatures here!
Tempo Town Trouble#014.speaker: Homeless Mayor

Tempo Town Trouble#015.src: Oh, not that kind of soldier? That's too bad... But- oh, this is a shot in the dark, but... maybe you'd be the type of soldier to take out a monster for us?
Tempo Town Trouble#015.speaker: Homeless Mayor

Tempo Town Trouble#016.src: You- you would!? Oh, thank goodness you arrived when you did! You see- we were told by that old man Martyn to settle on this ridge because there apparently weren't any dangerous creatures here!
Tempo Town Trouble#016.speaker: Homeless Mayor

Tempo Town Trouble#017.src: But every night, the same monster emerges from one of the ruins, and tries to smash the buildings down! Every single night, at the same time!
Tempo Town Trouble#017.speaker: Homeless Mayor

Tempo Town Trouble#018.src: The guards are getting run ragged, and I refuse to be responsible for any deaths when I'm trying to save these folks!
Tempo Town Trouble#018.speaker: Homeless Mayor

Tempo Town Trouble#019.src: We found the ruin it came out of, too- Er, one of the folks here, Doug, did! Here, let me write down the location for you- no, no, I insist, let me do it!
Tempo Town Trouble#019.speaker: Homeless Mayor

Tempo Town Trouble#020.src: There's the coordinates in case you forget, but it's in the temple just up the hill! Please, please hurry and take care of that horrible monster!
Tempo Town Trouble#020.speaker: Homeless Mayor

Tempo Town Trouble#021.src: The coordinates are in your book, but it's in the temple just up the hill! Please, please hurry and take care of that horrible monster!
Tempo Town Trouble#021.speaker: Homeless Mayor

Tempo Town Trouble#023.src: Grr... I KNOW I saw that beast go in here, where the heck is it?!
Tempo Town Trouble#023.speaker: Scout

Tempo Town Trouble#024.src: Hey soldier, does that disk look like some type of door to you?
Tempo Town Trouble#024.speaker: Scout

Tempo Town Trouble#025.src: I saw some creature that I've been tracking for a few days disappear around here, and I think it's somewhere behind this disk...
Tempo Town Trouble#025.speaker: Scout

Tempo Town Trouble#026.src: There's probably some kind of wacky magic keeping it shut, since I can't get it open at all!
Tempo Town Trouble#026.speaker: Scout

Tempo Town Trouble#027.src: Hey, you're able to use magic, right? Maybe using one of your fancy spells on the disk will get it open?
Tempo Town Trouble#027.speaker: Scout

Tempo Town Trouble#028.src: Stand on the disk and cast any spell. That should probably get it open, then we can finally kill that freak of nature lurking inside of there!
Tempo Town Trouble#028.speaker: Scout

Tempo Town Trouble#029.src: Let's see... What kind of secrets do these odd temples house?
Tempo Town Trouble#029.speaker: Scout

Tempo Town Trouble#030.src: Use spells to break open the temple at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Tempo Town Trouble#031.src: What was going through your noggin, ?
Tempo Town Trouble#031.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Tempo Town Trouble#032.src: Do you have any idea what you were doing? Bashing around that room I just sealed off for good?
Tempo Town Trouble#032.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Tempo Town Trouble#033.src: You need to be careful, soldier! This Valley's secrets are NOT to be meddled with.
Tempo Town Trouble#033.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Tempo Town Trouble#034.src: I assume the mayor of that place called {p} sent you here. You are going to have to tell that lad that his problems just got worse.
Tempo Town Trouble#034.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Tempo Town Trouble#035.src: The monster you killed was known as a Time Trouble. They're odd creatures that were forced into a day-long temporal loop by some fools long ago.
Tempo Town Trouble#035.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Tempo Town Trouble#036.src: The only way to keep them at bay effectively is to seal them, like I just did here. But now, that stunt you just pulled sent ripples across the entire Valley. Now, every single Time Trouble is responding to this one's termination!
Tempo Town Trouble#036.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Tempo Town Trouble#037.src: Now, one Time Trouble I can handle, but this? I can't keep them all at bay... and now, you went and awakened every single one of those critters.
Tempo Town Trouble#037.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Tempo Town Trouble#038.src: I can fix this seal, so you'll have one less to deal with, but the rest of the Troubles will have to be taken down daily with brute force.
Tempo Town Trouble#038.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Tempo Town Trouble#039.src: You're going to have to deal with those, soldier. I have far too much to take care of in this valley.
Tempo Town Trouble#039.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Tempo Town Trouble#040.src: They'll have to be exterminated every single day. Now, I'm sure the work won't be thankless, perhaps you'll be rewarded by the townsfolk of {p} for taking care of them.
Tempo Town Trouble#040.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Tempo Town Trouble#041.src: Now please, be careful in the Valley. I already have to look after one person, nevermind the mess of time that the Olm were so-
Tempo Town Trouble#041.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Tempo Town Trouble#042.src: ...I digress, I'm just rambling again. Now, let me bring us back outside this temple, and you should head back to that shanty town.
Tempo Town Trouble#042.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Tempo Town Trouble#043.src: Report back to the mayor in {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Tempo Town Trouble#044.src: You're back! I heard some kind of weird chime coming from the temple on the hill- is that a good sign?
Tempo Town Trouble#044.speaker: Homeless Mayor

Tempo Town Trouble#045.src: You did?! Oh, thank goodness... Honestly, Martyn told us he would deal with it, but then he just disappeared off into nowhere!
Tempo Town Trouble#045.speaker: Homeless Mayor

Tempo Town Trouble#046.src: Oh, he actually showed his face after you took care of that thing? What, did you beat him to the punch or something?
Tempo Town Trouble#046.speaker: Homeless Mayor

Tempo Town Trouble#047.src: Wait... What? He was... trying to seal the thing away, instead of killing it, and... you destroying it broke the seal?
Tempo Town Trouble#047.speaker: Homeless Mayor

Tempo Town Trouble#048.src: And now there's more of them? Why didn't he just tell us?! Now they'll need to be stopped every day to keep them in check!!
Tempo Town Trouble#048.speaker: Homeless Mayor

Tempo Town Trouble#049.src: Gah, this is a disaster... It isn't your fault, you didn't know- Wait, what's that boxy thing you have? A [Time Fragment]? ...oh, so the monster dropped it.
Tempo Town Trouble#049.speaker: Homeless Mayor

Tempo Town Trouble#050.src: Interesting... One of the townsfolk likes to collect those sorts of things! He's that Mysterious Merchant just behind me.
Tempo Town Trouble#050.speaker: Homeless Mayor

Tempo Town Trouble#051.src: Go talk with him about those! He might give you something worth your while if you trade them with him.
Tempo Town Trouble#051.speaker: Homeless Mayor

Tempo Town Trouble#052.src: ...also, while you were away, that strange magic stone up on the hill started glowing. We're not sure what to do with it, really! Might be worth your attention.
Tempo Town Trouble#052.speaker: Homeless Mayor

Tempo Town Trouble#053.src: ...though, this is a bit awkward- I don't have a reward ready for you. Making this place took a lot of money... Hopefully gratitude is enough- thank you, sincerely!
Tempo Town Trouble#053.speaker: Homeless Mayor

Tempo Town Trouble#054.src: Heya! Heard from the mayor that you helped out the town! Can't thank you enough for that.
Tempo Town Trouble#054.speaker: Tyko

Tempo Town Trouble#055.src: Oh hey, it's you! I hope you've been keeping those Time Troubles at bay.
Tempo Town Trouble#055.speaker: Homeless Mayor

Tempo Town Trouble#056.src: Oh, hey! I hope that monster wasn't too difficult for you to defeat.
Tempo Town Trouble#056.speaker: Scout
