The Dark Descent#001.src: Ah, hello there chap! I must say, I didn't expect to see a part of the old {p} regiment over 'ere.
The Dark Descent#001.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#002.src: I am General Graken, leader of the {p} militia. Charmed to meet you!
The Dark Descent#002.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#003.src: You've seen all the bloody zombies faffing about everywhere, yes? They're all seeming to come from this massive skull.
The Dark Descent#003.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#004.src: I'm putting together a crack team for an expedition inside, but we haven't got any bleedin' idea what's down there!
The Dark Descent#004.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#005.src: If you're up for it, chap, we could absolutely do with some recon 'round the old town, look for clues and the like.
The Dark Descent#005.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#006.src: I took a gander earlier, and one of the ol' houses caught my eye - it had a bloomin' great skull right over the door!
The Dark Descent#006.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#007.src: I didn't have time to look in proper, but I'd start the investigation there, chap.
The Dark Descent#007.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#008.src: It's just south of here. The house still had solid wood boarding in it, despite the age, so look lively, chum!
The Dark Descent#008.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#010.src: Oh, sod it, I knew I was forgetting something! Steady there, chum! I'm on my way!
The Dark Descent#010.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#011.src: Drat! Too late, it seems. Yes, I forgot to mention the floor was in poor condition. Up here! You took quite the tumble, are you alright?
The Dark Descent#011.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#012.src: Well, there's some good news, I suppose. Still though, seems I sent you a ticket to a bit of a sticky wicket! Do you see a way out anywhere down there?
The Dark Descent#012.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#013.src: There's a tunnel? Aha, spiffing! I suggest you take it immediately. I'll have to return to my post now, post-haste!
The Dark Descent#013.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#014.src: Good luck, chum! Now, back, you cads! Back I say!
The Dark Descent#014.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#015.src: Keheh... Come further, little human... Step into the shadows...

The Dark Descent#016.src: Explore the tunnel in the basement of the house.

The Dark Descent#019.src: Scout! Report your findings, immediately! How many corrupteds are coming?
The Dark Descent#019.speaker: Soldier

The Dark Descent#021.src: Thousands...? This is far worse than I expected. Men! Prepare for-
The Dark Descent#021.speaker: Soldier

The Dark Descent#023.src: Wait, w-what's going on? What's happening to you?!
The Dark Descent#023.speaker: Soldier

The Dark Descent#024.src: Please, stop this! Whoever you are, leave me and my family in peace! What did we ever do to deserve this?!
The Dark Descent#024.speaker: Lost Soul

The Dark Descent#025.src: Ah, but if you had only said so sooner! They have already left this mortal coil...oh, what a shame.

The Dark Descent#027.src: Hush now. I will ensure that you and your family are reunited. You will even be able to partake in...keheh...family outings, under my watchful eye...

The Dark Descent#028.src: Wha...you mean... N-no, please! I don't want to hurt anyone! I don't want to die!!
The Dark Descent#028.speaker: Lost Soul

The Dark Descent#029.src: Aha, naive girl. How cute, you believe you have a choice in the matter. What you want, is not what I need.

The Dark Descent#031.src: Do you see how easily this place fell? How quickly I became its master? And how I could simply dispose of you without a second thought?

The Dark Descent#032.src: Hundreds slaughtered in mere moments... only to rise again as my soldiers in infinite amounts.

The Dark Descent#033.src: You can barely keep them at bay on the surface, and yet you think you can enter my own domain, to challenge me in the Underworld?

The Dark Descent#034.src: You will fail, and I will be free to string your body up like a puppet and make you dance for me.

The Dark Descent#035.src: So enter the mouth of the skull, soldier, make your way below the ground. I look forward to our next meeting, keheheh...

The Dark Descent#037.src: Return the ruby to Graken at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Dark Descent#038.src: Return to your world, now. And if you still want to challenge me... I'll be waiting.

The Dark Descent#039.src: Hey! Come on, come over here! Quit milling about with the zombies, chap!
The Dark Descent#039.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#040.src: Oi! Hallo?! Chum? Why're you wandering round all bog-eyed? Come back to me now!
The Dark Descent#040.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#041.src: Come on, pip pip! Let's see a bit more colour in your eyes- There we are! Back now, chap?
The Dark Descent#041.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#042.src: Capital! You had me quite worried for a spot, there. Do bubble about just what went on down there, mm?
The Dark Descent#042.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#043.src: But, you were stumbling about like a senile biddy, eyes blank as cream, and you kept muttering something about a Charon.
The Dark Descent#043.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#044.src: I'm supposing he was the one who took you for a spin there? Well, you certainly haven't carked it, so I might call this operation a jolly good success!
The Dark Descent#044.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#045.src: Your discoveries fit in jolly-well with what we already know - and I'm convinced. To stop all these bleedin' zombos, we're going to have to go down under.
The Dark Descent#045.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#046.src: Preliminary expeditions have brought back some real nasty bits, brains and such - but also some fancy-as-you-like jewellery!
The Dark Descent#046.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#047.src: Take some with you, remind you what we're up against. But keep your eyes on the prize!
The Dark Descent#047.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#048.src: When you're ready, I'd be chuffed to have you along again in the expedition down into the depths, old bean!
The Dark Descent#048.speaker: General Graken

The House of Twain (Quest)#000.src: Talk to Twendle at The {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The House of Twain (Quest)#001.src: Oh, hey you there! Are you heading down this road? You know it's a dead end, right?
The House of Twain (Quest)#001.speaker: Twendle

The House of Twain (Quest)#002.src: It leads to an old mansion, that has fallen into decay.
The House of Twain (Quest)#002.speaker: Twendle

The House of Twain (Quest)#003.src: That mansion is the house of my ancestor; Dwendle Twain. It was a house of incredible heritage and magical powers, Dwendle himself was adopted into it.
The House of Twain (Quest)#003.speaker: Twendle

The House of Twain (Quest)#004.src: Marius Twain was the leader of the mansion; they fought against evil spirits, I think. The history of the house is not well-known, outside of a novel.
The House of Twain (Quest)#004.speaker: Twendle

The House of Twain (Quest)#005.src: I want to know the history of the mansion and uncover its secrets, but every time I get close, dark beings prevent me from entering.
The House of Twain (Quest)#005.speaker: Twendle

The House of Twain (Quest)#006.src: I am no soldier, and I don't think I will ever uncover the truth without your help. I can greatly reward you for your help.
The House of Twain (Quest)#006.speaker: Twendle

The House of Twain (Quest)#007.src: My ancestor left our family a large amount of emeralds. Beware though, traveller, the mansion's secrets are incredibly difficult to uncover and the monsters are powerful.
The House of Twain (Quest)#007.speaker: Twendle

The House of Twain (Quest)#008.src: Unravel the secrets of the mansion and help me uncover the secrets of my heritage. Bring me [{~} Twain Journal].
The House of Twain (Quest)#008.speaker: Twendle

The House of Twain (Quest)#009.src: This book has been hidden within the depths of the mansion and is protected by far more than puzzles or walls.
The House of Twain (Quest)#009.speaker: Twendle

The House of Twain (Quest)#010.src: I believe the spirits that now haunt the mansion will do anything to protect the book. I'm sure they think it's their own, and the secrets it hides.
The House of Twain (Quest)#010.speaker: Twendle

The House of Twain (Quest)#011.src: Bring [[Twain's Journal|[{~} Twain Journal]]] to Twendle

The House of Twain (Quest)#012.src: I guess I put my faith in the right person. My history lies within these pages, and I don't intend to keep them secret. I shall make them public.
The House of Twain (Quest)#012.speaker: Twendle

The House of Twain (Quest)#013.src: Thank you traveller. As promised, here is your reward.}} {{Clear
The House of Twain (Quest)#013.speaker: Twendle

The Mercenary#000.src: Talk to the Scout in {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] or find one in another town.

The Mercenary#002.src: Admiral Amerigo of the Almuji Army requests the aid of able-bodied and unmoored soldiers from around the Province of Wynn.
The Mercenary#002.speaker: Military Scout

The Mercenary#003.src: To put it bluntly... they've run into a predicament over there. {p}'s standing army has been taken captive, and the desert barracks overtaken.
The Mercenary#003.speaker: Military Scout

The Mercenary#004.src: The Admiral has sent scouts round to gather any free-moving soldiers to help him... remedy the situation.
The Mercenary#004.speaker: Military Scout

The Mercenary#005.src: ... If you ask me, I reckon he'd like this taken care of quietly and discreetly. I don't blame the man, really, given the circumstances.
The Mercenary#005.speaker: Military Scout

The Mercenary#006.src: Anyhow, if you can, travel on over that way. {p} is the desert city to the east of {p}, if you've never seen it.
The Mercenary#006.speaker: Military Scout

The Mercenary#007.src: With that, I'm off! There are many more soldiers to find. Good luck, if you choose to heed the summons!
The Mercenary#007.speaker: Military Scout

The Mercenary#009.src: Admiral Amerigo of the Almuji Army requests the aid of able-bodied and unmoored soldiers from around the Province of Wynn.
The Mercenary#009.speaker: Military Scout

The Mercenary#010.src: To put it bluntly... they've run into a predicament over there. {p}'s standing army has been taken captive, and the desert barracks overtaken.
The Mercenary#010.speaker: Military Scout

The Mercenary#011.src: The Admiral has sent scouts round to gather any free-moving soldiers to help him... remedy the situation.

The Mercenary#012.src: ... If you ask me, I reckon he'd like this taken care of quietly and discreetly. I don't blame the man, really, given the circumstances.

The Mercenary#013.speaker: Military Scout

The Mercenary#014.src: With that, I'm off! There are many more soldiers to find. Good luck, if you choose to heed the summons!
The Mercenary#014.speaker: Military Scout

The Mercenary#016.src: Admiral Amerigo of the Almuji Army requests the aid of able-bodied and unmoored soldiers from around the Province of Wynn.
The Mercenary#016.speaker: Military Scout

The Mercenary#017.src: To put it bluntly... they've run into a predicament over there. {p}'s standing army has been taken captive, and the desert barracks overtaken.
The Mercenary#017.speaker: Military Scout

The Mercenary#018.src: The Admiral has sent scouts round to gather any free-moving soldiers to help him... remedy the situation.
The Mercenary#018.speaker: Military Scout

The Mercenary#019.src: ... If you ask me, I reckon he'd like this taken care of quietly and discreetly. I don't blame the man, really, given the circumstances.
The Mercenary#019.speaker: Military Scout

The Mercenary#020.src: Anyhow, if you can, head on over to the Admiral's office. It's just by the bank, you can't miss it.
The Mercenary#020.speaker: Military Scout

The Mercenary#021.src: With that, I'm off! There are many more soldiers to find. Good luck, if you choose to heed the summons!
The Mercenary#021.speaker: Military Scout

The Mercenary#023.src: Ugh, for crying out loud- I'm busy, can't you see that? I don't have time to...
The Mercenary#023.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#024.src: Ah. You're a soldier. Good, that's one more to add to the list. You met the scout, I'm sure.
The Mercenary#024.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#025.src: Not as many of you lot as I would have hoped for, but it'll have to do. Come down here, the others are in the briefing room already.
The Mercenary#025.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#026.src: Hmph. I suppose this is as many soldiers as we'll be able to get. Very well!
The Mercenary#026.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#027.src: To begin with - the situation. Commander Takan of {p} has abandoned his post, and has taken the lead of a group of local bandits.
The Mercenary#027.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#028.src: Under his command, they were able to strike our forces in the dead of night, and have taken over the barracks to the northeast.
The Mercenary#028.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#029.src: Our entire military force, captured or killed! What a disgrace. We've sent messengers to {p}, and they have promised their support...
The Mercenary#029.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#030.src: But I would like this dealt with quickly and quietly. That's where you five come in.
The Mercenary#030.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#031.src: You will attack and infiltrate the barracks, and assassinate our treasonous commander. I will leave the strategizing to you, as there is much I still must handle here.
The Mercenary#031.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#032.src: A question, if I may. Do we know the commander's reasoning for this attack? It seems out of character.
The Mercenary#032.speaker: Lanu

The Mercenary#033.src: ...No. There is nothing that I can recall that would motivate such an attack. Will that be all?
The Mercenary#033.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#035.src: Then I must be off! Good luck, soldiers. I hope for a swift end to this disaster.
The Mercenary#035.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#036.src: ...Well, darn. Bandits sound like trouble. Do we know what sort?
The Mercenary#036.speaker: Mel

The Mercenary#037.src: Does it matter? We'll probably be fighting them no matter what kind they are.
The Mercenary#037.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#038.src: It might, actually... Some bandit groups are stronger than others. If we know which group we're dealing with ahead of time, it might-
The Mercenary#038.speaker: Lanu

The Mercenary#039.src: We've been standing around here for too long. Come on, let's make our way closer to the barracks. We can come up with a plan there.
The Mercenary#039.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#044.src: Well, darn. The place is swarming with bandits...
The Mercenary#044.speaker: Mel

The Mercenary#045.src: I don't see how that's a problem! We can just launch explosives into the crowd, and boom, problem solved.
The Mercenary#045.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#047.src: We can't do that. You'd almost certainly damage the structure in the process!
The Mercenary#047.speaker: Lanu

The Mercenary#048.src: Ah, true. Can't forget about the historical value. Good catch.
The Mercenary#048.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#049.src: ...Right. Well, anyway, I don't think we can get through those bandits with brute force. We'll have to try to find a way around them...
The Mercenary#049.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#050.src: Well, if I may interject- I reckon I won't be of much use in proper combat! Injured leg, 'n all. Makes moving a little hard!
The Mercenary#050.speaker: Mel

The Mercenary#051.src: So, if we think goin' right in won't work, I could try to create a distraction? I've got the magic for it, and I'd be of much more use out here.
The Mercenary#051.speaker: Mel

The Mercenary#052.src: It could work... if I join you, we'd be able to draw attention towards us while the others sneak in from a different angle.
The Mercenary#052.speaker: Lanu

The Mercenary#053.src: Good idea. But, how do we get in? I don't think there is another entrance, other than that one in front.
The Mercenary#053.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#055.src: This had better not be going where I think it is, Linton.
The Mercenary#055.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#056.src: Okay, maybe it is. But, listen! We don't have any entrances, right? What if we made our own... by blowing a hole through a wall?
The Mercenary#056.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#057.src: ...Alright, fine. That sounds like it could work.
The Mercenary#057.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#059.src: Exactly! You need to have more faith in the experts, Aledar.
The Mercenary#059.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#060.src: We all need to make sacrifices, Lanu.
The Mercenary#060.speaker: Mel

The Mercenary#061.src: Hm. No, I don't think I do. Either way, that sounds like a plan. , Linton, and I will break into the barracks then.
The Mercenary#061.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#063.src: And Lanu and I can distract 'em while you do so. Sounds like a plan! Let's get goin'.
The Mercenary#063.speaker: Mel

The Mercenary#065.src: Well, well. This looks like a good place to break our way in, wouldn't you say, Aledar?
The Mercenary#065.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#066.src: Yes, Linton, it looks fine. , we'll be looking for Takan. I think the two of us could take him out.
The Mercenary#066.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#067.src: And I'll be looking for the captured soldiers! I stole a map of the barracks from Amerigo's desk, so I'll be able to find them easily enough!
The Mercenary#067.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#068.src: You-... nevermind, I don't care. Just do your job, please?
The Mercenary#068.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#070.src: See you two on the other side!
The Mercenary#070.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#073.src: Damn it... damn it, damn it, damn it ALL! Couldn't give me a MOMENT of peace, could he, that rat Amerigo...
The Mercenary#073.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#074.src: ...do I really need to do everything myself?! It's almost as though-
The Mercenary#074.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#075.src: Oh, I see. I see what's going on. More of Amerigo's dogs, here to take care of his business, huh?! Get out here where I can see you.
The Mercenary#075.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#076.src: You look new... haven't been around long enough to really see the face of War up close and personal yet, have you?
The Mercenary#076.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#077.src: You think this is right? You think it's right that those DAMNED admirals get all the wealth and fame, when WE'RE the ones out fighting in the trenches?!
The Mercenary#077.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#078.src: I've seen soldiers fall and fall and fall, then rise back up again. I've lived through the chaos and death of battle more times than I could count.
The Mercenary#078.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#079.src: And these IDIOTS think they deserve their power? Their authority?!
The Mercenary#079.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#080.src: ...You've killed dozens, and you're keeping dozens more captured.
The Mercenary#080.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#081.src: And I'd do all that and more, just to prove my point! They think they hold power?! I'll show them power...
The Mercenary#081.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#082.src: I suppose I'll start with you. What are two more compared to dozens?
The Mercenary#082.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#083.src: Step aside, Shadow Spears. I'd like to deal with these dogs myself.
The Mercenary#083.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#084.src: ...We won't make it easy for you.
The Mercenary#084.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#089.src: This tower can only go up... Come on, we need to chase after him! We can't let him get away!
The Mercenary#089.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#090.src: Continue up the stairs in the barracks.

The Mercenary#093.src: Look, it's obvious we've lost here. Even if that idiot escapes, you military folk will find him.
The Mercenary#093.speaker: Shadow Spears Leader

The Mercenary#094.src: So, I surrender! Don't see the point in fightin' a pointless battle. Not like we're gonna be paid after this mess, anyhow.
The Mercenary#094.speaker: Shadow Spears Leader

The Mercenary#095.src: Here, take the key to the tower. A sign of good faith. Do what you will with him, I really don't care.
The Mercenary#095.speaker: Shadow Spears Leader

The Mercenary#096.src: I always preferred his brother anyway. Much quieter.
The Mercenary#096.speaker: Shadow Spears Leader

The Mercenary#097.src: Ugh, more bandits... I'll hold them off here.
The Mercenary#097.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#098.src: Keep going after Takan! I'll be fine!
The Mercenary#098.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#099.src: Head up the tower and take out Takan.

The Mercenary#100.src: Urgh... Why did I even come up here?! There's nowhere for me to-
The Mercenary#100.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#101.src: ...Oh. L-listen. We can talk this out-
The Mercenary#101.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#104.src: ...and so then, I had to free them somehow! So I shouted at them to brace for it, and-
The Mercenary#104.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#105.src: ! There you are! I'm glad you made it out safely. It looks like the bandits are dispersing.
The Mercenary#105.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#106.src: And so is my train of thought for my story. So! Did you get him?
The Mercenary#106.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#107.src: That's good to hear. At least something good came of this whole situation...
The Mercenary#107.speaker: Lanu

The Mercenary#108.src: I'm glad we managed to take him out after all. The things he was saying... he seemed like a dangerous man.
The Mercenary#108.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#109.src: Oh, not this again. You're still on that?
The Mercenary#109.speaker: Mel

The Mercenary#110.src: I caught a few of the things he was shoutin' from outside. It didn't sound very pleasant.
The Mercenary#110.speaker: Mel

The Mercenary#111.src: Some of us care about history, Mel.
The Mercenary#111.speaker: Lanu

The Mercenary#112.src: Well, I didn't hear a thing. Probably on account of the ringing in my ears. It seems to me we're done here, though, right?
The Mercenary#112.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#113.src: It looks like it, yes. I think I'll stay behind to help the soldiers clear out the remaining bandits.
The Mercenary#113.speaker: Lanu

The Mercenary#114.src: I figure I'll stick around too. Don't got anythin' better to do right now, anyway!
The Mercenary#114.speaker: Mel

The Mercenary#115.src: Well, I'm out of here. I've got places to be! Things to do! Explosives to return! Goodbye!
The Mercenary#115.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#116.src: , I guess that leaves the two of us to return to {p} with the news! Let's get going.
The Mercenary#116.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#117.src: Bring Takan's badge to Amerigo at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Mercenary#118.src: Soldiers! Report! Don't tell me you're the only two survivors, damn it all...
The Mercenary#118.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#119.src: No, sir, the mission was a success. Takan is dead.
The Mercenary#119.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#120.src: You're certain of this? You have his badge, surely...?
The Mercenary#120.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#121.src: I see... satisfactory work, soldiers. You two, and the others, have {p}'s gratitude.
The Mercenary#121.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#122.src: Admiral, sir. Some of what Takan is saying, it was-
The Mercenary#122.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#123.src: I wouldn't put too much stock in those traitor's words. People like him, who spit vitriol with no merit, riling up the masses against the order we hold.
The Mercenary#123.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#124.src: He is an angry man holding a grudge for an imagined wrongdoing. There is nothing more to it than that. I would suggest putting it out of your mind.
The Mercenary#124.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#125.src: You will all be well-compensated for your work today. Now, run along. I have to collect my honorary badge for taking out Ex-Commander Takan.
The Mercenary#125.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#127.src: I'm starting to see why Takan hated him so much.
The Mercenary#127.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#128.src: I'll... probably try to speak to Admiral Aegis about that the next time I'm in {p}.
The Mercenary#128.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#129.src: Anyway! What an adventure, right? I can't wait to tell Tasim about it.
The Mercenary#129.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#130.src: ...Speaking of. Have you heard from him recently? I can't seem to get ahold of him at all.
The Mercenary#130.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#131.src: It's weird. Last I heard, he was at {p}, but he's not there anymore.
The Mercenary#131.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#132.src: He- what? Really? And he didn't even tell me...
The Mercenary#132.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#133.src: ...I guess it must have slipped his mind. That's alright. We're all busy around here, right?
The Mercenary#133.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#134.src: A general location is useful, though. I'll see if I can get any letters to him. Thanks for telling me.
The Mercenary#134.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#135.src: Yeah, that makes two of us...
The Mercenary#135.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#136.src: Well, it's probably fine. I'm sure he'll pop up eventually! We just need to wait.
The Mercenary#136.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#137.src: I wonder where he's gone off to? Some kind of assignment in {p}, maybe? Or could he have gone off to Gavel...?
The Mercenary#137.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#138.src: Well, whatever. It was good to see you again! Even if... well. Even if it was strange.
The Mercenary#138.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#140.src: Well, I guess I'm going to head off. I'll see you around, !
The Mercenary#140.speaker: Aledar

The Sewers of Ragni#001.src: Soldier! Good timing. We've been requesting help for ages.
The Sewers of Ragni#001.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#002.src: With the corrupted hordes terrorising the Wynn Plains, more and more people are moving to {p}.
The Sewers of Ragni#002.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#003.src: Issue is, a major sewage pipe's been blocked up. No wonder nobody wanted the job.
The Sewers of Ragni#003.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#004.src: I'm going to need you to get your hands dirty. I'll need some assistance with the blockage.
The Sewers of Ragni#004.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#005.src: Here's the brief. We get in, deploy some small explosives to dislodge the blockage, and get out.
The Sewers of Ragni#005.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#006.src: We're using the side pipe. The larger one down the hill, well... you don't want to stray too far into that one.
The Sewers of Ragni#006.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#007.src: Keep your wits about you in there. All sorts of things could be lurking. Ready? Let's go!
The Sewers of Ragni#007.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#008.src: Enter the sewer at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and find the blockage.

The Sewers of Ragni#009.src: Explore the sewer and find the blockage.

The Sewers of Ragni#010.src: Good, you caught up. Watch your step around this place, soldier.
The Sewers of Ragni#010.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#011.src: Our scouts have confirmed that this area is clear, but a wrong turn could lead you into the old prison complex.
The Sewers of Ragni#011.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#012.src: I... we really don't want to end up there.
The Sewers of Ragni#012.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#013.src: Anyway, I've found the blockage. It's right up ahead.
The Sewers of Ragni#013.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#014.src: Here's a small explosive. I placed this one at the blockage already, if that alone doesn't work, use this.
The Sewers of Ragni#014.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#015.src: Find a way to fix the blockage.

The Sewers of Ragni#016.src: Find a way out of the spooky sewer.

The Sewers of Ragni#017.src: Ah, you're alive. Looks like we underestimated the amount of sewage.
The Sewers of Ragni#017.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#018.src: I lost you for a bit back there. It's lucky we found each other, to be honest.
The Sewers of Ragni#018.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#019.src: ... ah. This sewer has some history, you know. Back during the {p} Raids, they used to hide civilians here, in the old prison.
The Sewers of Ragni#019.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#020.src: Sometimes... sometimes it wasn't enough. Some say there are still... things roaming there. Left over from the slaughters.
The Sewers of Ragni#020.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#021.src: Let's get out of here. Do you still have the explosive I gave you?
The Sewers of Ragni#021.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#022.src: Good, let's use it on this wall, it looks like we can break right through...
The Sewers of Ragni#022.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#024.src: Phew! Looks like that first explosion cleared the pipe, and the {p} citizens are going to be happy.
The Sewers of Ragni#024.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#025.src: And count yourself lucky we didn't run into anything too nasty in there. Some of the stories...
The Sewers of Ragni#025.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#026.src: ... I don't exactly know what's in there, soldier.
The Sewers of Ragni#026.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#027.src: I can't stop you from exploring the dungeon, but I recommend you gear up first.
The Sewers of Ragni#027.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#028.src: Legend has it that Bob, the legendary warrior, was born in them during a raid on {p}.
The Sewers of Ragni#028.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#029.src: His mother died in childbirth, but some people said she lay down there for years. Rotting. Waiting.
The Sewers of Ragni#029.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#030.src: But that's just a story! Thanks for your help, soldier, and good luck.
The Sewers of Ragni#030.speaker: Jenprest

The Shadow of the Beast#000.src: Talk to Dereg in his house at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Shadow of the Beast#001.src: Oh, you look tough. You must be one of those humans I keep hearing about, right? People talk about your kind all the time.
The Shadow of the Beast#001.speaker: Dereg

The Shadow of the Beast#002.src: You know, that you're all scrappers. Tough as nails, and willing to kill all sorts of beasts, you know?
The Shadow of the Beast#002.speaker: Dereg

The Shadow of the Beast#003.src: I think you know what I'm getting at. I saw some massive thing lumbering around the swamp one night! Tall as the trees, it was.
The Shadow of the Beast#003.speaker: Dereg

The Shadow of the Beast#004.src: I couldn't make out the details, but if its size was any indication, it could just step over the {p} walls and wreck the whole town!
The Shadow of the Beast#004.speaker: Dereg

The Shadow of the Beast#005.src: Of course, there's so many scam artists around here trying to sell anti-monster underwear or whatever that no one believes me.
The Shadow of the Beast#005.speaker: Dereg

The Shadow of the Beast#006.src: So, that means it's up to you! Ehm, supposing that you're willing to help out, at least... The one thing I know for sure is that it was eating something.
The Shadow of the Beast#006.speaker: Dereg

The Shadow of the Beast#007.src: See that blood on the ground? That stuff is fresh. Follow it, see where it leads, and hunt that beast before it does something terrible!
The Shadow of the Beast#007.speaker: Dereg

The Shadow of the Beast#008.src: That blood trail ought to lead you to wherever the beast went. Hunt that thing down for us all!
The Shadow of the Beast#008.speaker: Dereg

The Shadow of the Beast#009.src: Follow the trail of blood left by the beast.

The Shadow of the Beast#010.src: Oh, this is such a mess! And my axe is busted, too...how am I going to get this fixed?!
The Shadow of the Beast#010.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#011.src: I can't pay for- AAAH! H-Human! What do you want?! Not a good time!
The Shadow of the Beast#011.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#012.src: Something destroyed my cow pen and wrecked up my entire farm!
The Shadow of the Beast#012.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#013.src: And they were solid, good-quality Willow, too...uff...
The Shadow of the Beast#013.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#014.src: Wait, what? You're hunting the thing? Well, that's fine and dandy, but do you think you could help here first?
The Shadow of the Beast#014.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#015.src: I have an idea of where it went, so...you scratch my back, I scratch yours?
The Shadow of the Beast#015.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#016.src: Okay, this can work, this can work! I have to figure out how to fix this, and some of my cows ran off in a panic.
The Shadow of the Beast#016.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#017.src: So, you can take care of them while I re-plan my fencing. Simple enough, right?
The Shadow of the Beast#017.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#018.src: Three of my cows ran off. Look around the farm for them. They were eating, so look for fallen wheat on the ground!
The Shadow of the Beast#018.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#019.src: Go on, hop to it! I'm waiting for you right here!
The Shadow of the Beast#019.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#020.src: Deal with the three escaped cows near the house and in the cave under the farm.

The Shadow of the Beast#021.src: Oh, back aleady? I haven't even finished my stuff, where are the cows?
The Shadow of the Beast#021.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#023.src: ...eheh. You. You're. This is a joke, right? We're having a chuckle?!
The Shadow of the Beast#023.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#024.src: WE'RE JOKING, RIGHT?! FOR THE LOVE OF ALL THAT'S HOLY TELL ME THIS IS A JOKE!
The Shadow of the Beast#024.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#025.src: WHAT IS THIS?! ARE YOU BRAINDEAD?!
The Shadow of the Beast#025.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#026.src: NO, WAIT, YOU'RE HUMAN, THAT'S THE PROBLEM! IDIOT THUGS, ALL OF YOU!
The Shadow of the Beast#026.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#027.src: DID I NEED TO SPECIFY THAT I WANTED THEM BACK ALIVE? WAS THAT NOT OBVIOUS TO YOU?!
The Shadow of the Beast#027.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#028.src: Hff...haah...hrrgh...I...I can't bellevue...bellevue? Believe! I can't believe this!
The Shadow of the Beast#028.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#029.src: Uff, settle down, Tolem, settle down...you can still salvage this...
The Shadow of the Beast#029.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#030.src: Alright, two things. Your new name is Idiot, and I'm changing our deal. You owe me [{~} Willow Planks].
The Shadow of the Beast#030.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#031.src: You're going to help me get at least one thing around here working. You get the wood, I'll keep looking over the fencing.
The Shadow of the Beast#031.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#033.src: Oh lovely. Idiot's back! Joy of joys. Willow planks, please.
The Shadow of the Beast#033.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#034.src: Good. Even if you've got murder on the mind constantly, you have decent woodcutting arms.
The Shadow of the Beast#034.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#035.src: I'll sell the remainder of these planks to try and recoup the money for my cows you mulched.
The Shadow of the Beast#035.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#036.src: So go on, get out of here now. Make yourself useful and follow the giant footprints in the ground. Hunt something that NEEDS hunting, instead of cattle!
The Shadow of the Beast#036.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#037.src: Go on, get out of here. Make yourself useful and follow the giant footprints in the ground. Hunt something that NEEDS hunting, instead of cattle!
The Shadow of the Beast#037.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#038.src: Follow the footprints from Tolem's house at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Shadow of the Beast#039.src: Oh, I'll never be able to fix this with my back in this state...
The Shadow of the Beast#039.speaker: Kroac

The Shadow of the Beast#041.src: Oh, look at this...all my years of carpentry and my bad back does my poor house in.
The Shadow of the Beast#041.speaker: Kroac

The Shadow of the Beast#042.src: What on earth could have done this?! It must be the biggest beast in the swamp!
The Shadow of the Beast#042.speaker: Kroac

The Shadow of the Beast#043.src: I was just sitting inside having some dinner, I hear some rumbling, and suddenly my house is falling apart!
The Shadow of the Beast#043.speaker: Kroac

The Shadow of the Beast#044.src: You human folk are good with physical labor, I hear? Do you think you could help me out here?
The Shadow of the Beast#044.speaker: Kroac

The Shadow of the Beast#045.src: There's a mine just over there. Think you can get [{~} Cobblestone] out of it?
The Shadow of the Beast#045.speaker: Kroac

The Shadow of the Beast#046.src: I'll go find someone who's selling any spare wood for the roof...
The Shadow of the Beast#046.speaker: Kroac

The Shadow of the Beast#047.src: Think you could help fix my house? You'll need [{~} Cobblestone] to do it.
The Shadow of the Beast#047.speaker: Kroac

The Shadow of the Beast#048.src: Enter Kroac's mine and gather [{~} Cobblestone].

The Shadow of the Beast#049.src: Did you get enough cobblestone? I found a guy down the street selling this top-quality Willow...
The Shadow of the Beast#049.speaker: Kroac

The Shadow of the Beast#050.src: Good, perfect. That should be enough. Though, I do have one other thing to ask you, soldier.
The Shadow of the Beast#050.speaker: Kroac

The Shadow of the Beast#051.src: My back's already screaming at me just from lugging the wood over here, there's no way I can climb up there and fix the roof like this.
The Shadow of the Beast#051.speaker: Kroac

The Shadow of the Beast#052.src: I can compensate you for the trouble, but d'you think you could do some patchwork for me with that cobble?
The Shadow of the Beast#052.speaker: Kroac

The Shadow of the Beast#053.src: Oh, you're a saint. Can't imagine why the guy was grumbling about humans... Just climb right on up the ladder!
The Shadow of the Beast#053.speaker: Kroac

The Shadow of the Beast#054.src: Repair Kroac's house using the cobblestone from the mine.

The Shadow of the Beast#055.src: I'm sorry, but your patchjob fell apart. You'll need something like {~} cobblestone to help fix this.
The Shadow of the Beast#055.speaker: Kroac

The Shadow of the Beast#056.src: That'll do just fine, kind soldier! You're a lifesaver, really, you are.
The Shadow of the Beast#056.speaker: Kroac

The Shadow of the Beast#057.src: Wait, you're going after the thing that did this? Really?! Fantastic! That's a load off my mind.
The Shadow of the Beast#057.speaker: Kroac

The Shadow of the Beast#058.src: Look's like there's tracks off to the east...big tracks. Good luck following it, stay safe!
The Shadow of the Beast#058.speaker: Kroac

The Shadow of the Beast#059.src: If you are done fixing my house, it looks like there're tacks off to the east...big tracks. Good luck following it, stay safe!
The Shadow of the Beast#059.speaker: Kroac

The Shadow of the Beast#060.src: Keep following the tracks of the beast.

The Shadow of the Beast#061.src: EVERYONE, MOVE! THE BEAST IS ON A RAMPAGE!
The Shadow of the Beast#061.speaker: Rileen

The Shadow of the Beast#062.src: Aah, no! There were people in that house!
The Shadow of the Beast#062.speaker: Rileen

The Shadow of the Beast#063.src: Wah! H-Human! Get away, there's nothing you can help with here!
The Shadow of the Beast#063.speaker: Rileen

The Shadow of the Beast#064.src: All your type does is break and hurt! You have more in common with the giant there than any of us!
The Shadow of the Beast#064.speaker: Rileen

The Shadow of the Beast#065.src: Aah, there's so many people hurt already, don't make it worse please!
The Shadow of the Beast#065.speaker: Rileen

The Shadow of the Beast#066.src: We don't even have any medicine...
The Shadow of the Beast#066.speaker: Rileen

The Shadow of the Beast#067.src: Ugh, think Rileen! You have the herbs, what else goes into the poultices...
The Shadow of the Beast#067.speaker: Rileen

The Shadow of the Beast#068.src: Oh, right! Fish oil...but I don't have a rod, gah!
The Shadow of the Beast#068.speaker: Rileen

The Shadow of the Beast#069.src: There's no way I can get [{~} Salmon Oil], even if that pond out back is teeming with fish...
The Shadow of the Beast#069.speaker: Rileen

The Shadow of the Beast#071.src: No, there's no time to make a fishing spear- AAH! You're still here? What do you WANT?!
The Shadow of the Beast#071.speaker: Rileen

The Shadow of the Beast#072.src: W-wait, what's...is this... This is salmon oil! Ten bottles of it! You...you heard me talking?
The Shadow of the Beast#072.speaker: Rileen

The Shadow of the Beast#073.src: And you went out of your way to... What kind of a human are you? I've only ever heard horror stories about your kind.
The Shadow of the Beast#073.speaker: Rileen

The Shadow of the Beast#075.src: ...maybe you're not so bad. I don't have anything that I can give you in return, but thank you, still.
The Shadow of the Beast#075.speaker: Rileen

The Shadow of the Beast#076.src: Wait, you were chasing the giant? That's why you were here? That...that's amazing news!
The Shadow of the Beast#076.speaker: Rileen

The Shadow of the Beast#077.src: I think it went into the cave east of here. Go for it! Stop that thing before it causes any more damage!
The Shadow of the Beast#077.speaker: Rileen

The Shadow of the Beast#078.src: Find the cave of the beast by following the footprints behind Rileen's house.

The Shadow of the Beast#079.src: Kill the beast and return to Dereg with proof of its death at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Shadow of the Beast#080.src: You're back! Any luck hunting the thing down?

The Shadow of the Beast#081.src: What? You actually found the beast?! Heck of a hunting job, human!

The Shadow of the Beast#082.src: You wouldn't be back here if you didn't manage to kill it...which means our problems are solved, right?

The Shadow of the Beast#083.src: Heheh! That bone powder looks giant enough to me! Great job, bucko!
The Shadow of the Beast#083.speaker: Dereg

The Shadow of the Beast#084.src: Y'know, come to think of it, I remember something that might be interesting to your sort.

The Shadow of the Beast#085.src: The weapon merchant in {p} researches cryptids as a hobby, and that beast seemed one-of-a-kind to me.

The Shadow of the Beast#086.src: You should show him that bone powder! He might have some good gear for you.
The Shadow of the Beast#086.speaker: Dereg

Tunnel Trouble#000.src: Talk to Captain Fenor in front of {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Tunnel Trouble#001.src: Ah! You must be a new recruit! Well, I've got a mission for you.
Tunnel Trouble#001.speaker: Captain Fenor

Tunnel Trouble#002.src: There's an old cave behind me. It was used in the Corruption Wars...
Tunnel Trouble#002.speaker: Captain Fenor

Tunnel Trouble#003.src: We used it for quick and easy travel between {p} and {p}. It’s been abandoned for years.
Tunnel Trouble#003.speaker: Captain Fenor

Tunnel Trouble#004.src: This cave could prove to be very useful for future recruits who need to travel between {p} and {p}.
Tunnel Trouble#004.speaker: Captain Fenor

Tunnel Trouble#005.src: Now, here's where you come in - I need you to clear out that cave route so we can use it once more! Good luck, soldier!
Tunnel Trouble#005.speaker: Captain Fenor

Tunnel Trouble#006.src: Enter the cave behind Captain Fenor at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Tunnel Trouble#007.src: ...Oh! Shoot, is it time to get to work already?
Tunnel Trouble#007.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#009.src: Uh... well, to start, we'll need to clear that debris. Just... give it a shove, or something. That'll probably do it.
Tunnel Trouble#009.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#010.src: Help Miner Linton remove the debris blocking the path.

Tunnel Trouble#011.src: Pretty easy, huh? Hey, maybe you can just go on ahead, and do the rest yourself?
Tunnel Trouble#011.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#012.src: ...Yeah, no, I should probably do my job. Let me grab my pickaxe, and we can keep going forward.
Tunnel Trouble#012.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#013.src: Clear the cave of possible roadblocks.

Tunnel Trouble#014.src: Oh, come on... Hey, soldier, do your job! Get rid of those monsters, would you?
Tunnel Trouble#014.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#016.src: A cave-in? Really? More work for me... I'll make us a way through, just keep fighting those corrupteds!
Tunnel Trouble#016.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#017.src: Halfway there... Ugh, I knew I should have brought explosives...
Tunnel Trouble#017.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#018.src: I can see the other side! Just a little more...
Tunnel Trouble#018.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#019.src: There we go, I've made us a hole! Get over here, quickly!
Tunnel Trouble#019.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#020.src: ...Oh, come on. You've got to be kidding me. Another cave-in? Really?
Tunnel Trouble#020.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#021.src: And of course it's bigger than the last one. What's my pickaxe going to do against this thing?!
Tunnel Trouble#021.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#022.src: Really should have thought to bring explosives. Well, soldier, we tried our best! Nobody'll blame us if we give up now.
Tunnel Trouble#022.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#023.src: ...What? Don't look at me like that. Fine, we can- huh? Do you hear that? Over there, to the right.
Tunnel Trouble#023.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#024.src: Oh, uh... Hi... Well, this is a little awkward... I'll just... Go.

Tunnel Trouble#025.src: ...You know what? I'm not going to ask. As far as I'm concerned, that didn't happen.
Tunnel Trouble#025.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#026.src: Right, of course you want to check it out. Fine! Go ahead. I'll just... sit here and twiddle my thumbs 'till you're back.
Tunnel Trouble#026.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#027.src: Investigate the small hole to the right of the large pile of debris.

Tunnel Trouble#028.src: Oh... Didn't expect you to follow me... Well, um... Hi! This will sound mad but...
Tunnel Trouble#028.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#029.src: I'm Drale, and I'm on a mission to free these cows from the enslavement of {p}.
Tunnel Trouble#029.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#030.src: Those farmers stole those cows. They are sacred animals. Now they're about to turn them into steak! If you were to help me, maybe I could help you...
Tunnel Trouble#030.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#031.src: Go free those innocent cows from enslavement! Qu-quickly! Before that farmer gets back...
Tunnel Trouble#031.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#032.src: Where are you going? Come here and talk to me first.
Tunnel Trouble#032.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#033.src: Free the cows without being seen by the farmer.

Tunnel Trouble#034.src: Go free the cows from the farmers before they're taken to the slaughterhouse! Oh man, the slaughterhouse...
Tunnel Trouble#034.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#035.src: Ah, good to see my cows are all in tip-top shape! Welp, time to- gah!
Tunnel Trouble#035.speaker: Bylvis

Tunnel Trouble#036.src: An intruder! What are you doing with my cows!? Guard golem, attack!
Tunnel Trouble#036.speaker: Bylvis

Tunnel Trouble#038.src: Golem! No! That cost me thousands of emeralds!
Tunnel Trouble#038.speaker: Bylvis

Tunnel Trouble#039.src: Return to Drale about your success.

Tunnel Trouble#040.src: Thank you so much, but we're not done yet. We need to get these cows out the province.
Tunnel Trouble#040.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#041.src: There's a small opening behind me. Go through it and help me get these cows on a raft to Gavel!
Tunnel Trouble#041.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#042.src: Help Drale push the raft with the cows out to sea.

Tunnel Trouble#043.src: There's the raft! Help me push it for the cows!
Tunnel Trouble#043.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#044.src: And, that should do it! Be free, my friends! A new life awaits!
Tunnel Trouble#044.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#045.src: Again, thank you so much for what you have done this day. These cows deserve a better life than being farm animals.
Tunnel Trouble#045.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#046.src: ...Oh! Right! You were busy with something before you came to help me, weren't you? Hm... I think I might be able to help you with that as well! Let's go back to the tunnel!
Tunnel Trouble#046.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#047.src: Return to Miner Linton back in the abandoned cave.

Tunnel Trouble#048.src: Oh, good, you're back. It's been, like, an hour! What were you even doing for that long!
Tunnel Trouble#048.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#049.src: ...You helped some crazy cow-obsessed lunatic steal some cows? I don't think you're allowed to do that. There's a law against that, or something.
Tunnel Trouble#049.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#050.src: Eh. Not that I really care, either way. I've certainly done worse.
Tunnel Trouble#050.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#051.src: Well then! Ready to call it quits? We're definitely not going to make any progress, so we might as we-
Tunnel Trouble#051.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#052.src: Hello again, friend! I'm here with help! Cows, to me!
Tunnel Trouble#052.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#054.src: Since you helped me with my problem, I thought I should repay that favor by helping you!
Tunnel Trouble#054.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#055.src: Welp, see ya! Oh, and nice to meet you, miner! Now, let's get going my cows!
Tunnel Trouble#055.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#056.src: ...I- huh. You saw that too, right? I didn't just imagine that?
Tunnel Trouble#056.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#057.src: You know what? I think I quit. I think this has finally pushed me to my limit! I didn't know that I had one, but apparently I do!
Tunnel Trouble#057.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#058.src: You can... go on ahead. Tell whoever's on the other end that we succeeded. And while we do that, I'll be searching for a better career.
Tunnel Trouble#058.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#060.src: Speak to Sergeant Klafson next to the {p} entrance of the cave.

Tunnel Trouble#061.src: Recruit, Captain Fenor told me to meet you here, said if you came out on this side of that tunnel then you completed your mission!
Tunnel Trouble#061.speaker: Sergeant Klafson

Tunnel Trouble#062.src: You did a great deed today, soldier! We can now use this cave to travel easily between {p} and {p}! Great job!
Tunnel Trouble#062.speaker: Sergeant Klafson

Underwater#000.src: Talk to Omango located at the North of {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Underwater#001.src: Hi, my name is Omango. I am a resident of the {p} village, on top of the hill.
Underwater#001.speaker: Omango

Underwater#002.src: As you may know, our people came to your land years ago, and this is the ship they used.
Underwater#002.speaker: Omango

Underwater#003.src: They brought lots of luxurious goods with them. Most of them got lost in the wreck.
Underwater#003.speaker: Omango

Underwater#004.src: But recently, a small hole has opened in the shipwreck here. It is believed that fortune is hidden within it.
Underwater#004.speaker: Omango

Underwater#005.src: Unfortunately, nobody has been able to explore it. It is too deep, no creature can survive underwater that long!
Underwater#005.speaker: Omango

Underwater#006.src: However, my old friend Sayrr is a fisherman, and I know that he has a very special helmet...
Underwater#006.speaker: Omango

Underwater#007.src: If you convince him to give you this helmet, and find the treasure, I'll give you a part of it!
Underwater#007.speaker: Omango

Underwater#008.src: Sayrr is out on his boat, but the cave next to me is a quick way over to where he does his fishing. Be careful on the way, though.
Underwater#008.speaker: Omango

Underwater#009.src: When you finally have the helmet, explore the ship and bring me back [{~} Ancient Treasure]. Good luck.
Underwater#009.speaker: Omango

Underwater#010.src: Go through the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to find Sayrr on his boat on the other side

Underwater#011.src: Why ya looking at me like that? Is it cause I'm small, eh? I'll have you know that I caught fish that were twice your size!
Underwater#011.speaker: Sayrr

Underwater#012.src: ...or, well, I used to be able to. Nothing's biting recently- wait a sec, why'd you hop on my boat anyways, stranger?
Underwater#012.speaker: Sayrr

Underwater#013.src: Ahah! Yes, I still have that old breathing helmet. You want it? You'll have to do something for me first.
Underwater#013.speaker: Sayrr

Underwater#014.src: I'm sure you heard me, but the fish just aren't biting around here anymore! I need to make a living somehow! There's some fish in that cave, but...
Underwater#014.speaker: Sayrr

Underwater#015.src: ...it's a bit dangerous. Tell ya what, I'll give you my fishing rod, and you can go catch me, say, [{~} Gudgeon Meat] down there.
Underwater#015.speaker: Sayrr

Underwater#016.src: The helmet will be all yours after that.
Underwater#016.speaker: Sayrr

Underwater#017.src: Bring back [[Fishing#Gudgeon|[{~} Gudgeon Meat]]] found in the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to Sayrr

Underwater#018.src: Ah! Welcome back! Any luck with the fish?
Underwater#018.speaker: Sayrr

Underwater#019.src: Great, and I'll thank you kindly. Here's your helmet, have fun with that.
Underwater#019.speaker: Sayrr

Underwater#020.src: Explore the crashed ship for a lost treasure at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Underwater#021.src: Break the crate and bring [{~} Old Treasure] to Omango at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Underwater#022.src: You got it! You found the treasure!
Underwater#022.speaker: Omango

Underwater#023.src: As promised, here's your part of the loot.
Underwater#023.speaker: Omango

Wrath of the Mummy#000.src: Talk to Ormrod in the desert of {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Wrath of the Mummy#002.src: I live in this camp by choice. A curse follows me... and now trouble starts wherever I go. I left civilization and made camp in the desert, where I could do no more harm.
Wrath of the Mummy#002.speaker: Ormrod

Wrath of the Mummy#003.src: I do miss the comforts of {p} some days, though... you look like a learned adventurer. If I asked you to investigate this curse, perhaps you could help me rid myself of it?
Wrath of the Mummy#003.speaker: Ormrod

Wrath of the Mummy#004.src: It all started when I discovered an old tomb in the North of the desert. Upon entering it, the ground started shaking and I heard inhuman screams coming from deeper within.
Wrath of the Mummy#004.speaker: Ormrod

Wrath of the Mummy#005.src: I ran as fast as I could, learning later the tomb housed the remains of an ancient Mummy... which I accidentally awoke. If the Mummy could be put back to rest, perhaps the curse would go away.
Wrath of the Mummy#005.speaker: Ormrod

Wrath of the Mummy#006.src: I have heard of a scholar in {p}, Achper, who may know more about the tomb. I am reluctant to return to the city, in case my presence hurts anyone else.
Wrath of the Mummy#006.speaker: Ormrod

Wrath of the Mummy#007.src: If you would truly like to help, you should start by talking to him.
Wrath of the Mummy#007.speaker: Ormrod

Wrath of the Mummy#008.src: Talk to Achper in {p} about the curse at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Wrath of the Mummy#009.src: If I know about mummies? Of course! I've spent my entire life studying them!
Wrath of the Mummy#009.speaker: Achper

Wrath of the Mummy#010.src: They usually are very hard to reach, hidden in their tomb... and they don't like being disturbed.
Wrath of the Mummy#010.speaker: Achper

Wrath of the Mummy#011.src: I have heard of the curse that follows Ormrod, and the only way to remove its effects would be to kill the mummy.
Wrath of the Mummy#011.speaker: Achper

Wrath of the Mummy#012.src: The tomb lies in the North of the desert, but be very careful!
Wrath of the Mummy#012.speaker: Achper

Wrath of the Mummy#013.src: Mummies aren't known to be weak... especially that one. It's demonic... pure evil, It's easily one of the most powerful specimens I've encountered.
Wrath of the Mummy#013.speaker: Achper

Wrath of the Mummy#014.src: On top of that, the Creden Tibus bandit clan have been ransacking the tombs around the desert. You might run into trouble with them, so be prepared.
Wrath of the Mummy#014.speaker: Achper

Wrath of the Mummy#015.src: Attempt to enter the Mummy's tomb at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Wrath of the Mummy#016.src: Stop! If you're thinking about looting the tomb, you're too late. The Creden Tibus have laid claim here, and you're not getting past.
Wrath of the Mummy#016.speaker: Bandit

Wrath of the Mummy#017.src: Mummy? Curse? I don't know anything about that, but I can't let you in - how do I know you won't just grab the gold?
Wrath of the Mummy#017.speaker: Bandit

Wrath of the Mummy#018.src: Unless... look. I've been waiting to get my hands on some pink wool, and the only shop that sells it has just been restocked.
Wrath of the Mummy#018.speaker: Bandit

Wrath of the Mummy#019.src: Trouble is, the shop's over in {p} and I'm stuck guarding this tomb. If you go and grab me some before it sells out, I can look the other way.
Wrath of the Mummy#019.speaker: Bandit

Wrath of the Mummy#020.src: You can take my wagon over there, but you'll have to make your own way back. Give me [[Pink Wool|[{~} Pink Wool]]] and I'll let you through.
Wrath of the Mummy#020.speaker: Bandit

Wrath of the Mummy#021.src: Use the bandit's wagon at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] to get to {p}.

Wrath of the Mummy#022.src: Bring back [[Pink Wool|[{~} Pink Wool]]] to the bandit at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Wrath of the Mummy#023.src: Well, whaddya know? You got some Pink Wool! Okay, hand it here and I'll look the other way and let you into the tomb.
Wrath of the Mummy#023.speaker: Bandit

Wrath of the Mummy#024.src: Just don't touch any of the gold, hmm? And if I were you, I wouldn't go in too deep.
Wrath of the Mummy#024.speaker: Bandit

Wrath of the Mummy#025.src: The clan was going to explore further inside, but the sounds...
Wrath of the Mummy#025.speaker: Bandit

Wrath of the Mummy#026.src: Anyway, I'll still let you inside if you want. Just remember, if anyone asks, this conversation never happened.
Wrath of the Mummy#026.speaker: Bandit

Wrath of the Mummy#027.src: Enter the tomb at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] and kill the Mummy.

Wrath of the Mummy#028.src: Bring [[The Mummy's Bandage|[{~} Mummy's Bandage]]] to Ormrod at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Wrath of the Mummy#029.src: Hello, again... have you had any luck?
Wrath of the Mummy#029.speaker: Ormrod

Wrath of the Mummy#030.src: Those are the Mummy's bandages?! You did it? My curse is finally lifted!
Wrath of the Mummy#030.speaker: Ormrod

Wrath of the Mummy#031.src: I can't thank you enough! As a reward, take this rag I got from the Mummy when I entered the tomb.
Wrath of the Mummy#031.speaker: Ormrod

Wrath of the Mummy#032.src: I am not strong enough to wear it, but I'm sure you are! Take these emeralds too, that's the least I can do!
Wrath of the Mummy#032.speaker: Ormrod
